42276062.summary: In lab cultures and mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, a stem cell-derived astrocyte therapy helped clear myelin debris and produced new myelin-making cells.

41529777.conclusion_quote: PTX is not required for the manifestation of motor dysfunction and neuropathic pain in MOG 35-55 -based EAE models.
41529777.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, leaving out pertussis toxin still caused movement problems, pain sensitivity, and spinal cord demyelination.

42340505.conclusion_quote: This study is the first to demonstrate the synergistic effects of LPC and LPS toxins compared to their individual effects in both the brain and spinal cord.
42340505.summary: In mice, combining two toxins, lysolecithin and lipopolysaccharide, caused more myelin loss than either alone, especially in the spinal cord.

42148304.conclusion_quote: Our study provides novel information on the normal development of the membranous labyrinth of C57BL/6 embryos, reference data for detailed, objective and stage specific phenotyping of mutants and first results of employing the data for characterizing the spectrum of inner ear malformations in genetically engineered embryos.
42148304.summary: This study mapped normal inner ear development in C57BL/6 mouse embryos from days 9.5 to 14.5 and created reference measurements for spotting malformations. It is not about multiple sclerosis.

42102575.mechanism: Not applicable, biomarker study without a tested treatment
42102575.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the presynaptic protein BSN can be quantified in plasma and CSF to assess synaptic pathologies.
42102575.summary: In mice with EAE and people with MS, a synapse protein called bassoon was measured in blood and spinal fluid, rising early and staying high in progressive disease.

42237409.conclusion_quote: Our findings highlight the dynamic interplay between skin microbiota and the host in phenotypic skin-aging, offering new insights for designing interventions to maintain youthful skin.
42237409.summary: Study of skin bacteria and aging in people and human skin cells, not multiple sclerosis, linking one bacterium to youthful skin.

42304642.mechanism: activates adult neural stem cells, promotes partial remyelination
42304642.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, AuNPs activated adult NSCs in the mouse hippocampus, partially ameliorated degenerative changes, and enhanced partial remyelination in the CPZ demyelination model.
42304642.summary: In mice with cuprizone induced demyelination, gold nanoparticles activated stem cells in the hippocampus, reduced nerve damage, and partly restored myelin.

41509630.mechanism: Produces GABA to regulate immune cells
41509630.conclusion_quote: These changes, combined with reduced EAE severity observed in Env mice, suggest that GABA-producing bacteria could be considered for the treatment of neuroinflammatory conditions.
41509630.summary: In mice with EAE, a gut bacterium engineered to make GABA reduced disease severity in one mouse strain but not another, while altering gut microbes and brain protein levels.

42032184.mechanism: No treatment tested, respiratory measures reflect myelin status
42032184.conclusion_quote: Our study showed that respiratory function data may be used as a non-invasive method to predict brain conditions in mice, although translation to humans will require further validation.
42032184.summary: In mice with aging and cuprizone induced demyelination, combined breathing measurements predicted myelin loss, suggesting a possible noninvasive way to detect brain changes.

42233143.conclusion_quote: Spiritual coping is an important strategy in responding to anxiety, especially in the early stages of diagnosis.
42233143.summary: A survey of 120 women living with HIV in Indonesia found that spiritual coping was linked to anxiety, and longer time since diagnosis and older age were linked to less anxiety.

41593300.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes a model only
41593300.conclusion_quote: By employing lysolecithin-induced demyelination and Rabies virus infection experiments, we demonstrate the potential of MyS as an innovative, physiologically relevant platform for studying myelin-related neurodegeneration and neuroinfection.
41593300.summary: Researchers built human myelin spheres from stem cell derived neurons and oligodendrocytes that myelinate and mature like late fetal cells, offering a platform to study demyelination and infection.

41896238.mechanism: Blocks CD22, restoring microglial debris clearance and remyelination
41896238.conclusion_quote: These findings offer insights into potential therapeutic strategies to combat aging-related neurodegeneration and central nervous system functional decline.
41896238.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, blocking CD22 restored microglial clearance of myelin debris and improved remyelination in mice lacking Bhlhe41.

42507732.mechanism: Blocks GPR17 receptor, enabling oligodendrocyte precursor maturation
42507732.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings support a role for pharmacological GPR17 antagonism in promoting remyelination and highlight this G protein-coupled receptor as a promising therapeutic target for demyelinating disorders.
42507732.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a selective GPR17 blocker taken by mouth improved memory, visual nerve signal timing, and myelin repair in the brain and optic nerve.

41686700.conclusion_quote: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to detect A. marginale in host-seeking D. variabilis collected in the field.
41686700.summary: A field survey of ticks on Missouri cattle pastures found the cattle bacterium Anaplasma marginale in one pool of adult male Dermacentor ticks. This study does not involve multiple sclerosis or an MS model.

41457750.mechanism: Raises lysoPC and ROS, inducing ILC2 apoptosis
41457750.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that CD5L inhibits ILC2 activation and induces ILC2 apoptosis, thereby suppressing allergic airway inflammation.
41457750.summary: In animal models of allergic asthma, CD5L reduced harmful type 2 immune cells by causing their death, which eased lung inflammation.

41501060.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the importance of ECM protein induction in CNS glial cells during PMS while providing potential therapeutic targets for future investigation.
41501060.summary: Researchers analyzed proteins in human brain tissue, human brain cells, and mice with EAE or cuprizone demyelination, finding extracellular matrix proteins elevated in progressive MS lesions, mainly in glial cells.

41957643.mechanism: Removes CB1 receptors from mature oligodendrocytes, impairing maturation
41957643.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings demonstrate a crucial role for CB1 receptors in modulating oligodendrocyte maturation during myelin regeneration and supports the notion that appropriate endocannabinoid signaling in the oligodendroglial lineage is essential for achieving efficient remyelination.
41957643.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing CB1 receptors from newly formed oligodendrocytes slowed myelin repair, worsened nerve damage, and blocked motor recovery.

41689874.mechanism: Suppresses neuroinflammation and promotes myelin integrity
41689874.conclusion_quote: The above findings suggest that SA could ameliorate CPZ-induced psychotic symptoms in mice via suppressing neuroinflammation and promoting myelin integrity, perhaps providing further benefits to people suffering from schizophrenia.
41689874.summary: In mice given a cuprizone diet to model schizophrenia with myelin loss, syringic acid eased behavior problems, reduced inflammation, and supported myelin proteins.

42634800.conclusion_quote: The ternary emulsifier blend partially compensated for reduced dietary energy, particularly during the starter and grower phases.
42634800.summary: This poultry study tested an emulsifier blend in broiler chickens fed reduced energy diets, and it does not involve any multiple sclerosis model.

40925881.conclusion_quote: This aids our understanding of how certain autoimmune diseases are associated with infertility.
40925881.summary: This review of past studies looks at how mice with EAE, a model of MS, may show inflammation and hormone changes affecting the reproductive organs.

41258891.conclusion_quote: These data show a selective vulnerability of immunologically primed mice toward the effects of PM 10 , occurring before the emergence of overt motor impairment and presenting as specific behavioral alterations.
41258891.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, brief exposure to air pollution particles before symptoms appeared increased risky and novelty seeking behavior but did not worsen physical disease.

40930691.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes model induction only
40930691.conclusion_quote: This animal model could be useful for acute and chronic studies and to assess the effectiveness of different treatments.
40930691.summary: This paper describes how to induce EAE, a mouse model of MS, using a myelin peptide injection and how to assess disease and oxidative damage in the nervous system.

41249698.mechanism: Describes oligodendrocyte gene and chromatin changes in disease
41249698.conclusion_quote: Our single-cell multiomic resource highlights dynamic and subtype-specific responses of OLG to EAE, which might be amenable to modulation in MS.
41249698.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped how myelin cells change their genes over time, finding early immune states that persist later.

40844545.mechanism: targets mitochondrial oxidative stress, boosting myelin gene expression
40844545.conclusion_quote: The findings of this study demonstrate that mitochondria-targeted antioxidant SkQ1 may, through targeting oxidative stress in the mitochondria and consequently myelin gene expression, have induced remyelination enhancement and improved functional performance in chronic cuprizone-intoxicant mice.
40844545.summary: In mice given the toxin cuprizone to damage myelin, the mitochondria targeted antioxidant SkQ1 improved movement and enhanced myelin repair in the brain.

41409798.mechanism: Raises blood lipids and pro-inflammatory cytokines IFN-γ and IL-17
41409798.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates that a high-fat diet significantly worsens clinical and immunological outcomes in an animal model of MS.
41409798.summary: In rats with experimental MS, eating a high-fat diet for 45 days before disease induction worsened symptoms and raised inflammatory signals compared with a standard diet.

41231671.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal a mechanism of immune regulation mediated by noradrenergic transmission, offering potential therapeutic targets for immune-mediated diseases.
41231671.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that brain neurons controlling appetite regulate noradrenaline signals that shape immune cell production in bone marrow and thymus.

40677715.conclusion_quote: Yet, remarkable differences existed in the identity of deregulated EV-associated miRNAs, which, in EAE mice, were predicted to target several MS-relevant biological processes and nervous system-, immune- and inflammation-related pathways, possibly contributing to disease worsening.
40677715.summary: In mice with EAE, short term exposure to particulate matter air pollution changed which vesicle carried microRNAs were altered in the blood compared with healthy mice, possibly worsening disease.

40650067.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal the mechanisms of ERS-related biomarkers in MS and provide potential targets for diagnosis and treatment.
40650067.summary: Researchers analyzed patient data and tested an EAE mouse model to find 13 cell stress markers, with GPX1 and RCN1 showing diagnostic promise in mice.

40470772.mechanism: Activates Kir4.1 channels, enhancing FYN phosphorylation
40470772.conclusion_quote: The findings highlight the critical role of Kir4.1 channels in MS pathogenesis and suggest that pharmacological activation of these channels by 2-D08 can be a promising therapeutic strategy for enhancing brain recovery in demyelinating diseases.
40470772.summary: In mice with EAE and in marmosets, the drug 2-D08 activated Kir4.1 channels, reduced demyelination, and helped myelin producing cells mature.

40365310.mechanism: Suppresses microglia activation through NF-κBp65 signaling
40365310.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these results collectively suggest that Irisin alleviates EAE progression by suppressing microglia activation via the NF-κBp65 pathway, highlighting its potential as a promising therapeutic target for multiple sclerosis treatment.
40365310.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the protein irisin reduced disease severity and tissue damage by calming overactive brain immune cells called microglia.

40929244.conclusion_quote: Cross-validation of our findings in mouse cerebellar slice cultures confirmed that the pro-remyelinating compounds were effective ex vivo, suggesting the translational potential of our MHBOs +MG model.
40929244.summary: Human brain organoids containing microglia were damaged with a toxin, then treated with three pro-remyelinating drugs, which boosted myelin repair, and the effect was also seen in mouse brain slices.

41090353.mechanism: Removes ANKRD55, impairing T cell receptor signaling
41090353.conclusion_quote: These findings establish ANKRD55 as a critical regulator of TCR signaling and highlight its therapeutic potential in pathogenic T cell-driven autoimmune diseases.
41090353.summary: Mice with EAE lacking the Ankrd55 gene had milder disease and less brain inflammation, because their T cells activated less effectively.

40853740.mechanism: Biased S1P1 agonist favoring beta-arrestin over G-protein signaling
40853740.conclusion_quote: These results highlight compound 28 as the first β-arrestin biased S1P 1 agonist with effective immunomodulatory activity and improved safety, offering a promising MS therapeutic candidate.
40853740.summary: Tested a new fingolimod-like drug, compound 28, in mice with EAE, a model of MS. It lowered immune cells and improved symptom scores, with good heart safety in human heart cells.

40553489.mechanism: Covalently blocks JAK3 and TEC kinases
40553489.conclusion_quote: These findings support the potential of compound 8a as a promising candidate for the development of new therapies targeting JAK3 and TEC.
40553489.summary: A new drug candidate, compound 8a, blocks JAK3 and TEC immune enzymes, taken by mouth it eased disease in mice with EAE, a model of MS, without weight loss.

40254703.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that C. pepo attenuates cuprizone-induced oxidative stress and demyelination, supporting its neuroprotective potential in multiple sclerosis models.
40254703.summary: In rats given cuprizone to mimic MS, a Cucurbita pepo plant extract improved motor coordination, reduced anxiety-like behavior, lowered oxidative stress, and reduced myelin loss.

39955714.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the identified stage-dependent mechanism for bone loss in EAE may help to develop improved strategies for osteoporosis treatment in pwMS.
39955714.summary: In mice with EAE, bone loss follows two phases: early loss of bone formation with osteocyte death, then later increased bone breakdown linked to CXCL13/CXCR5 signaling.

40896933.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that EAE-related paralysis includes progressive biomechanical and structural changes in skeletal muscles, exacerbating motor disability.
40896933.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, limb muscles first stiffened, then softened at peak disease, then stiffened again, with lower dystrophin and laminin later.

40043135.conclusion_quote: The data indicate that a history of EBV infection, further compounded by a diagnosis of RRMS, promotes T cell-mediated xenogeneic CNS disease in a humanized mouse model of MS.
40043135.summary: In mice given human immune cells, donors with past EBV infection or relapsing MS produced more harmful T cells in the brain and worse neurological symptoms.

40244087.conclusion_quote: This study suggests NFL, GFAP, and IL-10 as potential translational predictors of disease activity in EAE, making them potential candidates as surrogate markers for the preclinical testing of therapeutic interventions in animal models of MS.
40244087.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blood tests showed raised nerve damage markers NFL and GFAP and lower interleukin 10, suggesting possible tools for testing treatments.

40111744.mechanism: Removing OPC HMGB1 reduces barrier leakage, immune entry
40111744.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal that HMGB1 secretion from OPCs is crucial for regulating immune cell infiltration and provides insights into the immunomodulatory function of OPCs in autoimmune diseases.
40111744.summary: In mice with EAE, removing HMGB1 from oligodendrocyte precursor cells reduced blood-brain barrier leakage, immune cell entry, myelin damage, and disease progression.

41441202.conclusion_quote: Together, these models advance the quantitative evaluation of PFAS neurotoxicity and support translation into risk assessment and therapeutic strategies.
41441202.summary: Review of cell models, including brain organoids and chip systems, for studying how PFAS chemicals may harm the brain in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's and multiple sclerosis.

40033124.mechanism: promotes mitophagy, limiting mitochondrial dysfunction and inflammasome activati
40033124.conclusion_quote: These findings identify CLEC16A as a suppressor of astrocyte pathological responses and a candidate therapeutic target in MS.
40033124.summary: Mice without the CLEC16A gene in astrocytes had worse EAE, a mouse model of MS, with more inflammation, suggesting this gene normally protects the brain and spinal cord.

40433872.mechanism: Suppresses NF-κB-mediated inflammation and protects neurons
40433872.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrated that RZV8 administration alleviated EAE clinical severity, reducing inflammation, demyelination, and gliosis in EAE mice.
40433872.summary: In mice with EAE, a synthetic peptide called RZV8 eased disease severity and reduced inflammation, nerve damage, and scarring in the nervous system.

40011630.conclusion_quote: These results identify gastrodin as a promising therapeutic agent for demyelinating diseases and highlight the potential of the zebrafish model for screening pro-myelinogenic pharmacotherapy.
40011630.summary: In zebrafish, lysophosphatidylcholine-injured mice, and mice with EAE, the compound gastrodin enhanced myelin formation and repair of damaged nerve coverings.

39487943.mechanism: Reduces inflammation, demyelination and immune cell infiltration
39487943.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that the therapeutic effects of AKBA are likely a consequence of its neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties.
39487943.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, were given AKBA, a natural plant compound, which reduced disease severity, inflammation, and nerve damage.

40036867.mechanism: Immune modulation plus oligodendrocyte precursor cell differentiation
40036867.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate the potential of CT to address complex pathobiology and lay a foundation for developing novel therapeutic strategies for MS.
40036867.summary: In mice with EAE, a combination of drugs reduced inflammation and boosted myelin repair, improving motor recovery, with lower doses still effective.

40969613.conclusion_quote: Overall, these results demonstrate that the OB is a permissive entry zone for autoreactive immune cells in the OB in early stages of EAE, highlighting olfactory and behavioral testing as promising tools for early detection and monitoring of MS.
40969613.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, smell deficits appeared before motor symptoms alongside a temporary breach of the olfactory bulb's barrier and immune cell entry.

41613946.conclusion_quote: Here, we describe xenobiotic-free protocols for generating retinal and oligodendrocyte-rich cortical organoids and their fusion into assembloids to more accurately model RGC physiology.
41613946.summary: Researchers built human retina and brain organoid assemblies without animal-derived reagents to model the nerve cells damaged in optic neuritis and MS. No treatment was tested.

41511600.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes CSF-1 expression changes
41511600.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest a potential role for CSF-1 in the pathogenesis and progression of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis/multiple sclerosis.
41511600.summary: Researchers found that spinal cord astrocytes showed much more CSF-1 signal during early and late stages of disease in mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS.

40523174.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease changes only
40523174.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that both human MS and mouse EAE share similar cerebellar changes linked to mitochondrial dysfunction.
40523174.summary: In postmortem MS cerebellum and mice with late-stage EAE, mitochondrial activity fell and Purkinje cells were lost, suggesting mitochondria may be a future treatment target.

40077767.mechanism: Boosts regulatory T cells and their suppressive function
40077767.conclusion_quote: In summary, we showed that YM promotes an immunosuppressive environment by modulating Treg function, reducing EAE symptoms and immune cell infiltration into the brain, and suggesting that YM consumption could be a good cost-effective treatment for MS.
40077767.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daily oral yerba mate reduced symptoms, immune cell buildup in the brain, and demyelination by boosting regulatory T cells.

40057769.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease mechanism only
40057769.conclusion_quote: This study reveals the crucial role of mitral cells and their potassium channel activity in the olfactory bulb during EAE, thereby enhancing our understanding of neuroinflammation-induced neurodegeneration in MS.
40057769.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, inflammation damaged olfactory bulb mitral cells and raised their potassium channel activity, likely impairing smell.

41224757.mechanism: none, descriptive study with no treatment tested
41224757.conclusion_quote: This multi-faceted microglial response during efficient remyelination provides the basis of multi-faceted microglia-specific targets for future MS therapies.
41224757.summary: In mice given lysolecithin to cause demyelination, single cell sequencing showed microglia pass through distinct states during myelin repair, and this is delayed in older mice.

40320991.mechanism: Replenishes NAD+ coenzyme levels to support cell energy
40320991.conclusion_quote: Direct NAD+ supplementation improves the locomotor ability and spatial memory of cuprizone-intoxicated C57BL/6J mice.
40320991.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, daily NAD+ injections improved spatial memory and motor skills but did not change depression-like or exploratory behavior.

39972161.mechanism: AAV-delivered NT-3 gives immunomodulation, remyelination, axon protection
39972161.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings demonstrate the translational potential of AAV-delivered NT-3 for chronic progressive MS.
39972161.summary: In mice with EAE, a gene therapy delivering neurotrophin 3 to muscle improved movement and strength, protected axons, and helped repair myelin after disease began.

40086762.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, preventing synapse loss
40086762.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the data indicate the potential of preventive treatment with Fingolimod against synaptopathy and visual dysfunction associated with inflammatory demyelination.
40086762.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, daily Fingolimod injections prevented loss of visual function and synapse changes, though it did not stop myelin damage.

40530518.mechanism: blocks MyD88 signaling, reducing activin-A and IL-17 production
40530518.conclusion_quote: MyD88 signaling in T cells may be an attractive clinical target for anti-inflammatory therapies for diseases of the central nervous system.
40530518.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blocking the MyD88 protein reduced activin-A and IL-17 production by T cells and eased disease severity.

40959993.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation and myelin formation
40959993.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings suggest that ospemifene is a promising treatment option for demyelinating diseases.
40959993.summary: In mice with EAE and toxin caused demyelination, the approved drug ospemifene helped cells form myelin and improved neurological function.

40053309.mechanism: Promotes remyelination and reduces glial inflammation
40053309.conclusion_quote: hucMSC-Exos administration in the animal model of chronic MS leads to improved movement function, likely due to increased remyelination, modulation of inflammatory processes, and increased expression of genes related to the oligodendrocyte lineage.
40053309.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, exosomes from umbilical cord stem cells improved movement, boosted myelin repair, and reduced inflammatory glial cells.

40407589.mechanism: silencing lncRNA alters inflammation and myelin gene expression
40407589.conclusion_quote: XIST may contribute to the MS pathogenesis as well as neuroinflammatory diseases such as and Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases and may be a promising therapeutic target.
40407589.summary: In human brain organoids, silencing the XIST gene changed inflammation and myelin markers, and treatment with FTY720 or DMF had mixed effects.

39165219.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study confirms the involvement of enzymes of cholesterol metabolism in the pathophysiology of EAE, with sex and disease progression affecting the expression of these genes.
39165219.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured cholesterol genes in the spinal cord and found their expression shifted with disease course and sex.

40800952.mechanism: No treatment tested, only measures blood flow changes
40800952.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study introduces a novel, non-invasive functional approach for investigating vascular dysfunction in the context of MS, addressing an important yet understudied aspect in both pre-clinical and clinical research.
40800952.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination, functional ultrasound showed increased blood volume response in the somatosensory cortex, linked to vascular changes rather than myelin loss.

40965509.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes B-cell changes in disease
40965509.conclusion_quote: In summary, dynamic changes in the brain, LM, and dural B cells are associated with age-dependent disease severity in an animal model of progressive MS.
40965509.summary: In mice with a progressive form of MS, immune B cells in the brain lining, dura and bone marrow change over time and track with disease severity.

39581303.mechanism: Not applicable, describes immune cell changes only
39581303.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our findings indicate that both small intestine and colon are involved in the pathogenesis of EAE, despite engaging distinct immunological processes.
39581303.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells in the small intestine and colon rose before symptoms began, with different cell types changing in each.

40488335.mechanism: Reduces inflammation, lowering CD200R expression in brain
40488335.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that IFN-β treatment may decrease CD200R expression by reducing inflammation.
40488335.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, IFN-β treatment reduced disease progression and demyelination and lowered brain CD200R gene expression.

41115040.conclusion_quote: The journal retracts the article "Oral Administration of Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein Attenuates Experimental Autoimmune Encephalomyelitis through Induction of Th2/Treg Cells and Suppression of Th1/Th17 Immune Responses" [...].
41115040.summary: The journal retracted this 2022 study of oral myelin protein treatment in mice with EAE, so its reported findings should not be relied upon.

40561028.mechanism: Not applicable, describes immune cells around nerves
40561028.conclusion_quote: Our findings improve the understanding of how the environments of CSF-interfacing cranial nerves and bone marrow are altered within the skull during neuroinflammatory disease.
40561028.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells around olfactory nerves increased and linked to skull bone marrow, which was also reshaped during disease.

40279778.mechanism: No treatment tested, biomarker timing study
40279778.conclusion_quote: The elevation of multiple proinflammatory cytokines concentrations in the blood of the same EAE mice in the presymptomatic stage suggested that blood biomarkers for neuroinflammation increased before blood biomarkers for neurodegeneration during the disease course in EAE.
40279778.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blood levels of the nerve damage marker NfL rose after symptoms began, while inflammatory cytokines rose earlier, before symptoms appeared.

40498142.mechanism: Modulates cytokines: lowering pro-inflammatory, raising regulatory markers
40498142.conclusion_quote: TLA treatment demonstrated immunomodulatory and neuroprotective effects in EAE mice, suggesting its potential as a prophylactic or therapeutic agent in MS.
40498142.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a Toxoplasma parasite extract reduced symptoms, nerve damage and inflammation while shifting immune signals toward regulation.

40220231.conclusion_quote: In this chapter, we provide protocols for the generation of primary effector memory T cell lines from the Lewis rat against CNS and control antigens and for their transduction with genes of interest.
40220231.summary: This methods chapter describes how to create and genetically label rat T cell lines that target nervous system antigens and can induce experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS.

40537468.mechanism: Dampens inflammation and supports neuronal survival
40537468.conclusion_quote: Together, microglia-derived TGFα is an important mediator of glial-immune crosstalk, highlighting its therapeutic potential in resolving acute CNS inflammation.
40537468.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, intranasal TGFα reduced inflammatory immune cells and protected nerve cells, helping the brain recover from inflammation.

40001462.mechanism: Blocks spermine oxidase, lowering galectin-3 neuroinflammation
40001462.conclusion_quote: This study provides compelling evidence for the potential of SMOX inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in multiple sclerosis and other demyelinating disorders.
40001462.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug blocking the SMOX enzyme preserved optic nerve myelin and nerve fibers, improved retinal function, and reduced inflammation.

41408289.mechanism: Blocks fibrin binding to CD11b/c complement receptors
41408289.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these results support the clinical development of THN391 for neurological diseases and ophthalmic indications.
41408289.summary: A humanized antibody, THN391, blocks fibrin from activating immune receptors and reduced demyelination and clinical signs in mice with EAE.

39940744.conclusion_quote: We confirmed the relationship and correlation between the content of the kynurenine metabolites in the plasma and the tissues of the visceral organs.
39940744.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone to model demyelination, levels of tryptophan breakdown products in blood and organs were measured and found to correlate with each other.

39983262.mechanism: Suppresses microglia activation and Th1/Th17 cell differentiation
39983262.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study demonstrates BTA possessed protective and therapeutic effects by ameliorating disease severity in the chronic EAE and mitigating relapse in the relapsing-remitting EAE, respectively.
39983262.summary: In mice with EAE, a novel compound called BTA reduced disease severity and prevented relapses by calming brain immune cells and blocking harmful T cell activation.

39540912.mechanism: Releases CO, activates Nrf2, dampens inflammatory cytokines
39540912.conclusion_quote: The observed effects support the view that HYCOs are promising candidates to be developed for the treatment of autoimmune and chronic inflammatory disorders.
39540912.summary: In mice with EAE, the HYCO-3 compound calmed immune cells and microglia by reducing inflammatory chemicals and their ability to present antigens to T cells.

40539039.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes microglial gene changes
40539039.conclusion_quote: This study provides a comprehensive microglial gene signature for EAE, highlighting the involvement of TLR pathways and circRNA-mediated regulation in MS pathogenesis.
40539039.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers profiled microglia immune cells and found six upregulated genes and a circular RNA linked to inflammation pathways.

41250830.mechanism: blocks adenosine A2A and A2B receptors
41250830.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, P626 showed efficacy in reducing neurological symptoms and demyelination in an MS model.
41250830.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called P626 that blocks adenosine receptors improved movement and pain signs and protected myelin, the fatty coating of nerves.

40307815.mechanism: loss of normal ATXN1 weakens immune control and nerve protection
40307815.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that ATXN1 plays a protective role in modulating immune responses and maintaining neural integrity during MS.
40307815.summary: In mice with EAE, a mutated human ATXN1 gene or loss of normal Atxn1 worsened nerve damage, inflammation and disability, showing ATXN1 protects against MS like disease.

40490789.mechanism: Engineered stem cells deliver miR181a to boost regulatory cells
40490789.conclusion_quote: This strategy takes advantage of BMSCs and miRNA and thus presents an effective synergistic strategy for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
40490789.summary: In animals with EAE, stem cells engineered to carry miR181a boosted regulatory immune cells and reduced harmful Th17 cells, improving treatment effects.

39729930.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease imaging and histology
39729930.conclusion_quote: The data demonstrate that ex vivo MRI is a valuable tool to assess white matter atrophy in EAE, which was shown to be directly linked to the severity of EAE and spinal cord histopathology.
39729930.summary: Mice with EAE, an animal model of MS, showed spinal cord white matter shrinkage on ex vivo MRI that tracked with disease severity and tissue damage.

40457355.mechanism: Reduces microglia gene transcription and T cell reactivation
40457355.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that microglia are critically involved in EAE disease progression for which BRD4 is essential.
40457355.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Brd4 in CD4 T cells and microglia reduced paralysis, demyelination, and inflammatory cytokines, showing these cells drive neuroinflammation.

40023067.mechanism: Upregulates AXL/SOCS3 and inhibits JAK2/STAT1 signaling
40023067.conclusion_quote: This study elucidates the molecular mechanism underlying Betulin's therapeutic effects in MS, both in vitro and in vivo.
40023067.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the compound Betulin reduced inflammation and disease, and its benefits depended on the AXL protein.

40765420.mechanism: Delivers BDNF to boost oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination
40765420.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that AAV-BDNF therapy enhances remyelination, myelin integrity, mitochondrial structure, and cognitive function in a CPZ model, underscoring its potential for treating MS.
40765420.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a virus delivering BDNF into the brain improved myelin repair and cognitive performance compared with controls.

38775061.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest an important role of ASK1 in glial cells, indicating that ASK1 might be a good therapeutic target for MS.
38775061.summary: Researchers examined post-mortem brain tissue from people with multiple sclerosis and found ASK1 activity in glial cells within active lesions, mostly in astrocytes.

40150860.mechanism: Increases lipid storage, boosts IL-10, tolerogenic T cells
40150860.conclusion_quote: It is showcased that manipulating diets is a potentially efficient and cost-effective approach to prevent and/or ameliorate EAE.
40150860.summary: In mice with EAE, a high-fat, low-carbohydrate diet fully protected against disease by reducing brain inflammation and shifting immune cells toward calmer, anti-inflammatory states.

40555745.mechanism: Blocks GSDME-mediated microglial pyroptosis, improving debris clearance
40555745.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings highlight GSDME-mediated pyroptosis as a key driver of demyelination and neuroinflammation in MS, suggesting novel therapeutic targets for neuroinflammatory disorders.
40555745.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, knocking out the Gsdme gene reduced microglial cell death, myelin loss, motor problems and brain inflammation.

40601171.mechanism: Inhibits MLKL, reducing necroptosis and neuroinflammation
40601171.conclusion_quote: Blocking MLKL plays a therapeutic role in EAE not only through regulating necroptosis via the RIPK3/MLKL pathway but also through regulating neuroinflammation via the NLRP3/caspase-1/GSDMD pathway and the MyD88/NF-κB pathway.
40601171.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug that blocks MLKL reduced symptoms, demyelination, and inflammation while protecting nerve fibers and oligodendrocytes.

40777040.summary: This is a correction notice for an earlier study of the P2X7R antagonist AFC-5128 in mice with EAE, and the abstract reports no new findings.

40275354.mechanism: inhibits STING-NF-κB pathway in microglia, disrupting microglia-Th17 loop
40275354.conclusion_quote: These findings emphasize the importance of interactions and bi-directional activations between microglia and Th17 in the autoimmune neuroinflammation, and provide rationale for further investigation on ACT001 as therapeutic option for autoimmune inflammatory diseases driven by similar mechanisms.
40275354.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug ACT001 blocked a self-reinforcing loop between microglia and Th17 immune cells, which reduced disease severity.

40475249.conclusion_quote: Overall, this study demonstrates the use of CPZ and LPC to model either acute or prolonged demyelination in a sagittal organotypic brain slice culture system.
40475249.summary: Researchers compared two chemicals, cuprizone and lysolecithin, for damaging myelin in rat brain slices grown in culture. Cuprizone caused brief damage with recovery, while lysolecithin caused lasting damage.

40859725.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes osteopontin elevation
40859725.conclusion_quote: In sum, OPN, a pro-inflammatory and immunomodulatory mediator, was elevated in all tissues following EAE induction, resulting in increased blood concentrations.
40859725.summary: Researchers measured osteopontin, a protein that drives inflammation, in mice with EAE and found it raised in the blood and many organs.

40083920.summary: This erratum corrects an earlier study of astrocytic YAP in an EAE model and contains no new experiments.

40333777.summary: This correction notice fixes a figure error in a 2022 study of pomegranate-peel extract in mice with EAE, reporting no new findings.

41383521.mechanism: Antihistamine that boosts myelin repair after demyelination
41383521.conclusion_quote: This approach provides insights into the dynamic processes of demyelination and remyelination, informing the development of more effective interventions for MS.
41383521.summary: In a mouse model of demyelination, clemastine given after myelin loss restored normal thalamocortical brain connectivity, while untreated mice stayed disrupted.

40556753.summary: This is a correction notice for an earlier study of a peptide in mice with EAE, so it reports no new experiments or results.

40476275.summary: This notice retracts a 2013 study on matrine and blood-brain barrier damage in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, so its findings should not be relied on.

40560117.conclusion_quote: These findings reveal the temporal progression of neurodegeneration with a dying-back pattern in EAE and emphasize the importance of early intervention to prevent permanent damage.
40560117.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers tracked how vision nerve fibers and their connections degenerate over time, with visual acuity declining at peak disease.

41624869.mechanism: Targets activated macrophages, reducing IL-1β and immune infiltration
41624869.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings highlight the therapeutic potential of macrophage-targeted PEGylated liposomes in controlling IL-1β-mediated neuroinflammation in MS and potentially other neurodegenerative diseases.
41624869.summary: In mice with EAE, large PEGylated liposomes that target inflammatory macrophages reduced disease signs and spinal cord demyelination when given before or after symptoms began.

40405544.conclusion_quote: We postulate that the inflammatory response of the VNO in EAE is associated with dysfunction of the accessory olfactory system.
40405544.summary: In mice with EAE, the vomeronasal organ that senses odors showed immune cell infiltration and reduced sensory marker staining, suggesting impaired smell processing.

41327438.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, limiting microglia-T cell activation
41327438.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that siponimod dampens compartmentalized CNS inflammation by disrupting detrimental interactions between T cells and microglia through a dual central and peripheral mechanism of action.
41327438.summary: In mice with chronic EAE, treatment with siponimod improved disease severity, reduced demyelination and nerve damage, and calmed brain inflammation by affecting microglia and T cells.

40136663.mechanism: blocks CSF1R signaling, limiting microglial proliferation
40136663.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that blocking early microglial proliferation through selective targeting of CSF1R signaling has a therapeutic effect in EAE by protecting BBB integrity and reducing peripheral immune cell infiltration.
40136663.summary: In rats with EAE, a drug blocking CSF1R reduced microglial growth, protected the blood brain barrier, and limited immune cell entry into the brain.

41006208.mechanism: reduces inflammation-driven senescence in organoid glia
41006208.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that chronic inflammation might accelerate senescence-like processes, potentially contributing to disease progression, and that its modulation might help limit further propagation.
41006208.summary: In human brain tissue and patient-derived organoids, chronic inflammation was linked to senescent-like glial cells, and anti-inflammatory drugs partly reversed inflammation-induced senescence in organoid cells.

40127044.conclusion_quote: The results of this study could help elucidatenovel biomarkers or therapeutic targets for MS.
40127044.summary: Using gene data from stem-cell-derived precursor cells of MS patients, researchers found iron-linked cell death and low-oxygen genes that may serve as possible biomarkers for MS.

40109348.mechanism: enhances AMPA receptor activity through positive allosteric modulation
40109348.conclusion_quote: These results suggest AMPA-PAMs as potential targets of interest for MS treatment beyond immunomodulatory approaches.
40109348.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, the drug PF4778574 reduced clinical disability and myelin loss and increased myelin-forming cells, though it did not reduce microglial activity.

40432752.conclusion_quote: MS HIS mice represent simple and rapid tools for investigating human immunopathology and the efficacy of therapeutics at a personalized level.
40432752.summary: In humanized mice given blood immune cells from MS patients, human T cells formed lesions in brain and spinal cord, mimicking MS features.

40440578.mechanism: Blocks BTK enzyme in microglia and macrophages
40440578.conclusion_quote: Our collective results support the rationale of using brain-penetrant BTK inhibitors to modulate the elevation of this enzyme in microglia/macrophages within inflamed plaques of MS.
40440578.summary: In mice with EAE, the BTK inhibitor fenebrutinib reduced disease severity when given early and only slightly helped once symptoms began.

41562059.mechanism: reduced expression boosts inflammatory genes and T cell activation by dendritic
41562059.conclusion_quote: This dual role highlights Regnase-1 in cDC1 as a critical regulator that balances inflammation and immune memory.
41562059.summary: Reducing the protein Regnase-1 in dendritic cells worsened early inflammation but sped recovery in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

40497405.mechanism: FOXP3 macrophages secrete amphiregulin, promoting oligodendrocyte progenitor dif
40497405.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that FOXP3 + macrophages could serve as a promising therapeutic target in MS.
40497405.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Foxp3 from macrophages showed these cells release amphiregulin to help oligodendrocyte progenitors mature and aid recovery.

40929242.mechanism: Lowers miR-21 and pathogenic Th17 cell development
40929242.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that type I IFN signaling limits central nervous system autoimmunity by inhibiting miR-21-mediated pathogenic T H 17 development.
40929242.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, interferon beta reduced microRNA-21 and harmful Th17 immune cells, which helped limit the autoimmune attack on the nervous system.

40294777.mechanism: Reduces inflammation via TNF-α/NF-ĸB/NLRP3 and kynurenine pathway
40294777.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, EDV exerted neuroprotective effects by reducing inflammation, inhibiting the KP's neurotoxic metabolites, and promoting remyelination through OLIG2 activation.
40294777.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced demyelination, edaravone reduced inflammation and harmful kynurenine metabolites while promoting myelin repair and improving motor function.

39972304.mechanism: Nedd4 ubiquitinates RORγt, boosting Th17 cell activity
39972304.conclusion_quote: Nedd4 is a crucial E3 ubiquitin ligase for RORγt in the regulating Th17 cell development and offers potential therapeutic benefits for treating Th17-mediated autoimmune diseases.
39972304.summary: Mice lacking Nedd4 in their T cells had fewer Th17 inflammatory cells and milder EAE, a mouse model of MS, showing Nedd4 helps drive autoimmune attacks.

41027274.mechanism: modulates cytokines to reduce neuroinflammation and demyelination
41027274.conclusion_quote: These findings highlight the neuroprotective and immunomodulatory effects of Siparuna brasiliensis protease inhibitors, suggesting their potential as therapeutic agents for autoimmune diseases.
41027274.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, oral plant protease inhibitors from Siparuna brasiliensis leaves reduced disease scores, inflammation, and demyelination.

40455336.mechanism: Boosts antioxidant enzymes and favors Bcl-2 over Bax
40455336.conclusion_quote: Saffron exhibits protective effects against MS-induced testicular damage by enhancing antioxidant defenses and modulating apoptosis-related gene expression.
40455336.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced MS, saffron protected testicles from damage by boosting antioxidant enzymes and balancing cell survival genes.

41226761.mechanism: No treatment tested, natural genetic variation compared
41226761.conclusion_quote: These findings identify novel genetic targets and demonstrate the utility of genetically diverse models for uncovering complex neuroimmune interactions.
41226761.summary: In Collaborative Cross mice infected with Theiler's virus, two strains developed myelin loss and nerve damage, likely from several combined genetic risk variants.

40131948.mechanism: Blocks TREM2 receptor on microglia, reducing MAFB-high microglia
40131948.conclusion_quote: We conclude that TREM2 is essential for maintaining a population of MAFB-high microglia that is associated with myelin repair.
40131948.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, blocking TREM2 with an antibody depleted repair-linked microglia and impaired remyelination, and MAFB-positive microglia were found in active MS lesions.

39424593.mechanism: Boosts oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and mitochondrial activity
39424593.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that puerarin promotes oligodendrocyte lineage progression and myelin repair, with a potential to be developed into therapeutic agent for neurological diseases associated with myelin damage.
39424593.summary: In mice with lysolecithin induced spinal cord demyelination, and in human stem cell and rat cultures, the natural compound puerarin increased new oligodendrocytes and enhanced myelin repair.

40606779.conclusion_quote: 6J substrain presented a more severe EAE than the 6N substrain, accompanied by an increase in the frequency of macrophages, CD8 + , and B cells within the infiltrated immune cells compartment.
40606779.summary: Mice from two C57BL/6 substrains were compared in an EAE model. The 6J substrain developed more severe disease with more immune cells and different gut microbes than 6N.

41067409.mechanism: Neurosteroid restores hormone balance and lowers inflammatory cytokines
41067409.conclusion_quote: AP played neuroprotective effects in relieving EAE-induced depression-like behaviors.
41067409.summary: In female rats with EAE, a model of MS, the hormone allopregnanolone eased depression symptoms and reduced brain inflammation.

41251049.mechanism: activates GLP-1 receptor, reduces splenic Th1 cells
41251049.conclusion_quote: The present preliminary findings demonstrate that liraglutide alleviates EAE severity, probably through peripheral immunomodulatory effects of splenic T helper cells.
41251049.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the diabetes drug liraglutide reduced disease severity and lowered splenic Th1 immune cells, while Treg levels did not change.

40750890.mechanism: Switches microglia to reparative state, aiding myelin cleanup
40750890.conclusion_quote: By highlighting the importance of microglia in promoting myelin regeneration, our study proved DHA as a promising candidate for promoting remyelination.
40750890.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, dihydroartemisinin helped microglia support myelin repair and improved recovery of nerve-related function.

40486123.mechanism: rebalances Th17/Treg cells via omega-3 fatty acid metabolism
40486123.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that SJP is a viable treatment option for MS, and traditional Chinese medicine therapies for autoimmune diseases will continue to be developed.
40486123.summary: In mice with EAE, a traditional Chinese herbal formula reduced disease symptoms and tissue damage by restoring immune balance and altering fatty acid processing.

41154518.mechanism: Regulates lipid metabolism via Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK signaling pathway
41154518.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, 0.1% soybean lysolecithin is recommended as the optimal dietary level for L. vannamei , supporting its feasibility as a substitute for 2% soybean lecithin in shrimp feed.
41154518.summary: Shrimp were fed diets containing 0 to 2% soybean lysolecithin, and 0.1% gave the best growth and fat digestion. This is not an MS or demyelination study.

41001930.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors to trap lymphocytes
41001930.conclusion_quote: The new EAE variant is suitable for use in preclinical assessment of candidate therapeutics and the identification of targetable molecular mechanisms underpinning disease development and progression.
41001930.summary: In animals with a milder EAE model of MS, fingolimod showed benefit when given early after symptoms began, giving researchers a longer window to test drugs.

40137979.mechanism: Loss of IRF5 impairs microglial lipid clearance
40137979.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our study identified the antiviral transcription factor IRF5 as a key transcriptional regulator of lipid degradation and cholesterol homeostasis and suggest that loss of IRF5 function leads to pathogenic lipid accumulation in microglia, thereby obstructing remyelination.
40137979.summary: In mice with EAE, lacking the Irf5 gene worsened damage and caused lipid buildup in microglia that hindered myelin repair.

41174786.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes cell-autonomous microglial activation
41174786.conclusion_quote: Together, our results provide evidence of putative cell-autonomous microglial activation in pwMS and identify transcriptomic and functional changes that recapitulate the phenotypes observed in vivo in microglia from pwMS.
41174786.summary: Using microglia grown from stem cells of people with multiple sclerosis, researchers found these cells show inherent overactive immune behavior, including more inflammation and phagocytosis.

40729017.mechanism: Triggers G-protein signaling, altering nutrient transport genes
40729017.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the data on intestinal cell viability, gene expression, and metabolite abundance seem to reveal the bioactivities of lysolecithin.
40729017.summary: In Caco-2 intestinal cells, a soybean lysolecithin product improved cell viability and altered gene expression and nutrient levels, suggesting bioactive signaling effects.

40691985.mechanism: Overexpresses endothelial integrin to test blood-brain barrier stabilization
40691985.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate that while β4-EC-KI mice show strong constitutive expression of endothelial β4 integrin, this had no discernible impact on blood-brain barrier integrity or the pathogenesis of EAE.
40691985.summary: In knock-in mice that overexpress endothelial β4 integrin, the change did not affect blood-brain barrier leakage or disease course in mice with EAE.

40722279.mechanism: Exercise counteracts cuprizone-induced glial cell changes
40722279.conclusion_quote: They evidenced the potential neuroprotective effect of regular physical exercise, suggesting that this non-pharmacological intervention could benefit patients with central demyelination-dependent diseases.
40722279.summary: In rats given cuprizone to demyelinate their brains, treadmill exercise counteracted some glial cell changes and altered brain electrical spreading, suggesting a protective effect.

41183892.mechanism: siRNA silences neogenin, reducing CD4 T-cell activation
41183892.conclusion_quote: The present study suggests that neogenin is a target molecule for EAE gene therapy and LNPsiNeo may be suitable for the MS treatment.
41183892.summary: Lipid nanoparticles carrying siRNA that silences the neogenin gene reduced CD4 T cells and eased symptoms in mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model.

41405997.mechanism: Mutation blocks RORγt lipid binding, reducing Th17 cells
41405997.conclusion_quote: Thus, RORγt alanine-304 in the LBD is indispensable for generating γδT17 and conventional Th17 cells and for the suppression of the Th1-like Th17 pathogenic population, which decouples the pathogenicity of skin and CNS autoimmune diseases.
41405997.summary: In mice with a single amino acid change in RORγt, skin psoriasis improved but experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a mouse model of MS, did not improve.

40864683.mechanism: Blocks S1PR2 receptor, limiting B cell egress
40864683.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that T fr cells contribute to autoimmune encephalomyelitis and suggest that their blood frequency reflects MS activity.
40864683.summary: In mice with EAE, removing follicular regulatory T cells reduced disease, and blocking the S1PR2 receptor reversed this benefit by letting more B cells enter the brain.

41133642.mechanism: Removing STING worsens demyelination by reducing interferon responses
41133642.conclusion_quote: STING signaling limits lesion severity in focal EAE by promoting IFN responses and regulating immune infiltration.
41133642.summary: In mice with focal EAE, lacking the STING immune sensor led to larger demyelinated lesions, lower interferon gene activity, and altered immune cell infiltration.

40701030.mechanism: Reduces Th17 cells, pDC and IFN-alpha, boosts Tregs
40701030.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrated that CQ treatment inhibits the development of EAE disease on one hand by enhancing the expansion of Treg in dLN and spleen, and on the other hand by inhibiting the accumulation of pDC and their IFN-α expression in the spleen and bone marrow.
40701030.summary: Chloroquine given to mice with EAE reduced disease severity by lowering inflammatory Th17 cells and plasmacytoid dendritic cells while increasing regulatory T cells.

41196500.mechanism: Not applicable, describes lineage tracing methods
41196500.conclusion_quote: This integrated methodology enables robust, reproducible assessment of glial proliferation, migration, and morphological plasticity in central nervous system lesions, offering novel insights into their roles in repair, inflammation, and demyelination.
41196500.summary: In mice with EAE and brain injury, a detailed method traces glial cell clones and measures their shape and spread to study repair and inflammation.

40209697.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the repercussions of thyroid hormone impairment in utero at adult ages while dissecting on the pathogenesis of EAE in terms of Th1/Th17 balance from an innate immune perspective.
40209697.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, maternal low thyroid hormone during pregnancy changed the adult offspring's immune cell balance before disease symptoms appeared.

40264649.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease effect only
40264649.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data highlight important similarities between MS in humans and EAE in mice with regards to skeletal muscle contractile impairments, and provide first evidence for a non-invasive in-vivo setup that will enable the preclinical profiling of novel drug candidates directed at specifically improving muscle function in MS.
40264649.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, showed about 28 percent weaker muscle force than healthy mice, supporting a noninvasive test for future muscle drug studies.

41378229.mechanism: improves rumen microbial community and fermentation in calves
41378229.conclusion_quote: In summary, dietary lysolecithin supplementation could positively influence the rumen microbial community, enhance rumen fermentation, and improve antioxidant ability, without affecting growth performance in Holstein calves.
41378229.summary: In Holstein calves, not an MS model, dietary lysolecithin improved rumen fermentation and antioxidant status without affecting growth.

40052890.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest a potential role of circSnx5 in autoimmune neuroinflammation.
40052890.summary: This study measured circSnx5, a circular RNA, in mice with EAE and in T cells, finding its levels rise in inflamed spinal cords but fall when T cells activate.

40397576.mechanism: deletes a regulatory DNA element in Th17 cells
40397576.conclusion_quote: Here, we present a protocol for CRISPR-mediated deletion of a CRE in murine Th17 cells for in vivo assessment of effector function in EAE.
40397576.summary: A protocol for using CRISPR gene editing to delete a regulatory DNA element in immune Th17 cells, then testing their effects in mice with EAE.

41463369.mechanism: Activates antioxidant defenses and reduces oxidative stress
41463369.conclusion_quote: TMS is effective in the treatment of MS, but its role could be enhanced, using hormone replacement therapy with estrogens and/or progesterone.
41463369.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, magnetic stimulation reduced oxidative stress, and estrogen or progesterone added to it further boosted antioxidant defenses and clinical signs in ovariectomized rats.

41229423.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal that cuprizone-induced intestinal dysfunctions temporally parallel central nervous system (CNS) lesion dynamics, disclosing temporal coordination of both compartments and highlighting gut-brain axis impact on both disease stages.
41229423.summary: In mice given cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin and lets it regrow, gut lining and microbe changes tracked brain demyelination and repair over time.

39046528.mechanism: Iron chelation promotes oligodendrogenesis and reduces gliosis
39046528.conclusion_quote: these results raise the possibility of using deferiprone as a therapeutic agent for remyelination therapy in MS.
39046528.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced optic nerve demyelination, deferiprone enhanced myelin repair, increased new oligodendrocytes, and improved nerve signal and behavioral recovery.

40494891.mechanism: Removes HIF-1α in myeloid cells, reducing inflammasome activity
40494891.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicated that hypoxia modulates inflammasome activation in response to periodontitis-related bacterial infections, contributing to the progression of autoimmune diseases.
40494891.summary: In mice with an MS model and Porphyromonas gingivalis infection, removing HIF-1α from myeloid cells reduced inflammation and reversed neurological symptoms.

40090080.mechanism: Malat1 sponges miR-124-3p, raising SGK1 to drive microglia activation
40090080.conclusion_quote: This study elucidates Malat1's role in MS, offering critical insights for developing future therapeutic strategies.
40090080.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blocking the Malat1 gene reduced microglia activation and nerve cell death, while boosting Malat1 worsened these effects.

39726165.mechanism: Dampens T cell activity, favors regulatory T cells
39726165.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that Crocin exerts therapeutic effects in EAE by modulating neuroinflammation and immune responses.
39726165.summary: In female mice with EAE, a model of MS, the saffron compound crocin reduced disease severity, inflammation and myelin damage while calming harmful immune cells.

39730017.mechanism: Inhibits glial NLRP3 inflammasome, reducing pyroptosis
39730017.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results suggest that FTS·B treatment attenuates central neuroinflammation and pyroptosis by inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome of glial cells in EAE mice.
39730017.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the natural compound forsythoside B reduced spinal cord inflammation and demyelination by calming the NLRP3 inflammasome in glial cells.

40653076.mechanism: Activates TGR5 receptor to regulate microglia
40653076.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings suggest that UDCA has potential applications as a novel therapeutic agent for MS.
40653076.summary: In mice with a multiple sclerosis model, ursodeoxycholic acid reduced disease scores and spinal cord damage by calming microglia through the TGR5 receptor.

41043415.mechanism: Stabilizes Treg cells, preventing Th17 conversion
41043415.conclusion_quote: Our studies thus identify altered Treg cell population dynamics as a fundamental pathogenic mechanism in autoimmune neuroinflammation.
41043415.summary: Deleting Notch3 from regulatory T cells prevented disease onset in mice with EAE by keeping these cells stable and blocking harmful immune cells.

41126242.mechanism: Loss raises MHC-II on myeloid cells, boosting T-cell activation
41126242.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings suggest that ZNRF1 in peripheral myeloid cells plays a suppressive role in neuroinflammation by regulating MHC-II surface expression, thereby controlling antigen-specific T-cell proliferation and activation.
41126242.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ZNRF1 gene from immune myeloid cells worsened disease severity, inflammation and demyelination by increasing T cell activation.

40810312.conclusion_quote: The findings presented in this paper reflect that exposure to bovine casein can result in axolysis in the myenteric plexus possibly as a result of molecular mimicry and antibody cross-reactivity between casein and antigen(s) expressed by the ENS.
40810312.summary: In mice with neuroinflammation, feeding or immunizing with bovine milk casein damaged nerves in the gut, likely because immune cells and antibodies attacked gut nerve cells.

40885740.mechanism: Alters mitochondrial metabolism, increasing oligodendrocyte myelin production
40885740.conclusion_quote: Metformin's brain effect is thus not cell-specific, alters metabolism in part through mitochondrial changes and leads to more myelin production.
40885740.summary: In human stem-cell brain models, mouse chimera models, and cells from people with MS, metformin increased myelin production and boosted mitochondrial activity.

39716594.mechanism: Not applicable, induces demyelination via copper chelation
39716594.conclusion_quote: In summary, we demonstrate that titration of cuprizone is a reliable approach to induce acute demyelination in the mouse forebrain.
39716594.summary: In mice, researchers compared two cuprizone diet protocols and found that gradually reducing the dose reliably caused acute brain demyelination, with similar damage in both groups.

41226630.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the systemic administration of PrC-210 may offer a safe, effective MS treatment when started at symptom onset.
41226630.summary: In mice with EAE, the antioxidant PrC-210 reduced paralysis severity by up to 62 percent and preserved spinal cord tissue, with no toxicity at effective doses.

39802026.conclusion_quote: Our study provides valuable insights into the dynamics and structure of this protein, which can aid in further understanding its biological functions and potential implications for disease.
39802026.summary: Computer simulations of normal and mutant PSMB8 protein, with no animal or human cell model, showed the G210V mutant is more flexible and less stable.

39675488.mechanism: Shifts gut microbiota and metabolites, restoring Th17/Treg balance
39675488.conclusion_quote: In summary, our study demonstrated that APS exerts a suppressive effect on EAE by regulating gut microbiota composition, affecting metabolite composition, and improving the Th17/Treg balance in the peripheral blood and CNS.
39675488.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, Astragalus polysaccharide reduced inflammation and rebalanced immune cells by altering gut microbiota and metabolites.

39674307.mechanism: Blocks myeloperoxidase, lowering oxidative stress and microglia activity
39674307.conclusion_quote: Data suggest that microglia suppression is not sufficient to prevent disease evolution, corroborating the hypothesis that immune-independent components drive neurodegeneration in progressive MS.
39674307.summary: In NOD mice with progressive MS, the MPO inhibitor verdiperstat reduced spinal cord microglia activity but did not slow disease progression or improve survival.

39616773.mechanism: suppresses Rac1, inflammation and oxidative stress in spinal cord
39616773.conclusion_quote: In summary, regular physical exercise may modulate neuropathic pain through inhibition of dendritic spine dysgenesis, inflammation and oxidative stress in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord.
39616773.summary: Strength training reduced pain behaviors, spinal inflammation and nerve connection damage, and improved movement in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

39726027.mechanism: ubiquitinates and degrades Fas, reducing Th17 cell differentiation
39726027.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these data demonstrate that CBL and Cbl-b can synergistically regulate Fas to inhibit Th17 cell differentiation, thereby alleviating spinal cord nerve injury in the EAE model.
39726027.summary: In mice with EAE, overexpressing the CBL and Cbl-b genes reduced Fas protein, Th17 immune cells, and spinal cord nerve damage.

40389044.mechanism: Blocks STAT4 and TGF-β1 signaling, reducing Th1/Th17 cells
40389044.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that Sora may be a potential treatment for autoimmune diseases.
40389044.summary: In mice with EAE, the cancer drug sorafenib reduced inflammatory T cells and increased protective Treg cells, protecting the mice from disease.

interventions: total sesterterpenoid extract of Leucosceptrum canum
40712011.mechanism: binds GAPDH, reducing glycolysis and AKT activation
40712011.conclusion_quote: This study underscores leu-F as a promising lead compound for autoimmune disease treatment and provides a compelling example of drug discovery inspired by chemical ecology.
40712011.summary: In mice with EAE and psoriasis, a plant compound called leucosceptrine F calmed immune responses and eased disease, suggesting a possible new autoimmune treatment.

40928249.conclusion_quote: BCV and TMEV L proteins use a combination of two independent SLiMs to hijack cellular kinases and retarget those kinases toward the nuclear pore complex.
40928249.summary: This virology study found that viral leader proteins from cardioviruses use two short protein motifs to redirect host kinases to the nuclear pore, and it does not model multiple sclerosis.

40540585.mechanism: Deletion causes DNA damage and cell cycle arrest
40540585.conclusion_quote: Thus, CLNS1A plays an important role in CD4 T cells by promoting genome stability and cell cycle progression.
40540585.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting Clns1a from T cells damaged DNA, halted cell division, and protected mice from disease.

40778495.mechanism: Knockout shifts cytokines toward IL-4, reducing inflammatory IL-17A
40778495.conclusion_quote: The overall shift to reduced disease severity highlights the multi-faceted role of TAM receptor signaling in inflammatory demyelination.
40778495.summary: In mice with EAE, genetically deleting the Gas6 or Tyro3 gene reduced disease severity, with changes in protective IL-4 and harmful IL-17A levels.

39926210.mechanism: Restores oligodendrocyte generation, reduces astrogliosis and microgliosis
39926210.conclusion_quote: These results provide evidence that melatonin abolishes destructive cuprizone effects in the mouse corpus callosum by restoring oligodendrocyte generation, remyelination, and decreasing astrogliosis and microgliosis.
39926210.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, melatonin injections prevented demyelination, restored oligodendrocytes, and reduced reactive astrocytes and microglia in the corpus callosum.

40744406.mechanism: Binds inhibitory CSPGs, freeing oligodendrocyte progenitor differentiation
40744406.conclusion_quote: Thus, LMWP supports remyelination as well as neuroprotection resulting in a promising strategy for the treatment of demyelinating disease, such as MS.
40744406.summary: In mice with toxin-induced demyelination and EAE, a small protamine peptide overcame inhibitory CSPG signals, boosting myelin repair, reducing nerve damage and easing disease.

41061045.conclusion_quote: Together, these results demonstrate profound systemic immune cell alterations in MOGAD and contribute to a better understanding of this distinct disease entity.
41061045.summary: Single cell analysis of blood immune cells in people with MOGAD found widespread changes, including fewer CXCR3 positive memory T cells, also seen in a mouse model.

40702356.mechanism: Notch2 deletion weakens regulatory cell ability to reverse symptoms
40702356.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that Notch2 expression in dysfunctional CD4 + T cells plays a crucial role in immune regulation.
40702356.summary: In mice with EAE, removing Notch2 from Foxp3-expressing immune cells weakened their ability to reverse disease symptoms, showing Notch2 helps calm harmful immune responses.

interventions: targeted depletion of brain-localized B cells
40669468.mechanism: removes brain-border autoreactive B cells, reducing neuroinflammation
40669468.conclusion_quote: These findings establish brain-localized autoreactive B cells as crucial initiators of neuroinflammation and promising therapeutic targets in relapsing MS.
40669468.summary: In mice with passive EAE, removing B cells located in the brain lining reduced relapses, showing these cells drive relapsing neuroinflammation.

interventions: CLEC12A-deficient (CLEC12A -/- ) and wild type C57BL/6 mice
41214106.mechanism: removes inhibitory receptor, boosting T-cell and cytokine responses
41214106.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, CLEC12A signaling in C57BL/6 mice contributes to suppressive immune modulation, delaying viral elimination and exacerbating brain damage during acute neurotropic virus infection.
41214106.summary: In mice infected with a neurotropic virus, deleting the immune receptor CLEC12A boosted antiviral T cell responses, cleared virus faster, and reduced hippocampal brain damage.

40873150.mechanism: Activates TR-beta, promotes Th17 cells via lipogenesis
40873150.conclusion_quote: In summary, our results demonstrate that TR-β signaling controls pathogenic Th cell function and autoimmunity.
40873150.summary: In mice with EAE, a thyroid hormone receptor beta agonist boosted harmful Th17 immune cells, while blocking this receptor reduced disease severity in passive EAE.

39661921.conclusion_quote: Our work identifies the recruitment of CX3CR1+ cells to the ON as an early sign of disease underlining the importance of combined structural and functional retinal imaging for the spatiotemporal characterization of neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative processes.
39661921.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, retinal imaging showed immune cells gathering near the optic nerve one week after induction, before clinical signs appeared.

40216817.mechanism: Myeloid C3 loss curbs reactive glia and oxidative stress
40216817.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that in addition to C3b opsonization of post synaptic proteins leading to neuronal demise, C3 activation is a contributor to reactive glia in the optic nerve.
40216817.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting C3 only in myeloid immune cells reduced optic nerve axon injury and retinal nerve cell stress, though it did not prevent synapse protein loss.

40563324.mechanism: Not applicable, descriptive study without a tested treatment
40563324.conclusion_quote: These findings provide insights into myelin repair mechanisms and highlight potential therapeutic targets for treating demyelinating diseases.
40563324.summary: In mice given cuprizone to strip myelin, researchers tracked glial cells, blood brain barrier leakage and inflammation during damage and recovery, revealing changes linked to repair.

39613526.mechanism: Neutralizes RGMa, restoring neurogenesis and cholinergic innervation
39613526.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that RGMa plays a pivotal role in VaD pathology within the hippocampus and propose the anti-RGMa antibody as a promising therapeutic avenue for treating VaD.
39613526.summary: In mice with vascular dementia caused by carotid artery narrowing, an antibody that blocks RGMa reversed brain changes and memory problems.

40842987.mechanism: Myeloid CUL5 loss shifts macrophages toward anti-inflammatory state
40842987.conclusion_quote: These findings identify CUL5 as an unanticipated pro-inflammatory mediator during neuroinflammation and reveal its potential as a therapeutic target for autoimmune diseases.
40842987.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CUL5 gene from myeloid immune cells reduced inflammation in the brain and spinal cord and slowed disease progression.

38829509.mechanism: Loss of Ido2 lowers kynurenine and AhR activity
38829509.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that Ido2 has an important role in preventing demyelination through AhR.
38829509.summary: In a mouse model of chronic demyelination, removing the Ido2 enzyme worsened movement problems and myelin loss, likely by lowering kynurenine signaling.

40101713.mechanism: Promotes regulatory T cells, dampens Th17 cell differentiation
40101713.conclusion_quote: Our data highlight the key role of immune regulatory BAMs for the prevention of central nervous system (CNS) autoimmunity.
40101713.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, giving bile acids DCA and LCA prevented disease by calming immune cells that attack the nervous system.

41313522.conclusion_quote: NLRC5 may regulate microglial PANoptosis through epigenetic and proteomic mechanisms, linking inflammatory cell death to MS progression.
41313522.summary: Researchers combined genetic data with mouse EAE microglia and LPS-stimulated BV2 cells, suggesting NLRC5 drives microglial inflammatory cell death in MS.

41091915.mechanism: Deleting Kdm6a removes histone demethylase activity in microglia
41091915.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that KDM6A might contribute to sex differences in susceptibility to MS.
41091915.summary: Deleting the Kdm6a gene in microglia, the brain's immune cells, reduced disease and reversed inflammatory changes in female mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

41083005.mechanism: delivers MOG antigen inducing Tregs and T-cell anergy
41083005.conclusion_quote: Hence, autoantigens, such as MOG peptide, can be remote loaded into PLGA NPs from an aqueous solution at high loading and encapsulation efficiency for long-term controlled release.
41083005.summary: In mice with EAE, a single dose of nanoparticles carrying MOG peptide prevented and reversed disease and induced lasting tolerance to re-challenge.

41126823.mechanism: Eliminates senescent cells by disrupting anti-apoptotic pathways
41126823.conclusion_quote: Senolytic therapy represents a promising geroscience-based strategy to meet the urgent therapeutic need in progressive MS.
41126823.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, middle aged mice given senolytic drugs dasatinib plus quercetin or navitoclax had better symptoms and survival.

40279405.conclusion_quote: Our study reveals that extensive T-B cell cooperation occurs in meningeal eLFs, promoting both B cell differentiation and T cell reactivation, and may thereby propagate smoldering inflammation in the CNS.
40279405.summary: In mice with EAE, immune cells in the meninges form structures where T and B cells interact, reactivating T cells and sustaining inflammation.

39862347.mechanism: deleting zinc importer causes T cell apoptosis
39862347.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings provide new mechanistic insights and potential targets for the development of new therapeutic strategies for the treatment and/or prevention of T cell-mediated autoimmune diseases.
39862347.summary: In mice lacking the zinc transporter SLC39A10 in T cells, disease was reduced in experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis and bowel inflammation models, as the T cells died off.

40253767.mechanism: Binds NLRP3, blocking inflammasome assembly and IL-1β release
40253767.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we demonstrated that broxyquinoline directly targets the NLRP3 protein to suppress the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome and provide a promising therapeutic agent for NLRP3 inflammasome-associated diseases.
40253767.summary: In mice with EAE, an animal model of multiple sclerosis, the drug broxyquinoline blocked the NLRP3 inflammasome and reduced disease progression.

41304740.mechanism: Tim receptor agonism expands regulatory T cells
