38067113.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study sheds light on the intricate relationship between retinal vascular alterations and the progression of optic neuritis as well as MS clinical score.
38067113.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, showed reduced retinal blood flow, lower vessel density, more stuck immune cells in retinal vessels, and nerve cell loss.

38069420.mechanism: Deleting TRPV4 channel increases microglial phagocytosis in vitro
38069420.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings indicate that TRPV4 modulates microglial activity but does not impact disease activity in mouse models of MS, suggesting a muted and/or redundant role in MS pathogenesis.
38069420.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the TRPV4 channel from microglia or the whole body increased cell clean-up in lab dishes but did not change disease or myelin damage.

37685956.mechanism: blocks NMDA receptors, restores glutamine and GABA transport
37685956.conclusion_quote: Memantine appears to partially regulate the disturbed relationships between Gln, Glu, and GABA.
37685956.summary: Memantine, an NMDA receptor blocker, partly restored the disturbed balance of glutamine and GABA in rats with EAE, a model of MS.

37526817.conclusion_quote: Thus, the RR-EAE model mimics the neuroinflammatory and behavioural features of the RRMS, including depression- and anxiety-like symptoms.
37526817.summary: In mice with a relapsing model of MS, researchers saw brain inflammation along with anxiety and depression behaviour, supporting the model as a realistic match for human disease.

37369312.mechanism: Inhibits T-cell activation and Th17 cell differentiation
37369312.conclusion_quote: Our studies not only provide new insights into the mechanisms by which BTN2A2-Ig affects T cells, but also have the potential to provide a new strategy to treat MS and other autoimmune diseases.
37369312.summary: In mice with EAE, a recombinant BTN2A2-Ig fusion protein given after disease onset reduced T-cell activation and blocked development of pathogenic Th17 cells, lessening disease.

36907120.mechanism: Diet-induced obesity disrupts blood-brain barrier, allowing immune cell infiltra
36907120.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results indicate that OIR promotes BBB disruption, allowing the infiltration of monocytes/macrophages and activation of resident microglia, ultimately promoting CNS inflammation and exacerbation of EAE.
36907120.summary: Mice fed a high-fat diet developed worse EAE than chow-fed mice, with blood-brain barrier leakage and more inflammatory immune cells in the spinal cord.

37075071.mechanism: Localized IL-4 and dexamethasone make monocytes anti-inflammatory
37075071.conclusion_quote: The use of backpack-laden monocytes offers an antigen-free, biomaterial-based approach to precisely tune cell phenotype in vivo, demonstrating the utility of myeloid cells as a therapeutic modality and target.
37075071.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, monocytes carrying microparticles that release anti-inflammatory signals calmed inflammation and improved motor function.

37292191.conclusion_quote: Though further studies are needed to reveal the underlying pathomechanisms following TMEV infection in OT mice, findings indicate an immunopathological process as a main contributor to clinical disease in OT-II mice, while a direct virus-associated pathology may be the main contributor to clinical disease in TMEV-infected OT-I mice.
37292191.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, lacking either CD8 or CD4 T cells specific to ovalbumin changed disease severity and virus persistence in different ways.

38091947.conclusion_quote: In this issue of Immunity, Peng et al. elucidate a female-biased increase in intestinal dopamine signaling that diminishes protective Lactobacillus and exacerbates inflammation in a mouse model of multiple sclerosis.
38091947.summary: In mice with a multiple sclerosis model, gut dopamine signaling is higher in females, which reduces helpful Lactobacillus bacteria and worsens inflammation.

36979924.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes metabolite changes
36979924.conclusion_quote: Thus, the KYN metabolite profile potentially serves as a biomarker of progressive MS and thus opens a new path toward planning personalized treatment, which is frequently obscured with immunologic components in MS deterioration.
36979924.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, levels of tryptophan breakdown chemicals fell in blood and brain, suggesting these chemicals could serve as markers of progressive MS.

35368059.mechanism: Ultrasound stimulation promotes remyelination and reduces demyelinated lesion si
35368059.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that MTR was a sensitive and reproducible quantitative marker to assess remyelination process in vivo during TUS treatment.
35368059.summary: In rats with lysolecithin-induced demyelination in the hippocampus, daily head ultrasound stimulation helped myelin recover, as shown by MRI and staining.

37243699.conclusion_quote: In summary, our data point to M-MDSC load as a factor to be considered for future studies focused on the prediction of disease severity in EAE and MS.
37243699.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patients, blood and brain immune cells called M-MDSCs tracked disease severity, with higher levels linked to milder course.

37041122.conclusion_quote: Intra- and inter-day assay experiments proved that the proposed ELISA methodology is accurate and reliable and could be used in the following applications: (i) to identify the peptide (antigen) while it is conjugated to mannan and (ii) to adequately address the alterations that the MOG 35-55 peptide may undergo when it is bound to mannan during production and stability studies.
37041122.summary: A laboratory test was developed to measure a myelin peptide attached to mannan, a sugar carrier, for drug production and stability checks. No animals or patient cells were used.

37014442.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that CD34 + SCs/TCs are abundant and may play a contributing role in modulating the immune response, recruiting macrophages and proliferation of haematopoietic and pluripotent stem cells following injury to promote tissue repair and regeneration in EAE mouse spleens.
37014442.summary: Researchers found more CD34 positive support cells in the spleens of mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, which may help immune responses and tissue repair.

37219933.conclusion_quote: Our findings highlight a potential therapeutic role of modulation of astrocyte phenotypes, generating a neuroprotective milieu.
37219933.summary: Researchers grew brain cells from stem cells of MS patients and found astrocytes from benign MS protected nearby neurons from inflammatory damage better than progressive MS astrocytes.

36966295.mechanism: AhR drives microglial myelin debris clearance via SYK
36966295.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our study highlights an essential role for AhR in microglial phagocytic function and suggests the therapeutic potential of AhR in demyelinating diseases.
36966295.summary: In mice given cuprizone to demyelinate the brain, deleting AhR from microglia impaired myelin debris clearance and slowed remyelination.

37788283.summary: This is a correction notice for a mouse study of fingolimod in EAE, not an original study with new results.

37323584.mechanism: electrical stimulation reduces delayed visual pathway signal timing
37323584.conclusion_quote: Results underline the importance of analyzing all VEP components for a complete overview of the neurophysiological visual pathway dysfunction and treatment efficacy.
37323584.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, analyzing all visual evoked potential waveform components detected visual pathway dysfunction earlier, and electrical neurostimulation shortened the delayed P2 response.

37895826.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota, antioxidant activity, omega-3 fatty acids
37895826.conclusion_quote: Because of its propensity to promote microbiota alterations, its antioxidant activity, and its content of -3 fatty acids, Palmaria p. could be a promising option for MS patients and could be beneficial as a potential probiotic for the at-risk groups as a preventive measure against MS.
37895826.summary: In mice given a cuprizone diet to mimic MS damage, a seaweed extract from Palmaria palmata improved gut bacteria, protected grip strength, and preserved brain tissue structure.

37414380.conclusion_quote: Our analysis suggests that the ASDC might be involved in the pathogenesis of CNS autoimmunity.
37414380.summary: Researchers found more AXL+ SIGLEC6+ dendritic cells in spinal fluid and brain tissue of people with inflammatory demyelinating disease, and in mice with EAE during acute attacks.

36835129.conclusion_quote: Taken together, nimodipine seems to have different positive effects on OPCs and mature oligodendrocytes.
36835129.summary: In mouse oligodendrocyte cells and zebrafish, nimodipine did not change myelin gene expression but increased the number of mature oligodendrocytes in zebrafish.

36634800.conclusion_quote: Early inflammatory processes led to altered GAG metabolism in early EAE stages and subsequent partially reversible changes in CS-4S and in HA.
36634800.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, brain inflammation altered sugar-chain molecules and their gene activity, lowering CS-4S and raising hyaluronic acid, with partial recovery during remission.

37143680.mechanism: blocks α4β7 integrin, reducing Th17 cell entry
37143680.conclusion_quote: Finally, therapeutic inhibition of α4β7 integrin at disease onset by intrathecal injection of a blocking antibody attenuated clinical severity and reduced neuroinflammation, further demonstrating a crucial role for α4β7 integrin in driving Th17 cell-mediated disease pathogenesis.
37143680.summary: In mice with EAE, a blocking antibody against α4β7 integrin, given into the spinal fluid at disease onset, reduced immune cell entry, inflammation, and symptom severity.

36450174.conclusion_quote: As a result, we have concluded that PDGFRB+ perivascular cells may be participating in lesion progression and as well as demonstrating different responses in different EAE models.
36450174.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that PDGFRB positive cells around blood vessels build up with scarring and rise as disease severity worsens.

36717913.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes chemokine profile in CSF
36717913.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that multiple cytokines and chemokines are involved in the pathophysiology of MP4-induced EAE.
36717913.summary: In mice with MP4-induced EAE, researchers found that cerebrospinal fluid chemokine levels rose with B cell clusters in the brain, suggesting a marker for them.

36702320.conclusion_quote: We provide here the first evidence that axonal-restricted derangement of mitochondrial homeostasis already occurs during the asymptomatic state exclusively in a mouse model of PMS.
36702320.summary: In mice with progressive EAE, axon mitochondria were damaged before symptoms appeared, and the antioxidant Mito-TEMPO prevented some of this damage.

36989705.mechanism: Inhibits STAT3, reducing Th1 and Th17 cells
36989705.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that S3I-201 may have novel therapeutic potential against MS.
36989705.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the STAT3 inhibitor S3I-201 reduced clinical symptoms and shifted immune cells toward regulatory T cells and away from inflammatory Th1 and Th17 cells.

37056247.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging method, no treatment tested
37056247.conclusion_quote: Our method will be useful to specify and track the stepwise development of microinflammation in whole organs that is triggered by the recruitment of pathogenic immune cells at specific blood vessels in various inflammatory diseases.
37056247.summary: Researchers developed a new 3D imaging method that uses gold nanoclusters and tissue clearing to locate inflammation in the spinal cords of mice with EAE.

37934060.mechanism: Removes BHLHE40 from TH17 cells, reducing cytokine production
37934060.conclusion_quote: Our studies highlight the importance of BHLHE40 in promoting TH17 cell encephalitogenicity and instructing myeloid cell responses during active EAE.
37934060.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the BHLHE40 gene in TH17 immune cells produced milder disease, less inflammatory cytokine production, and altered myeloid cell responses.

37021418.mechanism: Blocks miR-142-3p, which mediates TNF-driven neuronal toxicity
37021418.conclusion_quote: We propose miR-142-3p as a critical modulator of TNF-mediated neuronal toxicity and suggest a detrimental synergistic action of these molecules on MS pathology.
37021418.summary: In mice with EAE, reducing the microRNA miR-142-3p prevented TNF-driven damage to nerve signaling in the striatum, suggesting miR-142-3p helps drive neuronal harm in MS.

36646144.mechanism: Inhibits MAPK, reducing NF-κB signaling in B cells
36646144.conclusion_quote: The results of this study suggest that PD98059 may be pursued as a therapeutic agent for the treatment of MS.
36646144.summary: In mice with EAE, the MAPK inhibitor PD98059 reduced inflammatory immune cells and signals in the spleen and brain, suggesting possible use as an MS treatment.

38108416.mechanism: Not applicable, describes an antibody measurement method
38108416.conclusion_quote: The proposed method serves as a powerful tool to investigate the specificity and magnitude of the aberrant humoral response in the context of autoimmune demyelination.
38108416.summary: This protocol describes an ELISA method to measure autoantibodies against myelin peptide in the blood of mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

36965064.conclusion_quote: Significant rNOE and amide changes, validated by immunohistochemistry results for demyelination and remyelination, demonstrate the huge potential of CEST for revealing myelin pathology, which has implications for MS identification at the clinical field strength of 3T.
36965064.summary: Mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin were scanned with a 3T MRI method called CEST, which detected myelin loss and recovery, suggesting potential for MS identification.

37024509.mechanism: Reduces ER stress and mitochondrial dysfunction
37024509.conclusion_quote: GA reversed these pathological changes, suggesting that immunomodulating therapy can indirectly induce neuroprotective effects in the CNS by mediating ER stress.
37024509.summary: In mice with chronic EAE, glatiramer acetate reduced spinal cord inflammation, demyelination, cell stress and nerve cell death, suggesting it protects nerve cells indirectly.

37842634.mechanism: Regulates inflammatory pathway and suppresses inflammatory cytokines
37842634.conclusion_quote: WYP treatment relieves clinical symptoms in EAE mice, which may be related to regulate inflammatory pathway and inhibiting expressions of inflammatory cytokines.
37842634.summary: Wuzi Yanzong Pill, a traditional Chinese herbal medicine, was given to mice with EAE before disease onset and reduced their symptoms and inflammation.

36715148.mechanism: Ch25h loss in endothelium expands immunosuppressive myeloid cells
36715148.conclusion_quote: Our findings reveal a central role for CNS endothelial Ch25h in promoting neuroinflammation by inhibiting the expansion of immunosuppressive myeloid cell populations.
36715148.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Ch25h gene from brain blood vessel cells reduced disease by boosting immunosuppressive myeloid cells that calm T cells.

37909848.mechanism: Serpine1 represses Th1 cytokine production and pathogenicity
37909848.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we identify Serpine1 as a negative regulator of Th1 cells.
37909848.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the Serpine1 gene made disease more severe, while adding extra Serpine1 calmed harmful Th1 immune cells.

37655382.conclusion_quote: In relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, there is a correlation of the immune inflammatory activity in the lesion foci with the axon transection.
37655382.summary: In people with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis, researchers compared blood cytokine levels with disability severity, without testing any treatment.

37913917.mechanism: Describes disease changes, no treatment tested
37913917.conclusion_quote: In summary, this study delineated the longitudinal profile of RGC structural changes in EAE mice, providing an assessment platform for monitoring outcomes of RGC treatments.
37913917.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, retinal nerve cells showed dendrite shrinkage before the retinal layer thinned, tracked over time using in vivo imaging.

36754122.mechanism: Anti-muscarinic drug that promotes oligodendrocyte remyelination
36754122.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the lysophosphatidylcholine-induced IC demyelination model is useful for evaluating changes in motor functions following pharmacological treatments that promote remyelination.
36754122.summary: In mice with internal capsule demyelination, the drug clemastine improved movement, reduced nerve injury, and increased myelin repair, showing this model can test remyelinating treatments.

37443768.mechanism: Reduced TMEM106B delays lysosomal lipid and protein clearance
37443768.conclusion_quote: suggesting that when TMEM106B is compromised, protein and lipid clearance by the lysosome is delayed.
37443768.summary: In mice with EAE and reduced TMEM106B, axonal damage and lipid buildup increased, and lipid clearance was slower after cuprizone-induced demyelination.

37902312.conclusion_quote: Here we describe a protocol for the induction of EAE in both male and female C57BL/6J mice using myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein peptide 35-55 (MOG35-55) immunization, which leads to the development of a chronic form of the disease.
37902312.summary: This protocol explains how to induce chronic EAE, a model of MS, in male and female mice, then measure their symptoms and spinal cord damage.

interventions: a highly selective inhibitor to the TAM family of tyrosine kinase receptors
36708633.mechanism: inhibits TAM receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
36708633.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that constitutive TAM receptor signaling in hindbrain microglia confers region-specific protection against Th17 mediated EAE.
36708633.summary: In mice with Th17-driven EAE, blocking TAM receptors caused ataxia and shifted immune cells into the hindbrain, suggesting microglial TAM signaling protects that brain region.

37528070.mechanism: CD83 loss overactivates microglia, attracting harmful immune cells
37528070.conclusion_quote: Thus, CD83 in murine microglia orchestrates cellular activation and, consequently, also the resolution of neuroinflammation.
37528070.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the CD83 gene from microglia, the brain's immune cells, made them overactive and worsened the disease.

38124095.mechanism: epigenetically reprograms macrophages to resolve neuroinflammation
38124095.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data confirm the therapeutic activity of a pro-resolution secretome in the treatment of ongoing CNS inflammation, via the epigenetic reprogramming of macrophages and open with that a new therapeutic avenue for diseases marked by neuroinflammation.
38124095.summary: In mice with EAE, a secretome from resolution phase macrophages reduced demyelination and CNS immune cell infiltration by reprogramming macrophages.

37827142.conclusion_quote: Not only do these results demonstrate that the age of the 2D2 transgenic donor mice is critical in establishing P-EAE, but the differential effects might also identify age-dependent factors that contribute to EAE and perhaps MS.
37827142.summary: In mice with passive EAE, immune cells from young adult 2D2 donor mice caused more severe disease than cells from mature adult donors, showing donor age matters.

36890580.mechanism: Removes IGF-1 receptor from microglia and border macrophages
36890580.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our work shows that IGF-1R signaling in CNS-resident macrophages regulates the morphology and transcriptome of these cells while significantly decreasing the severity of autoimmune CNS inflammation.
36890580.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IGF-1 receptor from brain immune cells made disease worse and caused weight gain, showing this pathway limits inflammation.

37454525.mechanism: Removes JNK3 kinase, testing its role in EAE
37454525.conclusion_quote: These results suggest JNK3 normally limits EAE disease in a sex-dependent manner.
37454525.summary: In mice with EAE, genetically removing the JNK3 gene made male mice become sick sooner and more severely, while females showed similar disease.

37799385.mechanism: blocks GM-CSF signaling and inflammatory monocyte activity
37799385.conclusion_quote: Together, our data highlight the therapeutic potential of JAK inhibition in treating EAE by blocking the GM-CSF-driven inflammatory signature of monocytes.
37799385.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, blocking JAK signaling reduced inflammatory monocytes and GM-CSF production, which lessened the tissue damage caused by immune cells.

37531831.mechanism: Stimulates splenic sympathetic nerves, activating B-cell β2-AR-cAMP signaling
37531831.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the above results reveal that acupuncture can relieve EAE by stimulating the sympathetic nerves of spleen, mainly through acting on B cells to mediate anti-inflammatory effects, and indirectly affecting the function of CD4 + T cells.
37531831.summary: In mice with EAE, acupuncture at the ST36 point boosted spleen nerve activity and calmed inflammation, mainly by acting on B cells.

37175866.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the neuroinflammation-induced degenerating 21 kDa isoform of MBP sheds light on the development of abnormal myelin on the relapse of MS pathogenesis.
37175866.summary: In SJL mice with relapsing EAE, a degenerating 21.5 kDa form of myelin basic protein built up in the spinal cord, linked to abnormal myelin during relapses.

37951203.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
37951203.conclusion_quote: The findings show that the progression of induced EAE in adulthood can be significantly impacted by adverse early life experiences.
37951203.summary: In female mice with EAE, early life stress from shipping worsened disease severity, delayed recovery, and vision loss in adulthood.

37887329.conclusion_quote: Our data show that astrocytes isolated from the cerebellum (a brain region typically affected in MS) showed a strong alteration in the genes that encode for proteins related to several metabolic pathways.
37887329.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, cerebellar astrocytes showed altered metabolic genes and grew longer, more complex branches near lesions.

37735290.mechanism: Activates Nrf2 pathway, reducing oxidative stress and microglial inflammation
37735290.conclusion_quote: Our work proves that SIN exerts its neuroprotective effects by the Nrf2-dependent anti-oxidative stress and diminishing neuroinflammation, suggesting that the "antioxiflammation" effect of SIN is expected to be an ideal treatment strategy for MS/EAE.
37735290.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, sinomenine reduced disease severity, demyelination and inflammation by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant pathway.

37445742.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, all tested formulations did work, but the choice of Cuprizone formulation may have been responsible for the considerable variability in the experimental outcomes.
37445742.summary: Researchers compared six cuprizone powders from different suppliers in mice and found all caused demyelination, though two formulations performed weaker than the others.

37718988.mechanism: Boosts regulatory T cell gene Foxp3 and TGF-beta production
37718988.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrated that rCTL might be a potential agent to ameliorate EAE symptoms by stimulating anti-inflammatory responses.
37718988.summary: In mice with EAE, a parasite-derived protein from Toxocara canis reduced disability scores and delayed disease onset, linked to more anti-inflammatory immune signals.

37048118.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease effects
37048118.conclusion_quote: Our study suggests alterations in the function of the female reproductive system during central autoimmunity and highlights the bidirectional relationships between hormonal status and EAE.
37048118.summary: In female rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, researchers found ovarian function was disrupted, with a prolonged diestrus phase and altered sex hormone levels.

37180951.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrates regional differences of intrinsic reparative mechanisms after a chronic demyelinating insult and suggests a potential link between long-term motor function alterations and continued axonal damage during chronic remyelination.
37180951.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause chronic myelin loss, researchers found slower remyelination, later motor deficits, and gene activity that differed across brain regions.

37628867.mechanism: Tracer antibodies reveal local barrier leakage
37628867.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the methods with better sensitivity could detect the accumulation of macromolecules (such as fluorescent-labeled or gadolinium-labeled antibody conjugates) in the brain, suggesting a local BBB disruption in the demyelinating area.
37628867.summary: In mice fed the cuprizone diet to model demyelination, labeled antibodies accumulated in the corpus callosum, suggesting the blood brain barrier leaks locally in damaged areas.

37758703.mechanism: Not applicable, describes a microglia engulfment assay
37758703.conclusion_quote: Our work underscores how FEAST can be utilized to gain critical insight into functional neuro-immune interactions that shape development, homeostasis, and disease.
37758703.summary: In mice with cuprizone or lysolecithin induced demyelination, researchers developed a flow cytometry method showing microglia, not border macrophages, engulf myelin and synaptic proteins.

36635255.mechanism: blocks CSF-1R, depleting microglia and meningeal macrophages
36635255.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these data point to a specific role of CNS microglia and meningeal macrophages in antigen presentation and T cell reactivation at initial stages of EAE.
36635255.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug that removed microglia and meningeal macrophages delayed disease onset by reducing immune cell activation in the spinal cord.

36597350.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes antigen clearance mechanism
36597350.conclusion_quote: In experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, we found that the clearance of exogenous myelin antigen at the peak of the primary immune response is key to the pathogenesis of the disease.
36597350.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, clearing myelin antigen at the peak of the immune response drives T cells into the nervous system and causes disease.

37818688.mechanism: Shifts microglia and astrocytes to protective states
37818688.conclusion_quote: Our study showed that AST IV could be a potential and promising drug for multiple sclerosis treatment.
37818688.summary: In animals with EAE, a model of MS, astragaloside IV reduced paralysis and tissue damage by calming harmful immune cells and protecting nerve cells from dying.

37629117.conclusion_quote: Although these results implied that anti-glycolipid antibodies might play a role in remissions or relapses in RR-EAE, their functional roles need to be determined by mechanistic experiments, such as injections of monoclonal anti-glycolipid antibodies.
37629117.summary: Researchers measured antibodies against 11 glycolipids in mice with EAE and a viral MS model, finding raised levels of four antibodies in relapsing remitting EAE.

36181265.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that ARMD is a consistent and prominent feature and emphasise the importance of complex IV activity in the context of ARMD, especially in autoimmune inflammatory demyelination, paving the way for the development of novel neuroprotective therapies.
36181265.summary: In nine experimental models of multiple sclerosis, mitochondria gathered in demyelinated nerve fibres, and nerves with more energy-enzyme activity were less damaged.

36848960.mechanism: Removes repressor gene limiting Th17 IL-2 responsiveness
36848960.conclusion_quote: This work strengthened the idea of a negligible Msc gene involvement in these models.
36848960.summary: In mice with EAE or DSS colitis, removing the Musculin gene did not change disease course, gut bacteria, or immune responses, suggesting it plays little role.

37290683.mechanism: Not applicable, describes disease only without a treatment
37290683.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that VEPs may be a reliable biomarker reflecting the optic nerve involvement in EAE.
37290683.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, visual nerve signal tests showed delays matching inflammation and myelin loss in the optic nerve.

36770997.conclusion_quote: All data show that the IgGs' catalase activity can play an essential role in reducing the H 2 O 2 concentration and protecting mice from oxidative stress.
36770997.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, antibodies from the blood gained catalase activity as the disease progressed, which may help protect against oxidative stress.

37186158.mechanism: Lowers IGFBP2, dampening NF-κB inflammatory signaling
37186158.conclusion_quote: These results identified the unknown role of SARM1 in the promotion of neuroinflammation and demyelination and revealed a novel drug target pathway of SARM1/IGFBP2/NF-κB for MS.
37186158.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, that lacked SARM1 in their nervous system had less inflammation, myelin loss and neuron death.

36685301.mechanism: Blocks cathepsin B, reducing inflammation and demyelination
36685301.conclusion_quote: The findings of this study have shown the protective effect of CA-074 in the case of retinopathy and ON inflicted by EAE in SJL/J mice.
36685301.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug CA-074 reduced optic nerve inflammation, myelin loss and retinal damage, protecting vision-related nerves.

37600798.mechanism: Not a treatment, tests effects of toxicant exposure
37600798.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings provide insight into the complex roles of immune responses in the pathogenesis of virus-associated neurological diseases influenced by co-exposures to viruses and immunotoxic compounds.
37600798.summary: In mice infected with Theiler's virus, early exposure to the chemical PFOA altered immune signaling and increased the frequency and severity of seizures.

37245301.mechanism: lowers TNF and IFN gamma inflammatory cytokines
37245301.conclusion_quote: As a result, the reduction of inflammatory cytokines could reduce clinical symptoms in MS in the animal model.
37245301.summary: In rats with an ethidium bromide model of MS, chronic Toxoplasma gondii infection lowered inflammatory cytokines, slowed clinical signs, and reduced brain tissue damage.

38024159.mechanism: Reduces lipid peroxidation and oxidative protein damage
38024159.conclusion_quote: Consequently, the data obtained highlight the neuroprotective and antioxidant effects of Cronassial when administered to animals with autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
38024159.summary: In rats with EAE, a drug containing gangliosides called Cronassial reduced oxidative damage to fats and proteins in the brain and spinal cord.

36576709.mechanism: boosts autophagy, reduces apoptosis, protects myelin
36576709.conclusion_quote: This finding clarified that FLX and CBD ameliorate the severity of the EAE model.
36576709.summary: In mice with EAE, fluoxetine and cannabidiol raised autophagy markers, lowered cell-death markers, and reduced demyelination in the cerebellum.

37499337.mechanism: Antibodies used to model disease, not treat it
37499337.conclusion_quote: The described models are suitable for comparative analyses of pathological features associated with MOG- and AQP4-IgG and the investigation of therapeutic interventions.
37499337.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies against MOG or AQP4 made disease worse, with AQP4 antibodies causing lesions earlier and in different spinal cord locations.

37957588.conclusion_quote: These results support TMEV infection with brain MRI monitoring as a useful model for exploring the biology of disability progression in MS, but they did not identify an immunological or virological correlate with ventricular enlargement.
37957588.summary: In SJL/J mice infected with Theiler's virus, MRI showed enlarged brain ventricles alongside disability, but immune and viral measures did not explain the enlargement.

37952531.mechanism: Describes ageing effects on thymus T-cell development
37952531.conclusion_quote: The study indicates that strain differences in age-related changes in the efficacy of central tolerance, in addition to enhanced thymic generation of CD8+ T cells prone to differentiate into IL-17-producing cells, could partly explain the opposite effect of ageing on DA and AO rat susceptibility to EAE induction.
37952531.summary: In aged rats with EAE, two rat strains showed opposite thymus changes that may explain their different disease susceptibility and how long their disease lasted.

38025264.conclusion_quote: ICH caused distinct alterations in ECM molecules.
38025264.summary: In mice and one human brain with bleeding, the scar-related protein neurocan was strongly increased, and in lab culture it blocked growth of myelin-forming cells.

36882060.mechanism: not applicable, describes disease mechanism only
36882060.conclusion_quote: Overall, this work provides a framework for a mechanistic understanding of the link between RNA oxidation and neurodegeneration.
36882060.summary: In cells, an animal model, and postmortem brains from people with MS, researchers found oxidized NAT8L mRNA may lower NAA, weakening myelin and axons.

36841486.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results suggest that further study on the role of citrullination in MOG-induced experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis is necessary.
36841486.summary: Citrullinated human and mouse MOG peptides behaved differently in lab tests, and only one human version stimulated immune cells from marmosets with EAE.

37724087.conclusion_quote: It is expected that more and more research is going to delve into the immune tolerance field for allergies and autoimmune diseases, where effective therapies are in short supply.
37724087.summary: This review describes using mRNA lipid nanoparticles to induce immune tolerance, including a mouse EAE model, rather than testing a new treatment in MS.

37668533.mechanism: Emulsifier improving fat digestion, lipid metabolism and redox status
37668533.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our study indicates that dietary lysolecithin supplementation improved growth performance of weaned piglets, which may be associated with the improved nutrients absorption, redox status, and lipid metabolism.
37668533.summary: In weaned piglets, which are not an MS model, adding lysolecithin to feed improved growth, nutrient absorption and fat metabolism.

36967090.conclusion_quote: Especially in our data where female-based significant results were obtained reveal that demyelination may lead to significant mAChR2, mAChR3 and Kir3.1 changes in brainstem, vagus nerve, and heart.
36967090.summary: In rats fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, female rats showed increased muscarinic receptor and Kir3.1 channel levels in brainstem, vagus nerve, and heart.

37296632.mechanism: Removing TRPA1 reduces spinal cord neuroinflammation and demyelination
37296632.conclusion_quote: Present results indicate that the proalgesic role of TRPA1 in EAE mouse models is primarily mediated by its ability to promote spinal neuroinflammation and further strengthen the channel inhibition to treat neuropathic pain in MS.
37296632.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, knocking out the TRPA1 channel prevented pain-like sensitivity, reduced spinal cord inflammation, and protected myelin from damage.

37008218.mechanism: Raises CXCL12, reducing leukocyte entry and promoting remyelination
37008218.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that CXCL12 effectively promotes remyelination in the spinal cord and decreases the signs and symptoms of EAE.
37008218.summary: In Lewis rats with EAE, a viral vector that boosts CXCL12 in the spinal cord reduced clinical signs, immune cell infiltration, and myelin loss.

37590143.mechanism: blocks kynurenic acid GPR35 signaling in macrophages, reducing Th17 response
37590143.conclusion_quote: These findings shed light on the crucial role of microbial-derived tryptophan metabolites in regulating immune responses within extraintestinal tissues.
37590143.summary: In mice with EAE, a chemical made by gut microbes called kynurenic acid drew immune cells into the spinal cord, and blocking its GPR35 signal in macrophages eased disease.

38097655.mechanism: Sox8 loss reduces OPC proliferation and delays remyelination
38097655.conclusion_quote: Our findings present, for the first time, compelling evidence of a significant role of Sox8 in the context of a disease model.
38097655.summary: In mice fed cuprizone, deleting the Sox8 gene slowed myelin repair and reduced oligodendrocyte precursor proliferation and mature oligodendrocyte numbers, showing Sox8 matters for remyelination.

37080068.mechanism: Inhibits STAT3 dimerization, reducing Th17 cells and increasing Tregs
37080068.conclusion_quote: This study showed that STA-21 has therapeutic effects in EAE by reducing inflammation and shifting inflammatory immune responses to anti-inflammatory and can be used as a suitable treatment strategy for the treatment of EAE.
37080068.summary: In mice with EAE, the small molecule STA-21, which blocks the STAT3 protein, reduced inflammation and demyelination and shifted immune cells toward calming Tregs.

37673223.mechanism: Downregulates pro-inflammatory and MAPK pathways, reducing immune response
37673223.conclusion_quote: This study provides insight into the molecular impact of FOL in the brain and identifies potential therapeutic targets of the isoprenoid pathway in MS patients.
37673223.summary: In mice with EAE, daily oral farnesol reduced inflammatory activity in the brain, as shown by gene activity analysis of brain tissue.

37716347.mechanism: blocks mitochondrial mass increase during T cell activation
37716347.conclusion_quote: Thus, modulation of mitochondrial biogenesis may provide a therapeutic strategy for modulating T cell immune responses.
37716347.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug pyrvinium pamoate given at disease induction blocked T cell mitochondrial growth and prevented clinical disease.

36808020.mechanism: delivers antioxidant enzyme into neurons to reduce oxidative damage
36808020.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, PEP-1-SOD1 treatment only has partial effects to reduce cuprizone-induced demyelination and microglial activation in the hippocampus and corpus callosum and has minimal effects on proliferating cells in the dentate gyrus.
36808020.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain demyelination, delivering the antioxidant enzyme SOD1 into neurons only partly reduced myelin loss and microglial activation.

37629172.mechanism: Activates histamine H4 receptor, boosting B-cell inflammatory signaling
37629172.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate the harmful role of H4R agonists in the pathogenesis of MS in an EAE mouse model.
37629172.summary: In mice with EAE, a histamine H4 receptor agonist made disease worse and increased inflammatory signals in B cells and brain tissue.

37804507.mechanism: Degrades AIM2 via p62 autophagy, reducing Treg stability
37804507.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest that TRIM11 serves as a potential target for immunotherapeutic intervention for dysregulated immune responses that lead to autoimmunity and cancers.
37804507.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found that the protein TRIM11 reduces regulatory T cells by breaking down AIM2, so blocking it may help control autoimmune attacks.

37930016.conclusion_quote: This protocol presents an efficient method for isolating astrocytes and microglia from the adult mouse spinal cord, facilitating immediate or future analysis with potential applications in functional, molecular, or proteomic downstream studies.
37930016.summary: This protocol describes a method to isolate pure astrocytes and microglia from adult mouse spinal cords for later lab studies, with possible use in spinal cord disease research.

37695891.mechanism: Viral envelope protein drives neurotoxic glia, axon loss
37695891.conclusion_quote: This study therefore provides direct evidence on HERV-W ENV's contribution to the overall negative impact of this activated viral entity in MS.
37695891.summary: Mice engineered to express the human virus protein ENV showed poorer myelin repair, more nerve damage, and faster EAE disease progression.

36937529.mechanism: Ketogenic diet raises omega-3s and lowers inflammatory cytokines
36937529.conclusion_quote: In light of ongoing clinical trials using dietary strategies to treat people with MS, these findings support that a KD enriched in MCTs, omega-3 fatty acids, and fiber promotes a systemic anti-inflammatory milieu and ameliorates autoimmune-induced demyelinating visual and motor deficits.
36937529.summary: In mice with EAE, a ketogenic diet rich in fats and fiber prevented vision and movement problems and reduced inflammation, whether started before or after symptoms appeared.

37603183.mechanism: Not applicable, describes laboratory assay methods
37603183.conclusion_quote: Finally, we describe the methods to harvest and recover T cells to evaluate the properties associated with their trafficking ability.
37603183.summary: Describes lab methods for isolating T cells from MS patients, healthy controls, and EAE mice, then testing how they cross the blood brain barrier.

37245852.mechanism: promotes cholesterol synthesis and remyelination, protects neurons and synapses
37245852.conclusion_quote: Together, estriol treatment after EAE onset reduced atrophy and was neuroprotective in the cerebral cortex.
37245852.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, given estriol after symptoms began had less cortical shrinkage, more myelin, and preserved nerve cells and connections.

36853716.conclusion_quote: Here, we present a protocol to assess demyelination in the corpus callosum of an acute cuprizone mouse model, which is routinely used to induce demyelination for studying myelin regeneration in the rodent brain.
36853716.summary: This protocol explains how to measure demyelination, myelin repair, and cell proliferation in the brains of mice fed cuprizone, a toxin that strips myelin.

37709757.mechanism: Blocks dendritic cell IL-6 and IL-12p70 production
37709757.conclusion_quote: Overall, our study reveals CXCR1 governs DCs-mediated inflammation and autoimmune disorders and its potential as a therapeutic target for related diseases.
37709757.summary: In mice with EAE, removing CXCR1 from dendritic cells or blocking its ligand CXCL5 reduced disease severity and inflammatory cytokine production.

37395567.mechanism: Knocks down A2A receptor in choroid plexus tissue
37395567.conclusion_quote: This technique may have important implications for future research on the ChP's role in CNS disorders.
37395567.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a new method reduced the adenosine A2A receptor in the choroid plexus, which eased disease damage.

37083540.conclusion_quote: This study demonstrates the prevalence of spontaneous remyelination in marmoset EAE and the ability of in vivo MRI to detect it, with implications for preclinical testing of pro-remyelinating agents.
37083540.summary: In marmosets with EAE, MRI scans accurately identified myelin repair in brain lesions, checked against tissue examination in six animals.

37491623.conclusion_quote: This is the first comprehensive analysis of the expression of galectin-3 in MS, further strengthening its potential pathogenetic role in the etiopathogenesis of this CNS autoimmune disorder.
37491623.summary: Researchers measured galectin-3 levels in immune and brain cells from mice with EAE and in human MS brain lesions, finding higher levels, suggesting a possible role in MS.

37286732.mechanism: alters DNA methylation at MBP promoter, boosting oligodendrocyte differentiation
37286732.conclusion_quote: Altering the epigenetic status of MBP can restore the differentiation capacity of OPCs and possibly boost (re)myelination.
37286732.summary: In human stem-cell-derived oligodendrocytes, editing the methylation switch of the MBP myelin gene bidirectionally changed cell maturation and myelin production, as tested in lab cultures.

37595951.mechanism: Loss increases mTEC AIRE expression and thymic Treg
37595951.conclusion_quote: This work identifies a novel role for GPR109A and possibly the gut microbiota, on thymic Treg development via its regulation of mTECs.
37595951.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the GPR109A receptor increased protective regulatory T cells and reduced disease signs and inflammation.

36830524.mechanism: Improves fat digestion in low energy feed
36830524.conclusion_quote: Conclusively, adding LIP + LYSO 0.08 to a low energy diet could demonstrate better growth performance and reduce the negative impact of a low-energy diet.
36830524.summary: This study tested feed enzyme and emulsifier additives in broiler chickens on low energy diets, finding better growth with a combined higher dose, with no multiple sclerosis model used.

37658486.mechanism: zinc inhibits glutaminase activity, slowing glutamine metabolism in T cells
37658486.conclusion_quote: Besides T cell subset differentiation, zinc also impacts on the cellular metabolism by inhibiting glutaminolysis.
37658486.summary: In laboratory experiments on immune T cells, zinc deficiency and blocking the GLS enzyme reduced immune responses, and zinc directly slowed a key metabolic pathway.

37289590.mechanism: Reduces TREM2 levels, altering microglia and macrophage phenotypes
37289590.conclusion_quote: Our study provides comprehensive insights into the complex roles of TREM2 in myeloid populations across diverse CNS disorders, which has crucial implications in devising TREM2-targeting therapeutics.
37289590.summary: In mice with spinal cord injury or EAE, lowering TREM2 in myeloid immune cells gave early protection after spinal injury but worsened demyelination in EAE.

37513884.mechanism: Opens BK potassium channels to limit neural excitability
37513884.conclusion_quote: Therefore, in addition to symptom control, BK channel openers have the potential to save nerves from excitotoxic damage and could be useful as either stand-alone neuroprotective agents or as add-ons to current disease-modifying treatments that block relapsing MS but do not have any direct neuroprotective activity.
37513884.summary: In mice with EAE, BK channel openers did not stop relapses but reduced nerve loss and disability.

36266965.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease mechanism
36266965.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, periodontitis exacerbates EAE, likely through ectopic colonization of oral pathobionts and expansion of Th17 cells.
36266965.summary: In mice with EAE, gum disease worsened symptoms, likely by spreading oral bacteria that boost Th17 immune cells.

37870321.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this protocol offers a precise and comprehensive way to analyze complex cellular networks in healthy and EAE mice.
37870321.summary: This protocol isolates microglia, oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and neurons from the same mice with EAE, a model of MS, allowing study of all four cell types together.

37103078.conclusion_quote: These results suggest for the first time that tau pathology may be involved in the progression of neuroinflammation in dogs, similar to that in human MS.
37103078.summary: Researchers examined brain tissue from dogs with inflammatory brain disease and canine EAE models, finding abnormal tau protein modification in inflamed areas but not in healthy dogs.

37660962.conclusion_quote: Lastly, we determine the spatial correlation between stiffness measurements and myelin density and observe a region-specific proportionality between myelin content and tissue stiffness.
37660962.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice, which lose myelin, brain tissue became softer as myelin decreased, with stiffness tracking myelin content differently across brain regions.

37358743.mechanism: Gene deletion changes oligodendrocyte function and myelin regulation
37358743.conclusion_quote: A 1 and A 2A AR are involved in OPC/OL functions with opposing roles in myelin regulation in the hippocampus.
37358743.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the A1 adenosine receptor worsened hippocampal myelin loss, while removing the A2A receptor increased myelin.

37983957.mechanism: increases sustained IRE1α activity, reducing microglial inflammation
37983957.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that sustained increase in IRE1α activity can be beneficial in vivo, and that this protection is cell type and context dependent.
37983957.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, a gene change that keeps IRE1α constantly active improved motor function and reduced spinal inflammation and axon damage.

36574260.mechanism: Reduces SARM1 activation and necroptosis gene expression
36574260.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings suggest that the downregulation of SF3B2 is a novel potential therapeutic target to prevent secondary neurodegeneration in MS.
36574260.summary: In mice with EAE and in cultured brain cells, lowering the SF3B2 gene protected nerve cells and their axons from inflammatory damage.

36464096.conclusion_quote: IhMT sequences selective for long T 1D components are specific and sensitive in vivo markers of demyelination and remyelination and have successfully captured the spatially heterogeneous pattern of the demyelination and remyelination mechanisms in the cuprizone model.
36464096.summary: This MRI study in mice fed the cuprizone toxin tested imaging methods that track myelin loss and repair, and found that one ihMT signal closely matched tissue histology.

36943883.conclusion_quote: The identification of complement-dependent and -independent pathomechanisms of MOG-Abs has implications for therapeutic strategies in MOGAD.
36943883.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found that antibodies against MOG damage myelin through both complement and Fc receptors, and boost T-cell activity through Fc receptors.

36843841.mechanism: Directly blocks NLRP3 ATPase activity, stopping inflammasome assembly
36843841.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study identifies the anticancer drug tivantinib as a specific inhibitor of NLRP3 and provides a promising therapeutic agent for inflammasome-driven disease.
36843841.summary: Tivantinib, an anticancer drug, blocked the NLRP3 inflammation switch and had preventive and therapeutic benefits in mice with EAE.

37861715.mechanism: Not applicable, analytical copper detection chemistry
37861715.conclusion_quote: The application of the colorimetric sensor allows the quantification of copper in the range from 1 to 12 mg L -1 , with a low limit of detection of 0.21 mg L -1 .
37861715.summary: A cotton thread sensor read by smartphone measured copper levels in water and cachaça. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis, animals, or human cells.

37831759.mechanism: Deleting integrin limits Th17 polarization and CNS entry
37831759.conclusion_quote: The requirement of integrin α3 in T H 17 cell pathogenicity suggests integrin α3 as a therapeutic target for MS treatment.
37831759.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting integrin α3 from CD4 T cells reduced Th17 cell activity, their entry into the brain and spinal cord, and disease severity.

36775342.mechanism: binds L-MPZ on myelin debris, reducing demyelination
36775342.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that IVIg may modulate PNS demyelination, possibly by binding to L-MPZ on myelin debris.
36775342.summary: In mice with nerve damage caused by lysolecithin, intravenous immunoglobulin given after injury reduced the area of demyelination and attached to a myelin protein called L-MPZ.

37438842.mechanism: blocks BTK in B cells and myeloid cells
37438842.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that through lymphoid and myeloid cell regulation, BTK inhibition reduced neurodegeneration and disease progression during secondary progressive EAE.
37438842.summary: In mice with EAE, late treatment with a BTK inhibitor, including a drug that enters the brain called GB7208, reduced disease severity, demyelination and nerve damage.

37603185.conclusion_quote: In this chapter, we will summarize the current knowledge about the contribution of TLRs to the development or progression of MS, and we will illustrate different methods commonly used for the investigation of the role of different TLRs in various murine models of the disease.
37603185.summary: This book chapter reviews how Toll-like receptors, immune sensors that detect microbes, may contribute to multiple sclerosis and describes methods for studying them in mouse models.

36831228.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes membrane lipid changes
36831228.conclusion_quote: This regulation in lipid content suggests an increased cell membrane rigidity during the inflammatory phase of EAE and supports the investigation of peripheral cell membrane lipids as possible biomarkers for CNS lipid membrane concentration and assembly.
36831228.summary: Mice with EAE showed altered red blood cell membrane lipids during inflammation, with lower polyunsaturated fats and more rigid membranes, suggesting blood lipids may reflect CNS changes.

36730207.mechanism: not applicable, characterizes myeloid cell origins
36730207.conclusion_quote: Analysis of gene expression and chromosomal accessibility identified CD88 + CD317 + myeloid cells in the CNS of EAE mice as originating from BMC and microglia.
36730207.summary: Using bone marrow chimeric mice with EAE, researchers profiled single cells and found CNS myeloid cells CD88 and CD317 arise from both bone marrow cells and microglia.

38155863.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
38155863.conclusion_quote: This underscores the importance of understanding the role of infiltrating myeloid cells in different disease contexts and phases.
38155863.summary: Cells from mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, changed microglia morphology and inflammatory gene activity in a lab dish, with effects depending on disease type and timing.

37540735.mechanism: Pla2g12a deletion lowers lipid that drives Th17 differentiation
37540735.conclusion_quote: Thus, our data indicate that 1-oleoyl-lysophosphatidylethanolamine is a lipid metabolite that promotes RORγt-induced T H 17 cell differentiation and the pathogenicity of T H 17 cells.
37540735.summary: In mice lacking Pla2g12a only in T cells, the lipid 1-oleoyl-lysophosphatidylethanolamine fell, Th17 cells made less IL-17, and the mice did not develop EAE.

37170724.mechanism: Delivers FTY720 to lymph nodes, limiting T-cell migration
37170724.conclusion_quote: Taken together, this study demonstrates that targeted LNs delivery may greatly extend the treatment cycle of immunosuppressive drugs for durable MS treatment.
37170724.summary: In mice with EAE, nanoparticles that carry FTY720 to lymph nodes and target lymphocytes delayed disease progression after a single dose over 42 days.

36609052.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes bystander T-cell activation
36609052.conclusion_quote: Our study suggests a potential role of IL-17A-producing bystander-activated CD4 + IL-1Rl + T cells in MS.
36609052.summary: In people with MS, helper T cells that carry the IL1 receptor and are activated without a specific antigen made more interleukin 17A than those of healthy controls.

36702633.mechanism: Loss of SOCS4 alters antiviral and inflammatory responses
36702633.conclusion_quote: We conclude that, in the mouse brain, SOCS4 is a vital regulator of antiviral immunity that mediates the critical balance between immunopathology and virus persistence.
36702633.summary: In mice with Semliki Forest virus brain infection, removing the SOCS4 gene sped virus clearance but increased brain inflammation and nerve damage.

37128203.conclusion_quote: TLR9, CCL5, CXCL8 and PDGFRB were identified as potential biomarkers for GM injury in MS.
37128203.summary: Researchers analyzed public human gene data from grey matter lesions in MS and checked results in a mouse model, identifying four immune genes that may serve as diagnostic markers.

36853799.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings suggest that ETX-producing C. perfringens strains are biologically plausible pathogens in MS that trigger inflammatory demyelination in the context of circulating myelin autoreactive lymphocytes.
36853799.summary: People with MS more often carried epsilon toxin producing gut bacteria, and in mice with EAE this toxin caused widespread demyelination throughout the brain and spinal cord.

37988467.mechanism: Prevents MALT1 cleavage of Roquin-1, reducing Th17 differentiation
37988467.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate how TCR signaling and MALT1 activation utilize graded cleavage of Roquin to differentially regulate target mRNAs that control T cell activation and differentiation as well as the development of autoimmunity.
37988467.summary: In mice, a genetic change that stops the MALT1 enzyme from cutting the Roquin-1 protein prevented harmful immune cell activation and protected the mice from EAE.

37957728.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes neuroaxonal damage patterns
37957728.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate that CNS myeloid cells may play a crucial role in driving neuroaxonal damage in EAE.
37957728.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped where nerve fiber damage occurs over time, finding it linked to immune cell activity in the spinal cord.

37716077.mechanism: induces persistent antigen-specific regulatory T cells in CNS
37716077.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that, for optimal therapy, "benign autoimmunity" can be critically achieved through inverse vaccination with self-peptides by manipulating their flanking residues.
37716077.summary: In mice with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a self-peptide from myelin proteolipid protein that induced persistent regulatory T cells protected against disease re-induction.

36836678.mechanism: parasite infection raises angiogenic growth factor levels
36836678.conclusion_quote: Nematode-derived factors are promising tools to fight autoimmune diseases and to study angiogenesis.
36836678.summary: In mice with colitis and EAE, infection with a parasitic worm raised levels of several blood vessel growth factors and changed the structure of brain vessels.

37405565.mechanism: Loss of METTL3 reduces Th17 differentiation and infiltration
37405565.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our results highlight that m 6 A modification sustains Th17 cell function, which provides new insights into the regulatory network of Th17 cells, and also implies a potential therapeutic target for Th17 cell mediated autoimmune disease.
37405565.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the METTL3 enzyme from Th17 immune cells reduced their development and their spread into the central nervous system, which eased disease.

37005741.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes glycosylation marking astrocytes
37005741.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that the unique PTPRZ glycosylation plays a key role in the patterning of demyelination-associated astrocytes.
37005741.summary: In cuprizone-fed mice and in patients with multiple sclerosis, researchers found a specific sugar modification on the PTPRZ protein marks a subtype of astrocytes linked to myelin damage.

38020654.mechanism: No treatment tested, only disease description
38020654.conclusion_quote: Cortical neuronal transcriptomics, mitochondrial morphology, and functional respirometry assays in synaptosomes revealed worse neurodegeneration in male EAE mice.
38020654.summary: In mice with chronic EAE, a model of MS, males showed more cortical neuron and mitochondrial damage than females, but no treatment was tested.

37610097.mechanism: Inhibits MAPK/ERK pathway, pushing progenitors to mature oligodendrocytes
37610097.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggest OPC regenerative function depends on a permissive environment, which may include pro-regenerative inflammatory elements.
37610097.summary: In mice with chronic progressive EAE, a drug that pushed progenitor cells to become myelin-making cells did not improve symptoms or reduce demyelination.

38114994.mechanism: Large vesicles weaken barrier, small vesicles reduce inflammation
38114994.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study highlights the distinct and opposing effects of BBB-EV subpopulations on the BBB, both in vitro and in vivo.
38114994.summary: Brain blood vessel cells release two sizes of vesicles, and in mice with EAE, small vesicles reduced disease severity while large vesicles worsened symptoms.

37133337.conclusion_quote: Overall, we demonstrate the ease and utility of histoflow cytometry, which expands the number of fluorescent channels used in conventional immunofluorescence and enables quantitative cytometry and spatial localization of histological analyses.
37133337.summary: This study developed histoflow cytometry, a method that combines flow cytometry with microscope imaging, and used it to map immune cells in the spinal cords of mice with EAE.

37239102.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings show that adult-onset sulfatide depletion, independent of demyelination, is sufficient to trigger progressive axonal degeneration.
37239102.summary: In mice, turning off sulfatide production in adulthood caused progressive axon degeneration and loosened myelin protein anchoring, even without myelin loss.

37805549.mechanism: blocks BAFF, reducing B-cell survival and T-cell costimulation
37805549.conclusion_quote: Additionally, we noted that BAFF treatment protected against EAE-induced synaptic and neuronal loss in the adjacent cortex and in the CA1, CA3, and dentate gyrus regions of the hippocampus likely due to its effects on meningeal inflammation.
37805549.summary: In mice with EAE, an anti-BAFF antibody reduced immune cells in the brain lining and protected nearby brain cells from loss of synapses and neurons.

37160207.mechanism: Reduces microglia activation and PKR-NFκB signaling
37160207.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that activation of PKR and NFκB signaling may be important for the regulation of cognition and neuroinflammation in the GWI condition and that fingolimod, a drug already approved for human use, may be a potential candidate for the treatment of GWI.
37160207.summary: In mice exposed to Gulf War chemicals and stress, fingolimod restored memory and reduced brain microglia activation and inflammatory signaling, though the model is not one of multiple sclerosis.

36508914.mechanism: blocks pathogenic CXCR6 CD4 T cells
36508914.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the findings of this study suggest for the first time that baicalein may ameliorate EAE by suppressing pathogenetic CXCR6 + CD4 cells.
36508914.summary: In EAE mice, the plant flavonoid baicalein reduced disease severity and demyelination by suppressing harmful CXCR6 positive CD4 immune cells.

36511515.mechanism: T cells infiltrate corpus callosum after MOG immunization
36511515.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the inflammatory environment in the combined model affects axons and oligodendrocytes differently and that oligodendroglial lineage cells might be less susceptible to T cell mediated injury.
36511515.summary: In a combined cuprizone and MOG-EAE model, adding immune T cells to the brain's corpus callosum increased axon damage but did not change how myelin repair proceeded.

36830745.mechanism: reduces microglial nitric oxide and TNF alpha production
36830745.conclusion_quote: Altogether, the set of experiments presented in this work indicates that cannabigerol possesses an appealing therapeutic potential for the treatment of MS.
36830745.summary: In mice with EAE and in microglial cell cultures, cannabigerol reduced inflammatory nitric oxide and TNF alpha, and improved clinical scores and neuronal loss.

36377669.conclusion_quote: Together, the data presented here indicate that microglia obtain different features at different stages of crEAE and a particularly mixed phenotype in the chronic stage.
36377669.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, microglia were profiled across disease stages, showing inflammatory activity early, lipid and repair genes in remission, and mixed features when chronic.

36520661.mechanism: Raises oxygen supply to hypoxic inflamed spinal cord
36520661.conclusion_quote: Severe neurological deficits in both active and passive EAE can be caused by hypoxia and reduced by oxygen treatment.
36520661.summary: In rats with active and passive EAE, breathing high levels of oxygen reduced neurological deficits and, with longer treatment, reduced demyelination.

36750500.mechanism: Mimics estrogen signaling during perinatal development
36750500.conclusion_quote: Exposure to bisphenols seemed to be particularly deleterious in males.
36750500.summary: In mice with EAE, perinatal exposure to bisphenol A or S, chemicals found in plastics, brought earlier disease onset and more motor neuron loss, especially in males.

37542647.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, suppressing glial activation and NF-kB inflammatory sig
37542647.conclusion_quote: Our data demonstrated that siponimod induces anti-inflammatory effects via suppression of glial activation and inflammatory singling pathways that could protect the retina against acute excitotoxicity conditions.
37542647.summary: In mice with NMDA-induced retinal injury, siponimod reduced glial activation and inflammatory signaling, helping protect the retina from excitotoxic damage.

36958487.mechanism: suppresses neurotoxic reactive astrocytes in hippocampus
36958487.conclusion_quote: These findings support that the suppression of neurotoxic reactive astrocytes might be a potential target for treatment of depression in patients with MS, and suggest the potential of using rTMS as a potential therapeutic treatment for this disorder.
36958487.summary: Repetitive magnetic stimulation reduced depressive and anxiety behaviors in mice with EAE by suppressing harmful reactive astrocytes in the hippocampus.

37806512.mechanism: blocks PTPσ receptor that inhibits myelin regeneration
37806512.conclusion_quote: PTPσ inhibition can ameliorate neurofunctional deficit, promote white matter development, modulate neuroinflammation and microglia/macrophage phenotype after preterm WMI.
37806512.summary: In neonatal mice with preterm-type brain white matter injury, a peptide blocking PTPσ improved movement and thinking, helped myelin form, and calmed brain inflammation.

36700122.mechanism: Liver AAV expression induces antigen-specific regulatory T cells
36700122.conclusion_quote: Overall, the results suggests that AAV can efficiently restore Ag-specific immune tolerance to an immunogenic protein that is neither restricted by the major histocompatibility complex haplotype, nor by the specific antigenic epitope(s) presented.
36700122.summary: In mice with EAE, a liver-directed AAV gene therapy expressing a myelin antigen prevented disease and reduced established disease across different mouse strains and epitopes.

36930229.mechanism: Stable cyclic peptide, mechanism not studied here
36930229.conclusion_quote: With large-scale plant production facilities coming on-line across the world, the sustainable and cost-effective production of cyclotide-based therapeutics is now within reach.
36930229.summary: Researchers produced the experimental multiple sclerosis peptide [T20K]kB1 in Australian native tobacco plants, matching the synthetic peptide's structure at useful yields.

36901861.mechanism: Not a treatment study, describes antibody changes
36901861.conclusion_quote: Unlike abzymes hydrolyzing DNA, MBP, and histones, the spontaneous development of EAE leads not to an increase but to a permanent decrease of IgGs activity of hydrolysis of RNA-substrates.
36901861.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, antibodies that break down microRNAs decreased steadily as disease developed, unlike antibodies that break down DNA.

37882764.conclusion_quote: Our data reveal an essential role of Foxa2 in directing T-expressing cells towards the notochord lineage.
37882764.summary: Researchers mapped notochord enhancer DNA regions in mouse embryos and cultured cells, focusing on the brachyury gene. This developmental study does not involve multiple sclerosis or demyelination.

38027447.mechanism: Food enzyme safety assessment, no MS treatment
38027447.conclusion_quote: Based on the data provided, the Panel concluded that this food enzyme does not give rise to safety concerns under the intended conditions of use.
38027447.summary: This food safety assessment of a genetically modified fungal enzyme used in food processing does not involve multiple sclerosis, animals, or human cells.

36681886.mechanism: Ataxin-1 loss alters B-cell noncoding RNA expression
36681886.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these findings shed light on the possible contribution of noncoding RNAs to B-cell biology and MS pathogenesis, and further establish the immunomodulatory role of ataxin-1 in autoimmune demyelination.
36681886.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the ataxin-1 gene changed specific noncoding RNAs in B cells, and the knockout mice had worse autoimmune demyelination.

36899405.conclusion_quote: It appears that an increased expression of OX40 may be associated with the hyperactivation of T cells in patients with MS, and this may play a role in the pathogenesis of the disease.
36899405.summary: In people with MS, neuromyelitis optica, and healthy controls, OX40 levels in blood were higher in MS patients and linked to disability scores.

36926609.mechanism: promotes myelin gene expression and reduces ER stress
36926609.conclusion_quote: KRG and Rb1 may improve myelin regeneration during the remyelination phase in vivo , potentially by directly promoting myelin gene expression.
36926609.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, Korean Red Ginseng and its compound Rb1 increased myelin at one time point but not later, and boosted myelin gene activity in cells.

37727371.conclusion_quote: CASP4 and NLRC4 were key biomarkers of pyroptosis in MS.
37727371.summary: Using brain tissue from people with MS and mice with EAE, researchers found immune cell changes and identified CASP4 and NLRC4 as possible markers of inflammatory cell death.

37063962.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that RyR3 is a viable therapeutic target for the treatment of CAVD.
37063962.summary: In an in vitro model of heart valve cells, the approved drug dantrolene reduced harmful calcium deposits, suggesting a possible treatment target for aortic valve disease rather than multiple sclerosis.

interventions: IgG Fc fragments bearing regRF epitopes
36344864.mechanism: Fc fragments with regRF epitopes reduce immune cell expansion
36344864.conclusion_quote: Therefore, RegRF is a promising biotarget in autoimmune thyroiditis, and Fc fragments bearing regRF epitopes are a potential therapeutic agent for that condition.
36344864.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune thyroiditis, a thyroid immune disease model, Fc fragments carrying regRF epitopes reduced thyroid damage and restored normal thyroid hormone production.

37065222.mechanism: Emulsifies fats to increase nutrient digestibility
37065222.conclusion_quote: Overall, feeding LYSO during GRO and FIN enhanced feedlot performance and should lead to higher intakes during very hot days of the finishing feeding period.
37065222.summary: In beef cattle raised in a tropical feedlot, a lysolecithin feed additive increased weight gain and digestibility but is unrelated to multiple sclerosis.

37239982.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes antibody enzyme activity during EAE
37239982.conclusion_quote: Overall, it was first demonstrated that at different stages of EAE evolution, IgGs-abzymes against individual histones and MBP could significantly differ in the number and type of specific sites of H2A hydrolysis.
37239982.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies from blood hydrolyzed the histone H2A protein at different sites, and these cutting patterns changed as the disease progressed.

36831209.mechanism: modulates immune cells, reduces microglia and macrophage activity
36831209.conclusion_quote: Preventive treatment with GA reduces disease progression in OSE in line with modest effects on microglia/macrophages.
36831209.summary: In a mouse model of MS, starting glatiramer acetate before disease appeared slowed clinical worsening and modestly reduced microglia and macrophage activity in the spinal cord.

36758497.mechanism: Shortens QTc interval, possibly via cumulative cortisone effect
36758497.conclusion_quote: In humans, cortisone shortens the QTc interval over time.
36758497.summary: In a study of 78 people newly diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, methylprednisolone treatment shortened the heart's QTc interval over time.

37377729.conclusion_quote: Our method reveals a robust and interpretable multi-region metabolomic signal that discriminates the groups of interest.
37377729.summary: This statistical paper presents a new method for classifying multiway data, tested on mouse brain spectroscopy from a Friedreich's ataxia model and on MS treatment gene expression data.

37121980.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings reveal the clearly distinct effector-like heterogeneity of MP CD4 + T cells in the steady state and indicate that CCR6 high MP CD4 + T cells exacerbate autoimmune neuroinflammation via the Bhlhe40/GM-CSF axis in a bystander manner.
37121980.summary: In mice with EAE, memory CD4 T cells present even without disease worsened brain inflammation via the Bhlhe40 and GM-CSF pathway.

36424468.conclusion_quote: We conclude that, in addition to damaging mature OL, CPZ also reduces NSC/NPC proliferation and activates progenitor migration.
36424468.summary: In neural stem cell cultures from mouse brain, the toxin cuprizone, used to model demyelination, reduced cell proliferation, increased cell migration, and damaged mature oligodendrocytes.

37717888.mechanism: boosts precursor cell division and myelin protein expression
37717888.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these data suggest that lactation creates a conducive promyelinating environment through increased OPCs cell division, enhanced expression of select myelin proteins, and reduced number of non-myelinated axons.
37717888.summary: In lactating and non-lactating rats with lysolecithin-induced brain demyelination, lactation increased precursor cells and myelin markers and reduced demyelination damage in the corpus callosum.

37633912.mechanism: Blocks BTK in B cells and microglia
37633912.conclusion_quote: Remibrutinib inhibited EAE models by a two-pronged mechanism based on inhibition of pathogenic B cell autoreactivity, as well as direct anti-inflammatory effects in microglia.
37633912.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the BTK inhibitor remibrutinib reduced symptoms and inflammation by calming B cells and microglia, the brain's immune cells.

36650404.mechanism: activates Nrf-2, reducing oxidative stress and inflammation
36650404.conclusion_quote: This highlights the cardioprotective and hepatoprotective activities of SF via Nrf-2 activation and enhancing catalase function.
36650404.summary: In rats given cuprizone, a demyelination-inducing toxin, sulforaphane reduced heart and liver oxidative stress and inflammation by activating the Nrf-2 pathway.

37454252.mechanism: Shifts gut microbiota and restores Th17/Treg balance
37454252.conclusion_quote: Our findings suggested that the vital neuro-protection role of Heshouwu () (TCM) in immunomodulation effects partly by regulations of gut microbiome.
37454252.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the traditional Chinese herb Heshouwu reduced disease severity and nerve damage, partly by reshaping gut bacteria.

37049736.mechanism: Antibody-abzymes cleave histone H2B at multiple sites
37049736.conclusion_quote: Overall, this is the first study to demonstrate that at different stages of EAE evolution, IgG-abzymes against five individual histones and MBP could significantly differ in the specific sites and number of H2B hydrolysis sites.
37049736.summary: In mice with EAE, antibodies from different stages of disease cut the histone H2B protein at varying numbers and sites, with differences over time.

36993937.mechanism: Activates iNKT cells, increasing regulatory T-cells
36993937.conclusion_quote: This study has demonstrated immunomodulatory effects of the iNKT cell-stimulatory drug OCH in human.
36993937.summary: In a first human trial, oral OCH was well tolerated and increased regulatory T-cells in healthy volunteers and people with multiple sclerosis.

36902407.mechanism: Reduces intestinal inflammation and oxidative stress
36902407.conclusion_quote: This study proves that the protective effect of OLE in EAE also involves normalizing the gut alterations associated to the disease.
36902407.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, oleacein from olive oil reduced gut inflammation, oxidative stress and intestinal barrier damage, though gut microbe diversity was largely unchanged.

37301184.mechanism: Blocks STAT3 signaling, reducing Th17 cell formation
37301184.conclusion_quote: Magnolol selectively inhibited Th17 differentiation and cytokine expression through selectively blocking of STAT3 resulting in decreased the ratio of Th17/Treg cells for treating MS, suggesting that the potential of magnolol for treating MS as novel STAT3 inhibitor.
37301184.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, magnolol reduced disease severity and blocked the STAT3 pathway that drives harmful Th17 immune cells.

36321558.mechanism: Enhances microglia macrophage myelin debris clearance
36321558.conclusion_quote: Collectively, Nox4 deletion promoted remyelination after CPZ-induced demyelination by enhancing microglia/macrophage-mediated clearance of myelin debris and the production of trophic factors leading to oligodendrogenesis.
36321558.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, deleting the Nox4 gene improved remyelination and motor function by boosting microglia and macrophage clearance of myelin debris.

36548309.mechanism: blocks GMF-β Ser-83 phosphorylation, reducing gut inflammation
36548309.conclusion_quote: GMFBI.1's dual gut/brain targeting of GMF-β has therapeutical/translational potential in controlling autoimmunity in MS.
36548309.summary: In mice with EAE, a small molecule blocking GMF-β in the gut and brain partly reduced disease, and fully reversed it when gut drug levels were restored.

36805765.mechanism: boosts antioxidant defenses, lowers lipid peroxidation
36805765.conclusion_quote: These results suggested crocin has protective effect against CPZ-induced MS in mice.
