35888052.conclusion_quote: It was concluded that the dose of 250 ng and 350 ng of PTX were the best choices to trigger the brain and spinal cord demyelination lesions and did not correlate with clinical scores.
35888052.summary: In rats with EAE, different doses of pertussis toxin were compared, and 250 and 350 ng best triggered brain and spinal cord demyelination, though lesions did not track clinical scores.

33259004.mechanism: Not applicable, describes stress effect without treatment
33259004.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that gestational stress induces a marked increase in the severity of EAE symptoms in adulthood.
33259004.summary: In mice with EAE, stress during pregnancy worsened disease symptoms in adulthood and impaired oligodendrocyte maturation, alongside changes in BDNF signaling.

35976486.mechanism: reduces inflammation and gliosis while boosting progenitor remyelination
35976486.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicated that UA can enhance myelin repair after cuprizone challenge through the prevention of gliosis and increasing the newly generated myelin.
35976486.summary: In mice with demyelination caused by cuprizone, ursolic acid improved myelin repair, reduced inflammation and scarring, and helped exhausted progenitor cells rebuild myelin.

35700359.mechanism: Inhibits glycolysis, promoting anti-inflammatory macrophage phenotype in CNS
35700359.conclusion_quote: Our study provided a proof of principle for how a blood-based metabolomic approach using patient samples could lead to the identification of a therapeutic target for developing potential therapy.
35700359.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking glycolysis with 2-deoxy-D-glucose reduced disease progression and inflammation by shifting CNS macrophages toward an anti-inflammatory state.

35905076.mechanism: ROS-driven IL-10 overproduction blocks Th17 differentiation
35905076.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the results reveal a novel role of NQO1 in promoting Th17 development through the suppression of ROS mediated IL-10 production.
35905076.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the NQO1 gene reduced harmful Th17 immune cells and eased disease symptoms, with the effect linked to oxidative stress and IL-10.

36256820.mechanism: Antigen delivery reduces MHC II antigen presentation
36256820.conclusion_quote: This promising antigen-specific therapeutic approach advantageously engaged essential components of both innate and adaptive autoimmune responses and capably reversed paralysis in advanced EAE without the use of a broad immunosuppressant.
36256820.summary: In mice with EAE, a microparticle treatment carrying the disease antigen reversed paralysis and reduced nervous system inflammation and demyelination without broad immune suppression.

36377218.mechanism: Reduces apoptosis and promotes oligodendrocyte differentiation
36377218.conclusion_quote: The results of this study showed that FA plays a significant neuroprotective role in CPZ models of demyelination by reducing neuronal apoptosis and improving oligodendrocytes (OLs) growth and differentiation.
36377218.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause myelin loss, ferulic acid injections improved memory, movement, and myelin markers while reducing brain cell death.

35511417.mechanism: No treatment tested, only describes aging effects
35511417.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings suggest that drugs that suppress microglial activation, and acquisition or expression of aging-associated properties, may be beneficial in the treatment of progressive forms of inflammatory demyelinating disease.
35511417.summary: In mice with EAE, older mice had more severe, less remitting disease than young adults, driven largely by nonimmune CNS cells and microglia.

35758549.mechanism: Acts via microglial miR-126a-5p, inhibiting MMP9 to protect the barrier
35758549.conclusion_quote: Taken together, microglia can be manipulated to protect BBB integrity and ameliorate inflammatory demyelination.
35758549.summary: In mice with EAE, the approved drug Auranofin protected the blood-brain barrier by acting on microglia, the brain's immune cells, and reduced disease severity.

35294872.mechanism: Prevents ERK-mediated serine 182 phosphorylation of RORγt
35294872.conclusion_quote: The IL-1β-ERK-RORγt S182 circuit protects against T cell-mediated inflammation and provides potential therapeutic targets to combat autoimmune diseases.
35294872.summary: In mice with EAE and colitis, removing a phosphorylation site on RORγt worsened inflammation, showing this site protects against harmful T cell attacks.

35354043.mechanism: Removes T-cell IL-10, reducing effector T cell survival
35354043.conclusion_quote: Our data indicate a pro-inflammatory role of T-cell-derived IL-10 in the CNS.
35354043.summary: In mice with EAE, removing IL-10 from T cells reduced inflammation in the brain and spinal cord, showing this signal helps keep harmful immune cells alive.

35697993.mechanism: Less HMGB1 preserves barrier, limits immune cell entry
35697993.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results demonstrate that HMGB1 derived from astrocytes aggravates EAE by directly influencing the immune cell infiltration-associated functions of BMECs.
35697993.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting HMGB1 from astrocytes reduced disease severity and demyelination, with fewer immune cells entering the central nervous system.

35689766.mechanism: Sulfatide suppresses proliferation of activated human T cells
35689766.conclusion_quote: Therefore, it is plausible that progression of MS is associated with an escape from the immune-regulatory effect of sulfatide.
35689766.summary: In lab tests with human T cells, the myelin fat sulfatide suppressed T cell growth, but this effect was weaker in MS patients with higher disability.

34357453.mechanism: Not applicable: imaging method, no treatment tested
34357453.conclusion_quote: The results of this first in vivo implementation of the MEX sequence provide a quantitative measure of demyelination in brain white matter.
34357453.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, a new MRI method detected less myelin in the corpus callosum, agreeing with tissue analysis.

35859627.conclusion_quote: The data suggest that up-regulation of Nf expression in the retinal ganglion cells precedes development of RNFL atrophy and plausibly explains the transient increase of axonal diameter and RNFL thickening.
35859627.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, retinas from animals with optic neuritis had higher neurofilament levels, possibly explaining temporary retinal thickening.

35816000.conclusion_quote: The TMEV model is one of the first translational, infection-driven, experimental platforms to allow for the investigation of the mechanisms of epilepsy development as a consequence of CNS infection.
35816000.summary: Mice infected with Theiler's virus were used as a model of infection caused epilepsy, describing seizure monitoring, brain damage and inflammation, without testing any treatment.

35718292.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the effects on the hypothalamus-pituitary-gonadal axis depend on the differences between the demyelinating processes, their progression, and even individual factors, and it is thus important that fertility treatments are individualized to maximize therapeutic effects.
35718292.summary: In taiep rats, a model of progressive demyelination, hypothalamic kisspeptin expression differed by sex and serum LH fell in both sexes.

35930633.mechanism: Binds Foxo1 blocking its dephosphorylation, promoting Th17 differentiation
35930633.conclusion_quote: Our study provides mechanistic insight into the interaction of lncRNA and transcriptional factor in determining T cell subset differentiation during T cell-mediated autoimmune diseases.
35930633.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the lncRNA GM gene protected animals from disease by reducing harmful immune T cell activity through Foxo1 regulation.

35304225.mechanism: inhibits Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation
35304225.conclusion_quote: This research revealed that compound 5 could be a promising avenue as potential MS inhibitor.
35304225.summary: In mice with EAE, an artemisinin derivative called compound 5 reduced disease severity and limited immune cells that drive MS inflammation.

36001340.mechanism: Enzyme cascade converts soy lecithin into engineered liposomes
36001340.conclusion_quote: Thereby, this study will contribute to application of functional fatty acids and their derivatives as well as valorization of lecithin for the food and cosmetic industries.
36001340.summary: Enzymes were used to convert soy lecithin into liposomes carrying fatty alcohols for food and cosmetic uses, with no animal or MS model.

34748963.mechanism: Macrophage uptake of antigen-nanoparticles induces tolerance, regulatory T cells
34748963.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that targeting nano-conjugated autoantigens to tissue-resident macrophages in lymphoid organs can effectively suppress autoimmunity.
34748963.summary: In mice with EAE, a very low dose of myelin antigen attached to silica nanoparticles reduced disease more effectively than a much higher dose of free antigen.

35861698.mechanism: removes calcium channel subunit ORAI3 from immune cells
35861698.conclusion_quote: We conclude that despite its expression in myeloid and lymphoid cells, ORAI3 appears to be dispensable or redundant for physiological and pathological immune responses mediated by these cells.
35861698.summary: In mice lacking Orai3, immune cell calcium signaling and immune responses were normal, including no change in EAE, a mouse model of MS.

36114624.mechanism: Tests whether copper loss drives cuprizone myelin damage
36114624.conclusion_quote: The demyelinating effects of CPZ are not due to Cu deficiency but are instead consistent with acute toxicity of a CPZ + Cu complex.
36114624.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, the study found that the damage is not caused by copper deficiency but by toxicity of a cuprizone and copper complex.

35395486.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes retinal damage in disease
35395486.conclusion_quote: The retinal pathology that ensues from spontaneous optic neuritis in OSE mice mirrors that seen following human optic neuritis and may be a useful model for screening neuroprotective compounds for MOGAD and other diseases with optic neuritis.
35395486.summary: In mice with spontaneous opticospinal EAE, optic nerve inflammation and reactive astrogliosis developed, and retinal ganglion cells were lost, with about half gone by 10 weeks.

35343645.mechanism: Peptide represses miR-31, promoting regulatory T cell differentiation
35343645.conclusion_quote: Our results reveal an indispensable role of miPEP31 in maintaining immune homeostasis by promoting T reg differentiation and also present a potential therapeutic peptide for modulating miRNA expression and treating autoimmune diseases.
35343645.summary: In mice with EAE, a peptide made from a microRNA gene increased regulatory T cells and strongly reduced the autoimmune attack on the nervous system.

35696849.mechanism: Loss of ERAD promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
35696849.conclusion_quote: Thus, this study declared that the dysfunction of Sel1L in ERAD in T cells exacerbated the severity of EAE and indicated the important role of ERQC in maintaining immune homeostasis in the central nervous system.
35696849.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Sel1L from T cells made disease more severe, promoting Th1 and Th17 immune cell development.

36577829.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
36577829.conclusion_quote: Both D. missionum and P. lindneri were positive for A. marginale in tick-free areas, and the implications are discussed in this report.
36577829.summary: Researchers tested horseflies from Uruguay for the cattle pathogen Anaplasma marginale and found it in four species. The study has no connection to multiple sclerosis.

34914635.mechanism: Deletion blocks IMP2-driven CCL2 mRNA stabilization
34914635.conclusion_quote: These data showed that posttranscriptional control of Ccl2 in stromal cells by IMP2 was required to permit IL-17-driven progression of EAE pathogenesis.
34914635.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the protein IMP2 from stromal cells reduced CCL2 chemokine production, blocked immune cell recruitment, and protected mice from brain and spinal cord inflammation.

36279665.mechanism: Blocks STAT1 activation, reducing inflammatory M1 microglia
36279665.conclusion_quote: This study showed that BAI might inhibit the polarization of microglia/macrophages to the M1 phenotype in EAE mice by targeting STAT1.
36279665.summary: Mice with EAE given baicalein, a plant flavonoid, had delayed symptoms and less demyelination by blocking STAT1 and harmful M1 microglia activation.

35559385.mechanism: Loss of CD24 boosts regulatory T cell suppression
35559385.conclusion_quote: Thus, CD24 on Treg cells regulates their suppressive functions.
35559385.summary: In mice lacking CD24, regulatory T cells suppressed the development of EAE, a mouse model of multiple sclerosis, more strongly than normal regulatory T cells.

35410629.mechanism: No treatment tested, imaging study only
35410629.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings highlight a new aspect of neuroinflammatory pathology, revealing a significant degree of hypoxia in EAE in vivo that is accompanied by changes in spinal vascular perfusion.
35410629.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, imaging showed the spinal cord had less oxygen and blood flow than healthy mice, with a sparser perfused blood vessel network.

35030295.mechanism: Not applicable: describes a tissue RNA extraction method only
35030295.conclusion_quote: Proper performance of these steps is critical to achieving a sufficient yield of transcriptomic-quality spinal cord RNA when combined with final isolation using commercially available kits.
35030295.summary: This protocol describes how to remove and grind mouse spinal cords, including those from EAE mice, to obtain high quality RNA for later analysis.

35631676.mechanism: Inhibits PDE4 and PDE7 enzymes in immune cells
35631676.conclusion_quote: Compound 34 displayed a high efficacy in all three animal models of ADs.
35631676.summary: In mice with an animal model of MS, a new experimental drug that blocks two immune-cell enzymes reduced disease signs and progression.

34819358.mechanism: binds Act1 to block IL-17RA signaling
34819358.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these data indicate that TICAM-1 inhibits the interaction between IL-17RA and Act1 and functions as a negative regulator in IL-17A-mediated inflammatory responses.
34819358.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the TICAM-1 gene worsened inflammation and immune cell buildup in the spinal cord by boosting IL-17 signaling.

35659311.conclusion_quote: Taken together, we demonstrate the utility of CEST MRI signal changes in superficial cervical LNs as a complementary imaging biomarker for monitoring disease activity in MS.
35659311.summary: In mice with EAE, a noninvasive MRI method called CEST tracked changes in neck lymph nodes that matched disease activity and lymph node metabolite levels.

35488490.mechanism: removes Cdk7 from oligodendrocytes, altering myelin maintenance
35488490.conclusion_quote: Altogether, we identified novel functions for Cdk7 in CNS myelination.
35488490.summary: In mice lacking Cdk7 in myelin-producing cells, adult animals had thinner myelin and abnormal clasping, suggesting Cdk7 helps maintain healthy myelin.

35940634.mechanism: Loss of RNA-binding protein blocks IL-17-driven autoimmune pathology
35940634.conclusion_quote: Therefore, Arid5a-dependent signals mediate pathology in autoimmunity and yet are not required for immunity to candidiasis, indicating that selective targeting of IL-17 signaling pathway components may be a viable strategy for development of therapeutics that spare IL-17-driven host defense.
35940634.summary: In mice engineered to lack the Arid5a gene, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis was fully prevented while resistance to fungal infection stayed normal.

36341389.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that gut infiltration of Th17 cells and recruitment of neutrophils are associated with the development of gut dysbiosis and intestinal inflammation, and that fecal Lcn-2 level is a sensitive biological indicator for gut dysbiosis in multiple sclerosis.
36341389.summary: In mice with spontaneous EAE and in MS patients, elevated fecal Lcn-2 levels tracked gut inflammation and reduced gut bacterial diversity, suggesting it as an indicator.

35869475.mechanism: Raises hippocampal BDNF via AKT and CREB signaling
35869475.conclusion_quote: DMF improved the cognitive dysfunction of hypothyroid rats by increasing the level of BDNF in the brain tissue of hypothyroid rats.
35869475.summary: In rats with an underactive thyroid, dimethyl fumarate, a multiple sclerosis drug, improved learning and memory by raising brain BDNF levels, but the model is not MS.

36577999.mechanism: Binds ASC and blocks inflammasome assembly
36577999.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results identify LND as a broad-spectrum inflammasome inhibitor by directly targeting ASC, providing a novel candidate drug for the treatment of inflammasome-driven diseases in clinic.
36577999.summary: In mice with EAE, a cancer drug called lonidamine reduced inflammation by binding to ASC and blocking inflammasome assembly.

35644788.mechanism: Not a treatment study, describes proteomic changes
35644788.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results indicate that continuous CPZ-feeding, which evokes a slow demyelination, results in proteomic changes that precede any clear histological changes in the visual pathway and that these proteoforms may be potential early markers of degenerative demyelinating conditions.
35644788.summary: In mice fed the toxin cuprizone to cause slow damage to myelin, researchers found protein changes in the visual pathway before visible tissue damage appeared.

35019269.mechanism: radioactive tracer binds myelin for SPECT imaging
35019269.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that [ 123 I]1,3,4-PODP-DM may be a potential SPECT probe for imaging myelin in MS.
35019269.summary: In mice with EAE and brain demyelination caused by lysophosphatidylcholine, a radioactive tracer called PODP-DM showed promise for imaging myelin loss with SPECT scans.

35313042.mechanism: Extra Aire impairs self-reactive T cell deletion
35313042.conclusion_quote: Thus, not only loss of function of AIRE/Aire but also augmented and/or dysregulated expression of AIRE/Aire should be considered for the pathogenesis of organ-specific autoimmunity.
35313042.summary: In mice with EAE, extra copies of the Aire gene worsened disease scores and weakened removal of self-reactive T cells in the thymus.

36082828.mechanism: Restrains myeloid-derived suppressor cell expansion and differentiation
36082828.conclusion_quote: PLY may be an excellent candidate for the treatment of MS and other autoimmune diseases.
36082828.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, pseudolycorine chloride reduced spinal cord inflammation, demyelination and Th17 cell infiltration, easing disease severity.

35020849.mechanism: deletes RORγt positive regulatory T cells in mice
35020849.conclusion_quote: Taken together, it appears that Tr17 cells play a crucial role in the regulation of autoimmune arthritis.
35020849.summary: In mice with arthritis induced by collagen, deleting RORγt positive regulatory T cells prolonged the disease, showing these cells help control joint inflammation.

34196695.conclusion_quote: This study provides new insight into the pathophysiology of fragile X syndrome and identifies a new pathway for drug intervention for this debilitating disorder.
34196695.summary: In a mouse model of fragile X syndrome, the drug VSN16R reversed repetitive behaviour, hyperactivity and memory deficits. No model of multiple sclerosis was used.

36225395.mechanism: Activates Nrf2, reduces inflammatory cytokines and p38 MAPK signaling
36225395.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that DMF prevented the development of PIPN in rats through the activation of Nrf2 and the inhibition of p38 MAPK and BDNF.
36225395.summary: Dimethyl fumarate, a drug approved for multiple sclerosis, reduced nerve pain and inflammation in rats given paclitaxel chemotherapy.

35362723.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that phenytoin stimulates the proliferation of OPCs, re-establishes the oligodendroglial population, promotes myelin recovery in the corpus callosum, and improves motor coordination and muscle strength.
35362723.summary: In mice demyelinated with cuprizone, phenytoin increased oligodendrocyte precursor cells and myelin basic protein, improving motor coordination and muscle strength.

35275752.mechanism: Loss of Bat3 in dendritic cells boosts steroidogenesis, suppressing T cells
35275752.conclusion_quote: Our findings identified Bat3 as an endogenous regulator of DC function, which has implications for DC-based immunotherapies.
35275752.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the Bat3 gene from dendritic immune cells reduced harmful T cell responses and lessened disease.

35614392.conclusion_quote: T4-treated rat pups had increased MBP expression levels and higher MRI fractional anisotropy values, both indications of accelerated myelination.
35614392.summary: In neonatal rat pups, thyroxine injections sped up brain myelin development, shown by higher myelin protein levels and stronger MRI white matter measures, suggesting a test model for promyelinating drugs.

36569489.mechanism: saponins alter immune cells and regulate immune system
36569489.conclusion_quote: It could be inferred that this fractions are promising candidates for further investigation as dose-dependent immune system regulating compounds in multiple sclerosis patients.
36569489.summary: In an EAE animal model of multiple sclerosis, plant fractions from asparagus eased clinical signs, protected movement, and increased myelin in the brain.

35031916.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, reducing inflammation and tau pathology
35031916.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the potential of fingolimod as a multimodal therapeutic for the treatment of AD.
35031916.summary: In mice with an Alzheimer's model, the MS drug fingolimod started after symptoms improved memory and reduced inflammation and tau and APP proteins.

35861689.conclusion_quote: This study showed an interaction between hippocampal structural and functional networks in explaining spatial learning and memory in the early stages of MS.
35861689.summary: Male and female rats with ethidium bromide induced demyelination showed hippocampal cell death, reduced neurogenesis, and poorer spatial memory, movement, and coordination.

36214341.mechanism: Rapamycin induces autophagy, protecting against cell death
36214341.conclusion_quote: Taken together, oxidative stress was involved in LPC-induced apoptosis of mouse TM3 Leydig cells, and autophagy might play a protective role in LPC-induced apoptosis.
36214341.summary: In mouse Leydig cells grown in a dish, a fat molecule called lysophosphatidylcholine caused cell death through oxidative stress, while autophagy offered some protection. This is not an MS study.

35963325.mechanism: Cathodal stimulation lowers inflammatory cells in optic nerve
35963325.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that tDCS may exert an anti-inflammatory effect with potential therapeutic application to be further explored in autoimmune demyelinating diseases.
35963325.summary: In mice with EAE, a preventive course of cathodal brain stimulation reduced optic nerve inflammation, axon loss, and delays in visual signals before motor symptoms appeared.

35688339.mechanism: Raises Mfn2 protein, suppressing microglial inflammatory activation
35688339.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results indicate that Mfn2 is an essential immunomodulator conferring the anti-inflammatory effects of CBD.
35688339.summary: In mice with EAE and in cell cultures, cannabidiol reduced inflammation and microglial activation through the protein Mfn2, and blocking Mfn2 cancelled its benefits.

35536323.mechanism: Removing AQP4 impairs edema clearance and blood retina barrier
35536323.conclusion_quote: Therefore, AQP4 expression might be critical for retinal Müller cells to clear the interstitial space from excess vasogenic edema and prevent maladaptive scarring in the retina during remote inflammatory processes of the CNS.
35536323.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the AQP4 water channel worsened retinal swelling, leakage, scarring, and nerve cell loss.

35330085.mechanism: Gold nanoparticles deliver EGF to expand precursor cells
35330085.conclusion_quote: EGF-GNPs enhance the expression of myelin-associated proteins and improve the motor coordination in mice.
35330085.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, brain-injected gold nanoparticles carrying EGF increased myelin proteins and improved motor coordination.

35130806.mechanism: not applicable, compares tissue fixation methods
35130806.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that IV perfusion of mice with 10% NBF and 4% PFA are similar and adequate fixation techniques in this model.
35130806.summary: In mice with EAE, perfusing with 10% formalin gave results similar to 4% paraformaldehyde for tissue analysis, so both fixatives are adequate for this model.

34543449.mechanism: Activates CB2 receptor, reducing T cell cytokine production
34543449.conclusion_quote: Lenabasum exerts potent T cell-mediated immunomodulatory effects, suggesting CB2 as a promising pharmacological target to counteract neuroinflammation in MS.
34543449.summary: Lenabasum, a drug that activates the CB2 receptor, calmed T cell inflammation in blood from MS patients and reduced disease severity in mice with EAE.

35245521.mechanism: Removes ceramide kinase, reducing ceramide-1-phosphate production
35245521.conclusion_quote: CerK knockout, which did not affect developmental changes in MRPs, ameliorated the motor dysfunction, loss of MRPs, and demyelination in the brain in CPZ-treated mice.
35245521.summary: In mice given cuprizone to mimic MS, removing the CerK gene reduced motor problems and loss of myelin in the brain.

34453118.mechanism: Blocks MTH1, damaging activated T cell DNA
34453118.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we show proof of concept of the existence of MTH1 high and MTH1 low activated T cells, and that MTH1 inhibition by TH1579 selectively suppresses pro-inflammatory activated T cells.
34453118.summary: In human T cells and mice with EAE, a drug called TH1579 blocked the MTH1 enzyme, selectively killing overactive immune T cells and easing disease.

35589920.mechanism: Not applicable, descriptive study of sex effects
35589920.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrate an important regulatory role of sex chromosomes, independent of gonadal sex, on sex-biased hippocampal transcriptomic and epigenomic profiles.
35589920.summary: Healthy mice were studied to separate the effects of sex chromosomes from hormones on hippocampal gene activity, with no MS model used.

34896483.mechanism: Modulates proinflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokine expression
34896483.conclusion_quote: These data demonstrates that nobiletin has a potential to attenuate inflammation in EAE mouse model.
34896483.summary: In mice with EAE, the citrus compound nobiletin given before or after disease onset reduced inflammatory cytokines such as TNF and interleukin 6 in the brain and spinal cord.

35949308.mechanism: Targets Nrf2 and NF-kB pathways, reducing oxidative stress
35949308.conclusion_quote: These data support the suggestion that the beneficial properties of DAP on the CPZ-induced demyelination are mediated by targeting Nrf2 and NF-kB pathways.
35949308.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice modeling demyelination, dapsone reduced myelin loss and improved motor performance, likely by acting on Nrf2 and NF-kB pathways.

35635470.conclusion_quote: Overall, the two-point injection of lysophosphatidylcholine via a stereotaxic frame is a stable and reproducible method to generate a demyelination model in mice for further study.
35635470.summary: This study describes a surgical method that injects lysophosphatidylcholine into mice to create reproducible brain demyelination, a model relevant to multiple sclerosis research.

36183445.conclusion_quote: Western countries, especially European countries, the USA, and Canada lead the way in research and scientific collaboration on the subject of MS treatment.
36183445.summary: This bibliometric study counted and mapped about 5,000 published articles on multiple sclerosis treatment from 1980 to 2021, finding that Western countries lead research.

35086052.mechanism: Delivered intranasally to brain, reduces astrocyte activation and demyelination
35086052.conclusion_quote: It seems that IN administration of FTY720 may be a preferred route to decline the central inflammation and demyelination levels in the MS patients.
35086052.summary: In rats with a lysolecithin-induced demyelinated lesion in the optic chiasm, intranasal fingolimod reduced inflammation and myelin loss more than oral dosing did.

35016995.mechanism: Not applicable, air pollution exposure study
35016995.conclusion_quote: These findings collectively suggest that inhaled MVE-exposure may mediate estrogen receptor expression alterations associated with increased CD4+/CD8+ infiltration, regional demyelination, and ROS production in the CNS of female ApoE -/- mice.
35016995.summary: In female ApoE knockout mice, breathing traffic exhaust for 30 days increased immune T cells, oxidative stress, and myelin damage in the brain, with reduced estrogen receptor expression.

34787332.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that AMs may play a role in the interaction between Ol and Th1 cells.
34787332.summary: In mice with EAE, oligodendrocytes raised adhesion molecules when contacting T cells, and blocking ICAM-1 in lab cultures reduced the number of T cells making contact.

34935149.mechanism: blocks CSF-1R signaling, reducing microglia population
34935149.conclusion_quote: These results should be taken into account when proposing the modulation of microglial activation in the design of therapies relevant for demyelinating diseases.
34935149.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, the drug BLZ945 reduced microglia and myelin loss but worsened nerve fiber degeneration and did not improve behavior.

34634393.mechanism: Loss of TTR speeds remyelination and thickens myelin
34634393.conclusion_quote: TTR null mice displayed expedited rates of early re-myelination, preferentially re-myelinating smaller axons compared to those of wild type mice.
34634393.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, removing the TTR gene sped early myelin repair and produced thicker myelin than normal mice.

36345651.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the effects of muscle absence on prenatal murine skeletogenesis reduced in severity over gestation.
36345651.summary: This study looked at mouse embryos without limb muscles and found that their bones and joints partly recovered in shape as development progressed. It does not involve multiple sclerosis.

35777910.mechanism: Lowers Th17 cells, alters dendritic cell function
35777910.conclusion_quote: This study suggests that NFIL3 deficiency could alleviate MOG35-55-induced EAE through regulating different immune cell subsets, which is not only related with adaptive immunity and innate immunity, but also related with the cross-talk between them, especially CD4 + T cells and CD11c + dendritic cells.
35777910.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the NFIL3 gene lowered harmful Th17 immune cells, reducing inflammation and demyelination in the brain and spinal cord.

36044851.mechanism: Overexpression restores TCF7L2 transcription and myelin gene expression
36044851.conclusion_quote: These data causally link impaired TCF7L2-dependent transcription to the poor development and homeostatic retention of myelin in HD and provide a mechanism for its therapeutic restoration.
36044851.summary: In Huntington disease mice, boosting the Tcf7l2 gene restored myelin gene activity and sped myelin repair after cuprizone-induced demyelination.

36001972.conclusion_quote: This catalog of oligodendrocyte activation states (http://research-pub.gene.com/OligoLandscape/) will be important to understand disease progression and develop therapeutic interventions.
36001972.summary: Researchers used single cell sequencing of mouse models of Alzheimer's and multiple sclerosis, plus human MS data, to identify three activation states of myelin making oligodendrocyte cells.

36100764.mechanism: Protects lipid droplets from lipolysis-mediated degradation
36100764.conclusion_quote: In summary, we identify PLIN2 as a novel therapeutic target to prevent the pathogenic accumulation of LDs in foamy phagocytes and to stimulate remyelination.
36100764.summary: In mice lacking the Plin2 gene, fat droplets in immune cells broke down faster and myelin repair improved in a cuprizone demyelination model.

36499770.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes calpain changes
36499770.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the calpain-calpastatin system has putative roles in myelination and demyelinating diseases of peripheral nerves.
36499770.summary: Researchers measured calpain and its inhibitor calpastatin in rat and mouse nerves during myelin formation and after myelin damage, finding distinct changes in each setting.

36142668.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte precursor cell survival and myelin repair
36142668.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, stemazole promoted OPC survival in vitro and remyelination in vivo, suggesting that this compound may be used as a therapeutic agent against demyelinating disease.
36142668.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, the small molecule stemazole improved precursor cell survival and myelin repair along with motor recovery.

35185874.mechanism: Gut bacteria signal circulating immune cells to reduce inflammation
35185874.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate that an orally-delivered, non-viable strain of commensal bacteria can mediate potent anti-inflammatory effects in peripheral tissues through transient occupancy of the gastrointestinal tract, and support the development of non-living bacterial strains for therapeutic applications.
35185874.summary: In mice with EAE and other inflammatory diseases, an orally given killed gut bacteria strain reduced inflammation without settling in the gut.

35758525.mechanism: Loss of receptor speeds oligodendrocyte maturation and remyelination via MAPK/ER
35758525.conclusion_quote: Our study suggests that deleting or blocking GPR149 might be an intriguing way to promote myelin repair in demyelinating diseases.
35758525.summary: In mice lacking the GPR149 gene, myelin formed earlier and regenerated faster after cuprizone-induced demyelination, suggesting this receptor normally slows myelin repair.

33954959.mechanism: Antioxidant that reduces cuprizone-induced myelin damage
33954959.conclusion_quote: In the light of the above results, it could be concluded that NAC has neuroprotective effects and has the potential to be a novel therapeutic approach for the treatment of demyelinating diseases such as multiple sclerosis; however, treatment should begin as soon as the disease manifests.
33954959.summary: In rats given cuprizone to cause demyelination, taking N-acetylcysteine together with it protected myelin better than taking it afterward.

35034439.mechanism: Binds viral capsid, blocking host cell entry
35034439.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the lignin inhibits viral entry to host cells through interactions with the capsid surface.
35034439.summary: Antiviral lignin from sugarcane bagasse blocked several viruses from entering cells in laboratory tests. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis or demyelination.

34935529.mechanism: Lowers inflammation and boosts myelin gene expression
34935529.conclusion_quote: The outcomes demonstrated that fluoxetine reduces inflammation and strengthens the endogenous myelination in the LPC-induced demyelination model; however, supplementary studies are required for specifying the details of its mechanisms.
34935529.summary: In rats with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, fluoxetine reduced brain inflammation and increased myelin repair in the corpus callosum.

35705491.mechanism: Loss of PRMT1 reduces MHC-associated regenerative microglia
35705491.conclusion_quote: Overall, our findings demonstrate that PRMT1 is a critical regulator of the MHC- and IFN-associated microglia, necessary for central nervous system remyelination.
35705491.summary: In mice with diet-induced demyelination from cuprizone, deleting PRMT1 from microglia impaired myelin repair and reduced immune cells that help remyelination.

35507058.conclusion_quote: Molecular imaging of CNS fibrin deposition provides an imaging biomarker for inflammatory CNS pathology, which corresponds to pathophysiological ECM remodelling and disease activity, and yields high signal-to-noise ratio, which can improve diagnostic neuroimaging across several neurological diseases with variable degrees of barrier impairment.
35507058.summary: Researchers used a fibrin targeting MRI contrast agent to detect fibrin deposits in mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, and found it tracked inflammation and disability.

34365252.mechanism: Not applicable, analytical chemistry method only
34365252.conclusion_quote: The results obtained in three real samples and two spikes were compared with those of UV-Vis spectrophotometry, used as a reference method, and they show the potential of the proposed method for the accurate determination of copper.
34365252.summary: A smartphone-based photometric method was developed to measure copper in sugarcane spirits and matched a standard lab spectrophotometer. No animal or human MS models were used.

36266052.mechanism: Suppress immune responses and migrate to CNS to reduce inflammation
36266052.conclusion_quote: Altogether, these results suggest a defect in the number and function of CD8 + CD45RC low Tregs during MS relapse and an association of CD8 + CD45RC low Tregs dysfunction with MS severity.
36266052.summary: In patients with MS, a regulatory immune cell type was found to be altered, and transferred versions of these cells reduced inflammation in mice with EAE.

35467573.mechanism: Gadolinium contrast agents, brain retention and toxicity compared
35467573.conclusion_quote: In the EAE model, neuroinflammation promoted increased Gd retention in the brain for both GBCAs.
35467573.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the linear contrast agent gadopentetate stayed in the brain longer and was toxic to brain tissue in lab tests, unlike gadobutrol.

35366978.mechanism: Not applicable, describes a lab culture model
35366978.conclusion_quote: Therefore, this report provides an in-depth description for the generation and maintenance of ex vivo organotypic cerebellar cultures for demyelination-remyelination studies with a focus on practical tips for scientists that are new to this technique.
35366978.summary: This methods paper explains how to grow cerebellar slice cultures, a lab model where myelin is damaged and repaired, with practical tips for beginners.

36072569.mechanism: binds extracellular matrix at demyelinating lesion sites
36072569.conclusion_quote: These results demonstrate the selective targeting of CAQK to demyelinating injuries under multiple conditions and confirm the previously reported association with the ECM.
36072569.summary: In mice with three demyelination models, a small peptide called CAQK, injected into the bloodstream, selectively accumulated at myelin damage sites, mainly in surrounding extracellular matrix.

35105686.mechanism: Activates PPARγ signaling, promoting oligodendrocyte maturation and myelin produ
35105686.conclusion_quote: Our work demonstrated that BA promotes myelin production and regeneration by activating the PPARγ signal pathway and also confirmed that BA is an effective natural product for the treatment of demyelinating diseases.
35105686.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the natural flavonoid baicalin helped nerve-insulating myelin regrow and improved movement coordination, acting through the PPARγ pathway.

36248632.mechanism: high phenylalanine induces demyelination and microglial activation
36248632.conclusion_quote: The results suggest that prolonged exposure to high Phe concentrations can induce microglial activation preceding significant disruption of myelin.
36248632.summary: In mouse cerebellar tissue slices grown in the lab, prolonged exposure to high phenylalanine, as seen in phenylketonuria, reduced myelin and increased activated microglia, the brain's immune cells.

35093477.conclusion_quote: These data provide important insight on the common and unique global changes in expression of cellular senescence genes in the CNS accompanying aging, injury or disease.
35093477.summary: In mice, researchers compared aging, Alzheimer's disease and demyelination models, finding each condition showed its own pattern of cellular senescence gene activity.

interventions: an absorption enhancer containing a combination of lysophospholipids, monoglycerides and synthetic emulsifiers
36611697.mechanism: improves nutrient absorption and digestion in the gut
36611697.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these studies demonstrate that the addition of an absorption enhancer containing a combination of lysophospholipids, monoglycerides and synthetic emulsifiers can improve growth performance in growing pigs, driven by increased nutrient digestibility and retention.
36611697.summary: This feed-additive study in growing pigs found improved digestion and growth, but it does not study multiple sclerosis or any disease model of it.

36198499.mechanism: Deletes Olig2, impairing oligodendrocyte maturation and remyelination
36198499.conclusion_quote: Together, by leveraging multiple immature OL-expressing Cre lines, these studies indicate that Olig2 is essential for differentiation and myelination of immature OLs and myelin repair.
36198499.summary: In mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, removing Olig2 from immature oligodendrocytes impaired myelin formation and repair, contrary to earlier reports.

33928565.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes EAE induction protocol
33928565.conclusion_quote: Here, after introducing the model, we describe the protocol to induce active EAE in inbred mice, we report on a table the different clinical courses of EAE depending on the combination of antigen /mouse strain and we provide indications on how to evaluate the clinics and pathology of this induced disease.
33928565.summary: This methods chapter explains how to induce EAE, the standard mouse model of multiple sclerosis, and how to score its clinical signs and pathology.

34170637.mechanism: Not applicable: review of animal models
34170637.conclusion_quote: No single animal model accurately reflects the complexity of human MS pathogenesis.
34170637.summary: This review describes common animal models of MS, including EAE, Theiler's virus and cuprizone models, and the factors that affect how well they predict human disease.

34870901.mechanism: Not applicable, describes gut microbiome analysis methods
34870901.conclusion_quote: These results highlight the importance of accounting for consistent environmental conditions when inducing EAE and other animal models of disease.
34870901.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, this protocol analyzed gut microbiome composition and found that mice raised in different animal facilities developed EAE to different degrees.

33551096.mechanism: Blocks MAP kinase, reducing chromosome loss and oxidation
33551096.conclusion_quote: Interventions that mitigate chromosomal instability may have therapeutic value in MS.
33551096.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug PD98059 reduced chromosome-loss micronuclei and oxidative damage, suggesting possible therapeutic value.

34335622.mechanism: Ectopic SKI expression suppresses pathogenic Th17 cell differentiation
34335622.conclusion_quote: Therefore, our study provides valuable insights of targeting SKI to modulate pathogenic Th17 cell function and treat Th17-related diseases.
34335622.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, adding the SKI gene to T cells blocked harmful Th17 cells and reduced disease severity.

34948360.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results reinforce the involvement of S100B in the development of animal models of multiple sclerosis and propose AA targeting the S100B protein as a focused potential drug to be considered for multiple sclerosis treatment.
34948360.summary: In mice with chronic EAE, arundic acid, which reduces astrocyte production of S100B, lessened disease severity and reduced spinal cord inflammation, astrocyte activation and demyelination.

33752802.mechanism: Prolongs integrated stress response, protecting oligodendrocytes and promoting d
33752802.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings indicate that prolonging the ISR protects remyelinating oligodendrocytes and promotes remyelination in the presence of inflammation, suggesting that ISR enhancement may provide reparative benefit to MS patients.
33752802.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination plus inflammation, boosting the integrated stress response with Sephin1 and bazedoxifene improved myelin repair.

33480040.mechanism: Blocks CysLTR1 receptor, reducing Th17 cell development
33480040.conclusion_quote: Our findings strongly suggest that targeting Th17 response by inhibiting CysLTR1 signalling could be a promising therapeutic strategy for the treatment of MS and CNS inflammatory diseases.
33480040.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug montelukast blocked a leukotriene receptor, reducing harmful Th17 immune cells and easing disease and myelin loss.

34499922.mechanism: Removes eosinophils by deleting GATA1 double-GATA motif
34499922.conclusion_quote: Taken together, despite their enhanced abundance in the inflamed spinal cord during disease progression, eosinophils were dispensable for EAE development.
34499922.summary: In mice with EAE, removing eosinophils through a genetic change did not alter spinal cord inflammation, demyelination, or disease severity.

34374656.mechanism: inhibits Pin1, suppressing pathogenic Th1 and Th17 cells
34374656.conclusion_quote: Pin1 inhibitors therefore hold great promise for autoimmune disease and MS therapy.
34374656.summary: In mice with EAE, the Pin1 inhibitor juglone reduced disease severity, inflammation and demyelination by suppressing harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells.

34557140.mechanism: Suppresses dendritic cell activation and Th17 cell differentiation
34557140.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results show that silybin has high potential for the development of a novel therapeutic agent for the treatment of autoimmune diseases such as MS.
34557140.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS animal model, silybin from milk thistle reduced disease severity and inflammation by dampening dendritic cells and Th17 immune cells.

34385001.mechanism: Inhibits NF-κB signaling and glycolysis, favoring M2 macrophages
34385001.conclusion_quote: Overall, these findings provided important insights into the mechanisms through which EGCG may mediate MS.
34385001.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the green tea compound EGCG reduced disease severity and shifted macrophages away from inflammatory M1 types toward calming M2 types.

33517175.mechanism: Not applicable, biomarker imaging study only
33517175.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that ELTD1 may be a promising biomarker for CNS-inflammation in MS.
33517175.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found the ELTD1 protein in brain tissue and used MRI to show blood-brain barrier leakage and altered blood flow.

34087999.conclusion_quote: The iPSC line can serve as a valuable resource to generate cellular model systems to investigate molecular mechanisms underlying RRMS.
34087999.summary: Scientists turned blood cells from a man aged 25 with relapsing multiple sclerosis into stem cells, creating a human cell model for studying the disease.

34803461.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes immune and gene changes
34803461.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, for the first-time, involvement of both cellular immune response and antibody response as well as oligodendrocyte maturation and survival factors having role in demyelination and remyelination of cuprizone mouse model of MS have been shown.
34803461.summary: In mice given cuprizone to induce demyelination, immune cells and cytokines rose during demyelination and fell during remyelination, alongside changes in oligodendrocyte survival genes.

34688833.mechanism: reduces microglial activation and protects brain barrier integrity
34688833.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the current study suggests that (R)-ketamine could ameliorate EAE clinical scores and pathological changes in the spinal cord of EAE mice.
34688833.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the drug (R)-ketamine reduced weight loss, disease scores, spinal cord damage, and immune cell activation compared with saline.

34212377.mechanism: Gut microbial metabolite reduces neuron hyperexcitability ex vivo
34212377.conclusion_quote: Our study presents the first evidence of microbial-derived metabolite S-equol as a potential mechanism for alteration of TMEV-induced neuronal excitability.
34212377.summary: In mice infected with a virus that causes seizures, the gut bacteria product S-equol calmed overactive brain nerve cells in lab tests.

33925560.mechanism: Not a treatment, PET tracer binds activated microglia
33925560.conclusion_quote: 18 F-PBR-111 uptake in anatomic locations correlated with activated microglia at histology in the cuprizone mouse model of MS suggests that 18 F-PBR-111 has potential for in vivo evaluation of therapy response and potential for use in MS patients and animal studies.
33925560.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a PET scan tracer called 18F-PBR-111 showed higher uptake in brain regions with activated immune cells, suggesting it may help track disease.

33493617.mechanism: activates mitochondrial enzyme that detoxifies reactive aldehydes
33493617.conclusion_quote: Taken together, this study demonstrates the therapeutic efficacy of ALDH2-agonist Alda-1 in the abatement of EAE disease through the detoxification of reactive aldehydes, thus suggesting Alda-1 as a potential therapeutic intervention for MS.
33493617.summary: In mice with EAE, the drug Alda-1 given after disease onset reduced harmful aldehyde byproducts, improved motor function, and lessened myelin damage and nerve loss.

34371346.conclusion_quote: This iPSC line can be used as a healthy control in stem cell therapeutics and disease modeling studies.
34371346.summary: Researchers created a healthy control stem cell line from bone marrow cells with normal chromosomes, but did not study multiple sclerosis itself.

33981197.mechanism: Reduces immune infiltration and glial activation
33981197.conclusion_quote: These results suggested that fingolimod exerts neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects on the retina and optic nerve in a mouse model of EAE.
33981197.summary: Researchers gave fingolimod to mice with EAE, a model of MS, and found it reduced optic nerve damage, death of nerve cells in the retina, and inflammation.

34364067.conclusion_quote: In the spinal cord of EAE mice, which is the mostly damaged region in this specific animal model, a preferential but transient accumulation of Gd is observed.
34364067.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the gadodiamide contrast agent built up more in the spinal cord than in the brain, and the retained gadolinium decreased over time.

34795677.mechanism: Env immunization attempts to induce neutralizing antibodies
34795677.conclusion_quote: Studies using mouse models are useful to gain insight in how HIV-specific neutralizing antibody responses are regulated in order to develop a protective HIV-1 vaccine.
34795677.summary: Researchers immunized mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, using HIV-1 envelope protein, but the mice did not develop protective neutralizing antibodies.

34253764.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes microglial gene expression
34253764.conclusion_quote: Our results provide additional evidence of regional and temporal heterogeneity in microglial gene expression patterns that may help in understanding mechanisms underlying various symptomology in MS.
34253764.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers mapped microglial gene activity in brain and spinal cord before and during symptoms, finding that patterns differ by region and stage.

34799286.mechanism: Increases Th1 retention in periphery via CXCR3 chemokines
34799286.conclusion_quote: Our data indicates that MA might have therapeutic implications for autoimmune diseases such as MS.
34799286.summary: In mice with EAE, a solvent called methyl acetate reduced disease severity and CNS inflammation by keeping Th1 immune cells in the periphery.

34723288.conclusion_quote: Therefore, here, we have made a sincere attempt to discuss the similarities and dissimilarities between cinnamon and GTB with a focus whether GTB has the potential to be considered as a substitute of cinnamon for neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative disorders.
34723288.summary: This paper discusses whether glyceryl tribenzoate, a food flavoring, could replace cinnamon for brain inflammation diseases, and reports it calms inflammation in astrocytes and macrophages.

33770444.mechanism: Inhibits dendritic cell antigen presentation and Th1/Th17 cytokines
33770444.conclusion_quote: Taken together, the data lead one to conclude that galangin could potentially be used as a potent immunoregulatory agent to alleviate clinical symptoms and reduce the prevalence of MS.
33770444.summary: Galangin, a plant flavonoid, lowered disease incidence and symptoms in mice with EAE, a model of MS, by calming immune cells that drive inflammation.

34633360.conclusion_quote: Here, we present the experimental protocol for a novel rat model of cortical demyelination allowing the investigation of the pathological and molecular mechanisms leading to cortical lesions.
34633360.summary: This paper describes a rat model where immunized animals receive injected inflammatory cytokines into the brain, causing widespread cortical demyelination, a grey matter damage seen in MS.

33721183.conclusion_quote: Background stress -particularly emotional type- exacerbates the demyelination caused by cuprizone treatment.
33721183.summary: In rats given the cuprizone toxin, prior stress worsened myelin loss and memory, with emotional stress causing the most harm and raising brain 3β-HSD gene activity.

34634742.mechanism: activates CB1 and CB2 cannabinoid receptors
34634742.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, both 15b and 38b significantly alleviated the phenotype of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) in mice.
34634742.summary: Two newly designed synthetic cannabinoids, 15b and 38b, eased symptoms in mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis.

34040141.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes imaging of demyelination
34040141.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, ultrahigh-field multiparameter MRI can reflect the pathological changes associated with and the underlying mechanisms of demyelination and remyelination in MS after the successful establishment of an acute CPZ-induced model.
34040141.summary: This study used 7.0 T MRI to image demyelination and remyelination in mice given cuprizone, a toxin that mimics MS, and found imaging changes matching tissue damage.

34384953.mechanism: Boosts autophagy, reduces ROS and NLRP3 inflammasome activity
34384953.conclusion_quote: AZD8055 ameliorated EAE through anti-inflammatory and anti-pyroptosis effects via the mammalian target of mTOR/ROS/NLRP3 pathway.
34384953.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the drug AZD8055 boosted autophagy, reduced inflammation and nerve damage, and improved symptoms.

33720130.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging method without a treatment
33720130.conclusion_quote: Myelin PET imaging is an interesting tool for monitoring in vivo changes in myelin content which could be useful for monitoring demyelinating disease progression and therapeutic response.
33720130.summary: In rats given lysolecithin injections, PET scans with a myelin tracer showed myelin loss at one week and recovery by four weeks.

33475965.conclusion_quote: Overall, data suggest that the unique feature of EAE progression in NOD mice is not due to proneness to demyelination or intrinsic defects in myelin formation.
33475965.summary: In mouse strains used to model EAE, researchers compared how well three strains lost and regained myelin after a toxin exposure, finding similar damage and repair across strains.

34205965.mechanism: Reduces neuroinflammation via CD73 and adenosine receptor signaling
34205965.conclusion_quote: Finally, increased glial A 1 R expression following CTBS supports anti-inflammatory adenosine actions and potentially contributes to the overall neuroprotective effect observed in EAE animals after CTBS treatment.
34205965.summary: Rats with EAE, a model of MS, received repeated magnetic stimulation over the skull after disease onset, which reduced spinal cord inflammation and appeared protective.

35111128.mechanism: Calms overactive nerve signals via calcium channel binding
35111128.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that this QuilA-EAE model is clearly of interest for studying pain symptom development and so could be used to identify and evaluate new therapeutic targets.
35111128.summary: In mice with relapsing remitting EAE, a model of MS, the nerve pain drug pregabalin reduced pain from light touch and eased heat hypersensitivity.

33891644.mechanism: removes dendritic cells, non-DCs present myelin antigen to T cells
33891644.conclusion_quote: Our findings demonstrate that constitutive or conditional ablation of CD11c+ DCs diminished self-tolerance to PLP autoantigen.
33891644.summary: In mice with EAE, removing dendritic cells made disease start earlier, showing other immune cells can also trigger attacks on myelin.

33894548.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease cell models
33894548.conclusion_quote: Thus, our study altogether offers both RRMS and PPMS iPSC cellular models as a good tool for better understanding of MS pathologies and drug testing.
33894548.summary: Researchers made stem cells from people with two MS types and found their nerve progenitor cells showed signs of cellular aging, offering a lab model for MS.

34312706.mechanism: No treatment tested, descriptive study only
34312706.conclusion_quote: In summary, the four DGK isozymes are involved in the EAE process.
34312706.summary: In rats with EAE, an MS model, brainstem levels of four diacylglycerol kinase enzymes dropped early, while several rose as signs worsened and returned to normal in recovery.

33621940.mechanism: Blocks eIF4E, suppressing Th17 cell differentiation
33621940.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings imply that miRNA-467b inhibits the differentiation and function of Th17 cells by targeting eIF4E, thereby alleviating EAE.
33621940.summary: In mice with EAE, injecting a microRNA mimic reduced Th17 immune cells, lessening inflammation and disease severity.

33566588.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes gut microbiota changes
33566588.conclusion_quote: Besides, the reported microbial changes replicate most of the characteristics that define the potential dysbiosis in MS patients.
33566588.summary: Mice with EAE or demyelination caused by a cuprizone diet showed major gut microbiome changes that resemble those seen in people with multiple sclerosis.

33493985.mechanism: Suppresses HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB inflammatory signaling in CNS and macrophages
33493985.conclusion_quote: Taken together, these findings demonstrate that MAT treatment alleviated CNS inflammatory demyelination and activation of astrocytes and microglia/macrophages in EAE rats, and that the mechanism underlying these effects may be closely related to modulation of HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway.
33493985.summary: In rats with EAE, the plant-derived compound matrine eased spinal cord inflammation and nerve damage by calming the HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB inflammatory pathway.

33391501.mechanism: neutralises immune-cell proBDNF, reducing inflammatory cytokines
33391501.conclusion_quote: The findings suggest that proBDNF from immune cells promotes the immunopathogenesis of MS.
33391501.summary: In mice with EAE and in blood and tissue from MS patients, antibodies blocking the immune-derived protein proBDNF reduced disease scores, demyelination and inflammation.

34591795.mechanism: Blocks CD47, reducing microglial phagocytosis and macrophage transition
34591795.conclusion_quote: In summary, Ab blockade of CD47 impaired resolution of CNS inflammation, thus worsening EAE.
34591795.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody blocking CD47 reduced immune cells entering the central nervous system but slowed paralysis recovery and remyelination.

33912166.mechanism: predicted gene targets regulated in EAE brain tissue
33912166.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study defined several possible matrine target genes, which can be further elucidated as mechanism(s) of matrine action, and novel targets in the treatment of MS.
33912166.summary: Researchers analyzed MS lesion gene data and tested matrine in mice with EAE, finding eight genes changed by matrine that may explain its effects.

34716181.mechanism: Reduces symmetric arginine dimethylation, altering T cell splicing and NFAT sign
34716181.conclusion_quote: This understanding may guide development of drugs targeting these processes to benefit patients with T cell-mediated diseases.
34716181.summary: In activated mouse T cells, changing the enzyme PRMT5 altered how genes are spliced and affected calcium and NFAT immune signaling linked to IL-2 production.

33526922.mechanism: Deletes fibrotic cells or interferon-gamma receptor
33526922.conclusion_quote: These data delineate a framework for understanding the CNS fibrotic response.
33526922.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing proliferating fibrotic cells or blocking their interferon-gamma signaling reduced scarring, increased oligodendrocyte cells, and lessened motor disability.

32914363.conclusion_quote: These observations suggest that L. casei can reduce proinflammatory cytokines and reduce demyelinating symptoms in the mouse model.
32914363.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a probiotic called Lactobacillus casei lowered the inflammatory signal IL-17 and eased demyelinating symptoms, both before and after cuprizone exposure.

34391817.mechanism: Reduces microglia activation and inflammation, preserving hippocampal interneuro
34391817.conclusion_quote: Overall, these data provide evidence that regular exercise improves cognitive function and synaptic and neuronal pathology that typically affect EAE/MS brains.
34391817.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, wheel running reduced hippocampal inflammation and nerve cell loss and improved memory.

32901254.conclusion_quote: Overall, this study demonstrates the relevance and feasibility of the marmoset EAE model to study cortical lesions, among the most important yet least understood features of MS.
32901254.summary: In marmosets with EAE, a model of MS, high field MRI scans revealed widespread cortical demyelination and captured 65 percent of lesions seen after death.

34200023.mechanism: No treatment tested, descriptive study only
34200023.conclusion_quote: Overall, we provide evidence for a phenotypic alteration of M1/M2 balance during MS, which can be of crucial importance not only for a better understanding of the immunopathology of this neurodegenerative disease but also to potentially develop new macrophage-centered therapeutic strategies.
34200023.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, immune cells called macrophages lost their calming form and shifted toward an inflammatory form that drives damage.

33815654.mechanism: Promotes microglia shift to anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype
33815654.conclusion_quote: Therefore, the neuroprotective effect of BSYS against MS/EAE was related to promoting microglia toward M2 polarization, which may be correlated with changes in miR-124 and miR-155 in vivo.
33815654.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the herbal medicine BSYS reduced nerve inflammation and myelin loss, likely by shifting microglia toward a calming M2 state.

34952601.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes pericyte behaviour
34952601.conclusion_quote: Our data suggest that pericytes seek to restore the BBB through increased coverage, but that their exposure to CSPGs prompt their facilitation of macrophages to enter the CNS to elevate neuroinflammation in EAE and MS.
34952601.summary: In mice with EAE and in human MS brain samples, researchers found pericytes stretch along inflamed blood vessels and, when exposed to CSPGs, help macrophages enter the brain.

34752925.mechanism: Removes p38alpha signaling from CD11c+ microglia
34752925.conclusion_quote: Together, our study identified pathological hallmarks of chronic EAE progression and suggests that CD11c + microglia may regulate immune cell parenchymal infiltration in autoimmune demyelination.
34752925.summary: In mice with EAE, removing p38alpha from CD11c cells reduced these microglia and sped up disease progression in females.

34570348.mechanism: Activates AMPK, suppressing NF-κB and pro-inflammatory microglia
34570348.conclusion_quote: In summary, our data revealed that metformin attenuated pro-inflammatory microglia markers through suppressing NF-κB activity.
34570348.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, metformin reduced inflammatory microglia and brain inflammation signals, and it lessened myelin loss.

33279637.mechanism: Not applicable, phenotypes cuprizone-induced demyelination behaviour
33279637.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that the behavioural phenotyping of cuprizone-fed mice using Intellicage is reproducible and sensitive enough to detect changes normally missed in standard behavioral test batteries.
33279637.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to model demyelination, an automated home cage system detected reduced activity and impulsivity that repeated across two cohorts.

33828552.mechanism: blocks chemokine receptor signaling and Th17 differentiation
33828552.conclusion_quote: This study elucidated a critical role of protein geranylgeranylation in regulating T lymphocyte migration and function.
33828552.summary: In mice with EAE, removing protein geranylgeranylation from T cells made them resistant to disease by reducing immune cell migration and interleukin 17 producing Th17 cells.

33767202.mechanism: blocks SLAMF5 receptor, boosting IL-10 regulatory B cell survival
33767202.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that SLAMF5 is a negative moderator of IL-10 + Breg cells, and may serve as a therapeutic target in MS and other autoimmune diseases.
33767202.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the SLAMF5 protein increased calming regulatory B cells and eased disease severity, with similar effects seen in human cells.

34271980.mechanism: Blocks TAK1 kinase and immune signaling pathways
34271980.conclusion_quote: Our approach based on donor-specific signaling networks enables prediction of targets for combination therapy for MS and other complex diseases.
34271980.summary: Researchers mapped immune signaling in MS patients to predict drug combinations, then validated fingolimod plus a TAK1 inhibitor in mice with EAE.

34669500.mechanism: Describes neuron loss and astrocyte glutamate uptake
34669500.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, we comprehensively observed the temporal and spatial evolution of various functional neurons.
34669500.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause demyelination, researchers tracked brain neuron loss over time, finding major losses after 4 to 6 weeks.

34717909.mechanism: Carries stem cells into brain for better bioavailability
34717909.conclusion_quote: The engineering of advanced therapies using this natural carrier can result in efficacious treatments for MS and related debilitating conditions.
34717909.summary: In rats with EAE, an injectable hydrogel carrying stem cells into the brain reduced disease severity and eliminated relapse.

33565962.mechanism: boosts neuronal mitochondrial numbers and respiratory capacity
33565962.conclusion_quote: Our study provides systemic insights into mitochondrial dysfunction in neurons during inflammation and commends elevation of mitochondrial activity as a promising neuroprotective strategy.
33565962.summary: In mice with EAE, boosting the mitochondrial gene Ppargc1a in neurons protected nerves from damage, while deleting it made damage worse.

34978294.mechanism: Pump bypasses blood-brain barrier to deliver drugs directly
34978294.conclusion_quote: Therefore, this method is of great value to the field of central nervous system myelin regeneration research.
34978294.summary: This protocol describes using a small implanted osmotic pump to deliver drugs directly into specific brain areas of mice with lysolecithin-induced demyelination, to test remyelination treatments.

34301274.mechanism: Constipation-driven gut dysbiosis worsens immune imbalance
34301274.conclusion_quote: Our results verified that constipation induced gut microbiota dysbiosis exacerbated EAE via aggravating Treg/Th17 and Treg17/Teff17 imbalance and cytokines disturbance in C57BL/6 mice.
34301274.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, induced constipation disturbed gut bacteria and immune balance, worsening disease, and transferring their gut bacteria reproduced the effect.

34624687.mechanism: Inhibits FABP5 and FABP7, reducing inflammation and protecting oligodendrocyte m
34624687.conclusion_quote: MF 6 is a potent inhibitor of FABP5 and FABP7; targeted inhibition of the two proteins may confer potential therapeutic effects in MS via immune inhibition and oligodendrocyte protection.
34624687.summary: In mice with EAE, a novel FABP5 and FABP7 inhibitor given before or after symptoms reduced myelin loss, clinical signs, and inflammation, while protecting oligodendrocyte mitochondria.

33796102.mechanism: Alters gut microbiota, lowers Th17, raises Treg cells
33796102.conclusion_quote: These results uncovered a protective role of SE in neuroimmunomodulation effects partly via changes to the gut microbiome.
33796102.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, strength exercise reduced disease and nerve damage, partly by changing gut bacteria.

33508411.mechanism: Not applicable: model development without a tested treatment
33508411.conclusion_quote: The optimized model provides a longer demyelination time frame and axonal damage followed by RGC degeneration; which is of exceptional interest in investigating axonal degeneration mechanisms and screening the new drugs for progressive MS.
33508411.summary: In mice, a refined lysolecithin optic nerve injection with agarose caused longer lasting demyelination, nerve damage, and retinal cell loss than the standard method.

34440146.mechanism: Reduces Th17 and GM-CSF T cells, boosts IL-10
34440146.conclusion_quote: Conclusively, HBOT attenuated EAE through the modulation of T cell responses in an earlier stage.
34440146.summary: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy, which has people breathe pure oxygen in a pressurized chamber, eased disease in mice with EAE by calming harmful immune T cells.

32378022.conclusion_quote: These preliminary results suggest that both activated microglia and infiltrated macrophages are present in vulnerable brain regions during the acute phase of PLP-EAE and contribute to disease severity.
32378022.summary: Researchers used PET and MRI scans to detect activated microglia and infiltrating macrophages in the brains of mice with EAE, a multiple sclerosis model, during acute disease.

33785790.conclusion_quote: Legumain was associated with increased lesion activity and might be valuable as a drug target using specific inhibitors as already suggested for Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease.
33785790.summary: In mice with cuprizone and EAE models of MS, researchers used protein profiling to find changes in the frontal cortex, and legumain was higher in human MS lesions.

34188587.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that serum factors might contribute to progressive MS pathogenesis via pericyte dysfunction.
34188587.summary: Serum from mice with EAE and from people with progressive MS reduced survival of human brain pericytes in lab tests, hinting that blood factors may drive progressive MS.

34628133.mechanism: Not applicable, measurement tool study only
34628133.conclusion_quote: CS and ADWB were strongly correlated, indicated that these measures are comparable and suggesting that ADWB may be an appropriate observer-independent tool for the assessment of EAE progression.
34628133.summary: In mice with EAE, a weight bearing system measured hindlimb weakness and matched the standard clinical score, offering an unbiased way to track disease progression.

34017815.conclusion_quote: Our observations might help in understanding myelination and especially remyelination-a process in which damaged myelin is repaired-which is a promising candidate for treatment of the still mostly incurable demyelinating diseases such as MS.
34017815.summary: This lab study used artificial membranes coated with myelin basic protein to model myelin formation, finding stronger adhesion with native-like lipids than with EAE-like lipids.

33971906.mechanism: Knockdown reduces Notch1 and STAT3 signaling in astrocytes
33971906.conclusion_quote: These findings uncover that Gm13568 regulates the production of inflammatory cytokines in active astrocytes and affects the pathogenesis of EAE through the Notch1/STAT3 pathway.
33971906.summary: In mice with EAE, switching off a long noncoding RNA called Gm13568 in astrocytes reduced inflammation and nerve sheath damage and delayed disease.

34610465.mechanism: Removes PAC1 receptors from retinal neurons using Cre
34610465.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that neuronal PAC1 receptors play a homeostatic role in protecting RGNs and directly protects neurons and their axons against neuroinflammatory challenge.
34610465.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, deleting PAC1 receptors from retinal neurons increased nerve cell loss and damage to the optic nerve.

33879167.mechanism: Deleting STEAP4 reduces Th17-driven inflammation in CNS
33879167.conclusion_quote: In this study, we identified STEAP4 as a Th17-specific effector molecule that participates and contributes to the pathogenesis of neuroinflammation, thus potentially provide a novel target for MS therapy.
33879167.summary: Mice lacking STEAP4 in brain and spinal cord resident cells had milder EAE, an MS animal model, when Th17 cells drove disease.

34535564.mechanism: Binds S1P1 and S1P5 receptors, blocking lymphocyte egress
34535564.conclusion_quote: Based on readouts for experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis and cuprizone intoxication, S1P 1 modulation is neuroprotective, but S1P 5 activity may be required for remyelination.
34535564.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, the drug ozanimod reduced disease signs and nerve damage through S1P1 receptors but did not boost myelin repair.

34437581.conclusion_quote: The data suggest a relatively higher proportion of ermin immunopositivity in oligodendrocytes compared to Nogo-A indicates recent or ongoing remyelination.
34437581.summary: In mice fed cuprizone and in human MS brain tissue, the protein ermin was found in higher proportion of repairing cells, suggesting it may mark recent remyelination.

34630443.summary: This retraction notice covers a study of exosomal PVT1 and Th17 cells in mice with EAE, so it reports no new findings.

33381863.mechanism: Calms reactive astrocytes, cuts inflammatory cytokines and endothelin-1
33381863.conclusion_quote: These data indicate that MSC attenuate detrimental features of reactive astroglia and, based on the reacquisition of stem cell properties, also suggest that astrocytes may be empowered in their protective and reparative actions by MSC.
33381863.summary: Stem cells from mesenchymal tissue calmed harmful reactive astrocytes and promoted progenitor traits in cultured cells and in mice with EAE, an MS model.

34408824.conclusion_quote: PEGylation of antigenic peptides is an effective and feasible strategy to improve tolerogenic (Treg-inducing) peptide-based vaccines, but application for immunotherapy of overt disease might require modifications or combination therapies that simultaneously suppress effector mechanisms.
34408824.summary: In mice with EAE, a PEGylated myelin peptide vaccine given before disease onset prevented symptoms by activating regulatory T cells, but treatment at disease peak did not help.

34678664.mechanism: No treatment or gene change tested
34678664.conclusion_quote: This disease-specific hiPSC line will be useful for studying PPMS in vitro, allowing the generation of immune and CNS cell types.
34678664.summary: Researchers created a stem cell line from a person with primary progressive multiple sclerosis, which can be used to study the disease in lab grown immune and nervous system cells.

34987466.mechanism: Biased kappa opioid receptor agonist favoring G-protein signaling
34987466.conclusion_quote: Overall, EOM SalB was effective in two preclinical models of multiple sclerosis and demyelination, adding further evidence to show KOR agonists are a promising target for remyelinating therapies.
34987466.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone induced demyelination, the salvinorin analogue EOM SalB reduced disease severity and increased myelin repair.

33504620.mechanism: Loss of IL-38 reduces macrophage and T-cell inflammation
33504620.conclusion_quote: These data suggest an alternative cell-intrinsic role of IL-38 to promote inflammation in the CNS.
33504620.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IL-38 gene lowered clinical scores and reduced spinal cord inflammation, including macrophage and T-cell infiltration.

33671675.mechanism: Cuprizone impairs mitochondrial respiration, reversible after withdrawal
33671675.conclusion_quote: This reversible cell-based model may help to further investigate the role of mitochondria in the disease, and study the molecular intricacies underlying the pathophysiology of the MS and other demyelinating diseases.
33671675.summary: In human brain cell lines and rat brain cells, the demyelination toxin cuprizone impaired mitochondrial energy production, and this effect reversed once the toxin was removed.

34088020.conclusion_quote: In the newly-developed induced pluripotent stem cell line, the pluripotent markers were well expressed.
34088020.summary: Researchers created stem cells from a 70-year-old man carrying the APOE-ε4 gene variant and confirmed they looked normal and could mature into other cell types. The work did not study MS.
