33876477.summary: Researchers compared gut bacteria in MS patients and healthy people, then gave mice Akkermansia from patients, which reduced EAE symptoms, a mouse model of MS.

33285042.mechanism: Inhibits T-cell proliferation or Th1/Th17 polarization
33285042.conclusion_quote: HICT and HIIT attenuate systemic autoimmunity and T cell encephalitogenicity by distinct immunomodulatory mechanisms.
33285042.summary: In mice with EAE, high intensity continuous and interval treadmill running each reduced disease severity and inflammation, but through different immune cell effects.

33274566.mechanism: Induces apoptosis and differentiation through several signaling pathways
33274566.conclusion_quote: To summarize, curcumol and FTY720 synergistically inhibit proliferation involved in differentiation and induce apoptosis in CML cells.
33274566.summary: In leukemia cells and mice with leukemia tumors, combining curcumol with FTY720, a multiple sclerosis drug, slowed cell growth and triggered cell death, but MS itself was not studied.

34166966.mechanism: Increases Akt phosphorylation via PI3K/Akt pathway activation
34166966.conclusion_quote: Glucosamine may exacerbate acute and chronic epileptic seizures via activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway in rats with experimental epilepsy.
34166966.summary: In rats with induced epilepsy, a high dose of glucosamine worsened and prolonged seizures, likely by activating the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

34483908.mechanism: Suppresses IL-23/Th17 axis and STAT3 phosphorylation
34483908.conclusion_quote: DHA inhibits the progression of psoriasis by regulating IL-23/Th17 axis and is expected to be an effective drug for the treatment of psoriasis.
34483908.summary: In mice with imiquimod-induced psoriasis-like skin disease, dihydroartemisinin reduced skin inflammation by dampening the IL-23 and Th17 immune pathway.

34358632.mechanism: Copper chelation activates STAT3, blocking stem cell differentiation
34358632.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that short-term CPZ exposure inhibits differentiation of NSCs into NPCs via activation of STAT3, which may in part underlie cognitive deficits.
34358632.summary: Mice fed the toxin cuprizone for two weeks showed cognitive deficits, more active STAT3 in hippocampal stem cells, and fewer new neurons.

34419102.conclusion_quote: Anti-AQP4 antibody was shown to induce the release of extracellular ATP from astrocytes.
34419102.summary: In rats given anti-AQP4 antibodies, which model neuromyelitis optica rather than MS, ATP release from astrocytes was linked to pain-like sensitivity.

33483333.mechanism: Deletes TRAIL gene in regulatory T cells
33483333.conclusion_quote: We conclude that T regs do not appear to be dependent on TRAIL exclusively as a mechanism of suppression in both the tumor and autoimmune microenvironments, although it remains possible that TRAIL may contribute in combination with other mechanisms and/or in different disease settings.
33483333.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the TRAIL gene from regulatory T cells did not change disease progression, showing these cells do not rely solely on TRAIL to suppress immunity.

33436375.conclusion_quote: These results point to a role of SERPINA3 as a biomarker associated with the progressive forms of MS, particularly PPMS.
33436375.summary: Researchers found higher levels of the protein SERPINA3 in the spinal fluid of people with progressive MS, especially PPMS, and in mice with EAE.

34166868.mechanism: Blocks lymphocyte exit from lymph nodes
34166868.conclusion_quote: DBSI was used to assess changes of the underlying optic nerve pathologies in EAE mice with ON, exhibiting great potential as a noninvasive outcome measure for monitoring disease progression and therapeutic efficacy for MS.
34166868.summary: In mice with EAE optic neuritis, fingolimod improved vision and protected optic nerves, and a special MRI method tracked these changes noninvasively.

33516262.mechanism: Increases regulatory T cells in blood, spleen and brain
33516262.conclusion_quote: Fingolimod increases Treg frequency in spleen and blood post-ischaemia and enhances the number of FoxP3+ cells in the ischaemic brain.
33516262.summary: In mice with a stroke-like brain injury model, fingolimod increased regulatory T cells in the blood, spleen and injured brain tissue.

34202160.conclusion_quote: In this study, we demonstrate that bacterially expressed, purified SHFL can decrease the efficiency of programmed ribosomal frameshifting in vitro at a variety of sites, including the RNA pseudoknot-dependent signals of the coronaviruses IBV, SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2, and the protein-dependent stimulators of the cardioviruses EMCV and TMEV.
34202160.summary: In laboratory tests with purified protein, a human antiviral factor reduced how often viral genetic machinery shifts reading frames. The study does not involve multiple sclerosis or animal models of it.

33708074.mechanism: Reduces microglial ROS formation and pro-inflammatory cytokine release
33708074.conclusion_quote: HICT protects the CNS against autoimmune neuroinflammation by reducing microglial-derived ROS formation, neurotoxicity, and pro-inflammatory responses involved in the propagation of autoimmune neuroinflammation.
33708074.summary: In mice with EAE, high intensity treadmill training before disease induction led to milder disease and less harmful brain microglia activity.

34666481.mechanism: inhibits dihydroorotate dehydrogenase, reducing T cell proliferation
34666481.conclusion_quote: This study proposes SF 5 as a novel superior 19 F MR reporter group for the MS drug teriflunomide.
34666481.summary: Researchers modified the MS drug teriflunomide so it shows up more clearly on MRI scans. The modified version also suppressed immune T cell growth more strongly in lab tests.

33497934.conclusion_quote: DMF treatment during sub-acute ischemic stroke did not significantly improve the neurological deficit scores.
33497934.summary: In rats with stroke, dimethyl fumarate given for three days did not improve movement or neurological scores, though it reduced neuron swelling and death in the motor cortex.

32572163.mechanism: Removing ADAM12 cuts Th1 T-bet and IFNγ output
32572163.conclusion_quote: We conclude that ADAM12 is a T-cell costimulatory molecule that contributes to the pathogenesis of tissue inflammation and a potential target for the treatment of Th1-mediated diseases.
32572163.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, removing the ADAM12 gene reduced Th1 immune cell activity and lessened disease severity.

33815353.mechanism: Lowers Nav1.6 sodium channel, dampening innate inflammation
33815353.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that in addition to its recognized impact on axonal damage, Nav1.6 impacts multiple aspects of the innate inflammatory response.
33815353.summary: In mice with EAE, a reduced level of the sodium channel Nav1.6 improved motor function and lowered inflammation, with fewer myeloid immune cells and lower blood levels of interleukin 6.

34054415.conclusion_quote: We here provide first evidence for a controlled lesion induction model in EAE using FUS-induced BBBD.
34054415.summary: In mice with EAE, focused ultrasound opened the blood brain barrier to create controlled inflammatory lesions, which showed activated microglia and altered brain tissue stiffness on MRI.

33323466.mechanism: Cytokine boosts T-cell inflammatory signaling and cytokine production
33323466.conclusion_quote: Our results underscore that IL-15 contributes to the amplification of T-cell inflammatory properties after disease onset in both MS and EAE.
33323466.summary: In mice with EAE, extra interleukin 15 given after disease onset worsened symptoms and increased inflammatory immune cells in the central nervous system.

33612231.mechanism: emulsifier that may improve fat digestion
33612231.conclusion_quote: The inclusion of LYSO as an additive in milk replacer in a dose of 4 g/d may improve performance, and calf fecal score, preweaning.
33612231.summary: This study tested lysolecithin added to milk replacer in dairy calves, finding better growth and fewer abnormal fecal scores. It does not involve multiple sclerosis.

34021906.conclusion_quote: These findings emphasise the important role of mechanical forces during IVD development, and demonstrate a critical role of muscle loading during development to enable proper annulus fibrosus formation.
34021906.summary: In prenatal mice with muscular dysgenesis lacking muscle contractions, spinal discs and vertebrae developed abnormally, with cervical vertebral fusion and disrupted collagen, though notochord involution was unaffected.

34452320.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, this study provides proof for the occurrence of persistent EqPV-H infection in asymptomatic horses and cross-species EqPV-H detection in donkeys.
34452320.summary: This study followed 124 German horses for five years and found a parvovirus linked to horse hepatitis can persist without liver disease and infect donkeys.

33936108.mechanism: Describes macrophage locations and polarization, no treatment tested
33936108.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data indicate differential distribution of pro- and anti-inflammatory MoCs at CNS borders and highlight how the interaction of MoCs with CNS barriers can significantly affect the functional activation of these CNS-invading MoCs during autoimmune inflammation.
33936108.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, immune cells entering the nervous system showed different activation types depending on which barrier they crossed.

33015737.mechanism: Foxg1 loss speeds OPC maturation via Wnt signaling
33015737.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that Foxg1 is involved in the proliferation and differentiation of OPCs through the Wnt signaling pathway.
33015737.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, deleting the Foxg1 gene reduced demyelination and sped up myelin repair through the Wnt signaling pathway.

32991933.conclusion_quote: Anti-CD20 antibody treatment delayed brain tissue neurodegeneration in GM, and showed clinical benefit on measures of disease severity in huMOG-EAE mice.
32991933.summary: In mice with human MOG-induced EAE, a subcutaneous anti-CD20 antibody that depletes B cells slowed brain gray matter shrinkage and improved disease severity and motor performance.

34259595.conclusion_quote: The elaborated studies proved the potential of ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy for the fast qualification of magnetic nanoparticles in terms of their ability to separate the selected analyte from the sample matrix.
34259595.summary: This chemistry study used a fast light absorption test to check copper doped iron nanoparticles, with no animal or human MS research involved.

33593907.mechanism: Diagnostic staining method, no treatment tested
33593907.conclusion_quote: Nile Red spectroscopy offers a relatively simple yet highly sensitive technique for detecting subtle myelin changes.
33593907.summary: Researchers developed a Nile Red dye method that detects subtle chemical changes in myelin in mice given cuprizone and in normal-appearing white matter from people with multiple sclerosis.

34909829.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the addition of the blend T-FRA in broiler diets was able to improve the feed conversion and maintain the other performance parameters even considering a reduction of 0.8% in the inclusion of oil.
34909829.summary: Feeding broiler chickens a blend of monolaurin and butyric acid glycerides improved feed conversion, but this poultry study has no link to multiple sclerosis.

33691116.mechanism: Mertk loss impairs microglial debris clearance and activation
33691116.conclusion_quote: Together, our work establishes a role for Mertk in microglia activation, phagocytosis, and migration during remyelination.
33691116.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, removing the Mertk gene impaired debris clearing by microglia and slowed myelin repair.

34557075.mechanism: Lack of receptor reduces BBB leakage and immune entry
34557075.conclusion_quote: This evidence suggests that IL-20 subfamily cytokines may signal at the BBB via IL-20RB, triggering neuroinflammation.
34557075.summary: In mice with EAE, lacking the interleukin 20 receptor subunit beta reduced disease severity and lowered inflammation in the brain and spinal cord.

34502381.mechanism: disrupts myelin formation in developing brain organoids
34502381.conclusion_quote: Here, we define a methodology that allows quantification of myelin disruption and provides reference compounds for chemical-induced myelin disruption.
34502381.summary: In human stem-cell-derived brain organoids, cuprizone, Bisphenol A and Tris(1,3-dichloro-2-propyl) phosphate reduced myelination, while methyl mercury and ibuprofen did not.

34106403.mechanism: removes Dicer microRNA enzyme from astrocytes
34106403.conclusion_quote: Together, our results indicate that Dicer in astrocytes is required for oligodendroglia myelination in both the developing and adult CNS.
34106403.summary: Deleting the Dicer gene in mouse astrocytes reduced myelin formation during development and blocked myelin repair after lysolecithin-induced demyelination, also impairing memory and movement.

34642237.mechanism: Accumulates zymosterol in oligodendrocytes, boosting their differentiation
34642237.conclusion_quote: TF enhances zymosterol accumulation in oligodendrocytes and CNS myelin repair, a beneficial off-target effect that should be investigated in patients with multiple sclerosis.
34642237.summary: In mice and tadpoles with induced myelin damage, the MS drug teriflunomide boosted oligodendrocyte maturation and myelin repair by raising zymosterol levels.

34342813.mechanism: promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and migration
34342813.conclusion_quote: Considering that the 100 mg/kg HCQ group had the highest level of PDGFR-α as well as the highest level of myelin repair in LFB staining, it could be inferred that it was the most effective dose in inducing proliferation and migration of OPCs.
34342813.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, hydroxychloroquine at higher doses increased oligodendrocyte progenitor cells and myelin repair, with the 100 mg/kg dose working best.

33708131.mechanism: Inhibits NOTCH1 pathway, promoting oligodendrocyte precursor differentiation
33708131.conclusion_quote: Our data suggested that catalpol may promote OPC differentiation and remyelination through modulation of the NOTCH1 pathway.
33708131.summary: In mice with cuprizone induced demyelination, catalpol promoted myelin repair and motor recovery by reducing NOTCH1 pathway activity that normally blocks oligodendrocyte maturation.

33746698.conclusion_quote: The combination of RAFF4, MT and DTI has the potential to differentiate between normal, demyelinated and remyelinated axons and gliosis and thus it may be able to provide a more detailed assessment of white matter pathologies in several neurological diseases.
33746698.summary: In rats with brain demyelination induced by a chemical, MRI scans tracked myelin loss and partial repair, and combining methods better distinguished healthy, damaged, and repaired nerve fibers.

34048871.conclusion_quote: This study advances our understanding of the pathophysiological contributions of the GCC-specific white matter lesion to the related disease, and demonstrates an indispensable role of interhemispheric communication between the frontal cortices for the top-down regulation of the sensorimotor gating.
34048871.summary: Mice with a focal demyelinating lesion in the genu of the corpus callosum showed reduced sensorimotor gating but normal social, mood, and motor behavior.

33912017.conclusion_quote: This new CNN-based analysis pipeline offers a rapid, robust method to quantitatively analyze oligodendrocyte dynamics in vivo , which will aid in understanding how changes in these myelinating cells influence circuit function and recovery from injury and disease.
33912017.summary: In mice given cuprizone to cause demyelination, an automated machine learning tool tracked thousands of brain oligodendrocytes over weeks, revealing that repair is suppressed in deeper cortical layers.

33369182.mechanism: boosts oligodendrocyte transcription factors Olig2, Myt1, Sox17
33369182.conclusion_quote: NES alone or with E2 increased the levels of transcription factors, essential for myelin synthesis.
33369182.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the synthetic progestin Nestorone raised transcription factors needed for making myelin, supporting remyelination of the corpus callosum.

32779553.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes tissue autofluorescence
32779553.conclusion_quote: Autofluorescence spectroscopy illuminates prior and ongoing white matter injury.
32779553.summary: In mice given cuprizone and in autopsied MS brain tissue, autofluorescence built up in damaged white matter even after repair, hinting at hidden ongoing injury.

33497496.mechanism: Nogo-A activates RhoA in astrocytes, reducing synapse-promoting signals
33497496.conclusion_quote: Hence, we suggest that interactions between Nogo-A and astrocytes might represent an important pathway of plasticity regulation and could be a target for therapeutic intervention in demyelinating diseases in the future.
33497496.summary: In lab cultures and mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, the myelin protein Nogo-A reduced astrocytes' ability to support new nerve connections.

33819278.mechanism: Not applicable, imaging analysis method only
33819278.conclusion_quote: Collectively, metric learning using standard MRI may prove to be a new alternative method for estimating myelin content, which ultimately can improve our disease monitoring ability in a clinical setting.
33819278.summary: In mice with lysolecithin induced demyelination, a new MRI analysis method estimated myelin content from standard scans and closely matched tissue histology.

34567412.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the differential metabolites have great potential to serve as biomarkers of demyelinating diseases.
34567412.summary: In mice fed a cuprizone diet that causes myelin loss, researchers measured brain metabolites and identified molecules that could serve as biomarkers of demyelinating diseases.

32940597.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease model
32940597.conclusion_quote: This model represents a crucial tool for the study of both miRNA involvement and cortical lesion formation in disease pathogenesis.
32940597.summary: In a modified mouse model of MS with cortical lesions, researchers found that cortical microRNA profiles changed, with differences between mice having high or low clinical scores.

33101703.mechanism: Enriched housing reverses stress effects on relapse
33101703.conclusion_quote: These data provide the platform for further studies on the biological processes that link stress and multiple sclerosis relapses in a suitable animal model.
33101703.summary: In mice with EAE, an enriched environment reduced relapse rate and severity and offset the relapse increase caused by repeated stress.

32848245.mechanism: Gut microbes activate MOG-specific T cells, amplifying inflammation
32848245.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that the synergistic effects that result from the presence of these microorganisms should be considered in the pathogenicity of multiple sclerosis, and that further study of these microorganisms may lead to preventive strategies for this disease.
32848245.summary: In mice with EAE, two gut bacteria working together activated immune cells that target myelin, causing more severe symptoms than either bacterium alone.

32197530.mechanism: binds and inhibits S100B protein, reducing inflammation
32197530.conclusion_quote: Overall, our results indicate that pentamidine targeting the S100B protein is a novel potential drug to be considered for multiple sclerosis treatment.
32197530.summary: In mice with relapsing-remitting EAE, the drug pentamidine, which blocks the S100B protein, delayed attacks, reduced inflammation and limited brain damage.

31911458.mechanism: Lowers vascular permeability, limiting leukocyte entry into CNS
31911458.conclusion_quote: Thus, cortactin contributes to the development of neural inflammation by supporting leukocyte transmigration through the blood-brain barrier and, therefore, represents a potential candidate for targeting CNS autoimmunity.
31911458.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the cortactin gene reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord, and female mice developed milder disease.

31808502.mechanism: Promotes oligodendrocyte progenitor maturation via GSK-3β signaling
31808502.conclusion_quote: Our data led to the conclusion that GA could be used as a potential therapeutic candidate for the treatment of demyelinating diseases such as MS, which remains refractory to available treatments.
31808502.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-induced demyelination, glycyrrhizic acid reduced inflammation and helped oligodendrocyte progenitor cells mature, speeding myelin repair.

32298774.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes feeding peptide changes
32298774.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that inflammatory anorexia in rat EAE may be caused by activation of the OXT-ergic pathway and HPA axis via changes in the expression of hypothalamic feeding-related peptides, including Avp but not Crh.
32298774.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, researchers found that changes in appetite-related brain hormones may drive loss of appetite during the disease.

33013394.mechanism: Regulates TLR2 signaling, reducing proinflammatory cytokines and inflammation
33013394.conclusion_quote: Our results suggest that OAA might have promising therapeutic properties and that the TLR signaling pathway is an effective therapeutic target against multiple sclerosis.
33013394.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, oleanolic acid acetate reduced paralysis and spinal cord inflammation by regulating TLR2 signaling.

31816310.conclusion_quote: The increase in white matter rigidity can be regarded as an early signature of EAE.
31816310.summary: Researchers used atomic force microscopy to measure spinal cord stiffness in mice with EAE at different disease stages, finding white matter became stiffer early in disease.

32831634.mechanism: rebuilds gut microbiota, reduces glial activation, protects barrier
32831634.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our data suggest that FMT, as a GM-based therapy, has the potential to be an effective treatment for MS.
32831634.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, fecal microbiota transplantation partly restored gut bacteria, reduced glial activation, and protected the blood brain barrier, myelin, and axons.

32592862.conclusion_quote: We propose that inflammation of hypothalamic tissue downregulates Kiss1 and Gnrh1 expression in females and males, respectively, leading to sex-specific changes downstream the axis.
32592862.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, inflammation in the hypothalamus of the brain lowered reproductive hormone genes in a sex specific way, changing hormone levels.

33127393.mechanism: Neonatal smoke exposure suppresses regulatory T cell function
33127393.conclusion_quote: Together, these findings demonstrate that neonatal ETS exposure suppresses Treg functions and aggravates the severity of EAE, confirming early-life exposure to ETS as a potential risk factor for multiple sclerosis in adulthood.
33127393.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, smoke exposure in the first week after birth worsened later disease by suppressing regulatory T cells.

32215835.mechanism: reduces T cell and macrophage infiltration, promotes M2 microglia polarization,
32215835.conclusion_quote: The results showed that BB treatment effectively prevented worsening and demyelination of EAE, accompanied by the inhibition of neuroinflammation that should be closely related to T cell tolerance and M2 macrophages/microglia polarization.
32215835.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, bilobalide treatment reduced worsening and myelin loss by calming inflammation and limiting immune cell infiltration.

31778849.mechanism: suppresses activation of effector T cells
31778849.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that MYMD-1 may be of interest for evaluating for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
31778849.summary: In mice with EAE, a synthetic plant alkaloid called MYMD-1 improved disease course and reduced activation of harmful T cells without broadly suppressing the immune system.

32682447.conclusion_quote: We therefore conclude that spatial frequency testing is better suited as visual acuity assessment in C57Bl/6 J EAEON mice.
32682447.summary: Testing two vision-measurement methods in mice with EAE optic neuritis found spatial frequency testing correlated better with disease measures than contrast sensitivity testing.

32087534.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes cardiac channel gene expression changes.
32087534.conclusion_quote: For the first time, these findings provided valuable insights into the potential role of Kir channels in cardiac problems associated with MS.
32087534.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to cause brain demyelination, heart rhythm changed and two potassium channel genes were more active, suggesting a link to heart problems in MS.

33828603.mechanism: Antioxidant vitamin E protecting myelin from damage
33828603.conclusion_quote: Short-term AT therapy showed improvement in motor dysfunction and reduction of demyelination in the animal model of MS.
33828603.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced demyelination, vitamin E injections given after the diet improved walking and balance and reduced myelin loss in the brain.

31982706.mechanism: Neuroprotective effect reduces demyelination in hippocampal fimbria
31982706.conclusion_quote: Dimethyl fumarate, even if initiated after hindlimb paralysis, ameliorated memory deficits in the MS mouse model due, at least in part, to its positive impact in the demyelination of the main hippocampal output pathway.
31982706.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, dimethyl fumarate started after paralysis improved memory and reduced demyelination in a key hippocampal pathway.

32482056.mechanism: Reduces spinal cord inflammation and demyelination
32482056.conclusion_quote: Swimming exercises can be considered for relief of symptom in incurable multiple sclerosis.
32482056.summary: In rats with EAE, an animal model of MS, daily swimming exercise reduced spinal cord inflammation and demyelination and eased symptoms about as well as interferon-beta.

32706187.mechanism: Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory, raises CREB and synapse proteins
32706187.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that melatonin may provide protective effects against memory impairments associated with multiple sclerosis.
32706187.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced MS-like damage, melatonin improved memory and raised levels of proteins that support connections between brain cells.

32304749.mechanism: replaces glia and reduces astrogliosis near transplant site
32304749.conclusion_quote: Hence, diffuse injury-sensitive onVDMP CEST MRI may complement conventional MRI to locate and monitor tissue regions responsive to GRP therapy.
32304749.summary: Transplanted glial precursor cells reduced paralysis and astrogliosis near the transplant site in mice with EAE, and a special MRI method detected this tissue response.

32253301.mechanism: Activates PPARγ, boosting CNTF and oligodendrocyte maturation
32253301.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings demonstrate that UA has significant potential as an oral antiinflammatory and neural repair agent for MS, especially at the chronic-progressive stage.
32253301.summary: In mice with EAE and cuprizone-treated mice, oral ursolic acid reduced inflammation and demyelination and promoted myelin repair, even when started after disease was established.

32938979.mechanism: Describes gut microbiome changes without testing treatment
32938979.conclusion_quote: Our analysis and interpretation of results provides a detailed picture of the changes to the gut microbiome that are occurring throughout the course of EAE disease progression and helps to evaluate EAE as a viable model for gut dysbiosis in MS patients.
32938979.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, gut bacteria shifted, with fewer Lactobacillaceae and more Clostridiaceae and related families, but no treatment was tested.

32584865.mechanism: Removing SARM1 blocks programmed axon degeneration
32584865.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, Sarm1 deletion delayed axonal degeneration early in the course of CNS inflammation, but did not confer long-term protection from axonal degeneration in an animal model of immune-mediated CNS inflammation.
32584865.summary: Mice lacking the Sarm1 gene had less nerve fiber damage early in experimental allergic encephalomyelitis, an MS model, but not later on.

32241915.mechanism: Deletion impairs macrophage and microglial migration, reducing CCL2
32241915.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our findings suggest that DOCK10 plays a role in innate immunity and neuroinflammation and might represent a potential therapeutic target for managing multiple sclerosis.
32241915.summary: In mice with EAE, removing DOCK10 eased disease severity and reduced immune cell migration, while removing DOCK9 or DOCK11 had no such effect.

32962135.conclusion_quote: Hence, the data suggest that OBZ could have neuroprotective effects on the CNS, setting the drug apart from the currently available type I anti-CD20 antibodies.
32962135.summary: In mice with EAE, the anti-CD20 antibody obinutuzumab reduced spinal cord damage, lowering demyelination and boosting myelin repair.

32661729.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
32661729.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that endogenous rhythms in immune responses might cause seasonal variations in EAE severity, and, maybe, in the course of MS, and that they might be related to macrophages/microglia.
32661729.summary: Mice with EAE born or immunized in summer had milder disease and fewer macrophages and microglia in the central nervous system, suggesting seasonal internal rhythms affect disease.

33841545.mechanism: reduces inflammatory cytokines and boosts antioxidant enzymes
33841545.conclusion_quote: The results of our assay confirmed that immunomodulatory and antioxidant features of the herbal extract of Melilotus Officinalis ameliorated the EAE severity.
33841545.summary: In mice with EAE, a herbal extract of Melilotus officinalis given from the first day after immunization reduced disease signs, inflammation, and oxidative stress while preserving myelin.

32694981.mechanism: Thrombin inhibitor limits PAR-1, SphK1 and S1P signaling
32694981.conclusion_quote: We suggest that dabigatran, a specific inhibitor of thrombin, antagonized the effect of thrombin in astrocytes by limiting the activation of PAR-1, in turn downregulating SphK1 and disrupting S1P receptor signaling.
32694981.summary: In mice with EAE, the blood thinner dabigatran reduced astrocyte activation, spinal cord inflammation and demyelination, and improved neurological function.

32973458.conclusion_quote: Elucidating the spectrum of microglial functions in these models, from detrimental to protective, is essential to identify emerging targets for therapy and guide drug discovery efforts.
32973458.summary: This review describes how microglia, the brain's immune cells, behave in mouse models of multiple sclerosis, including EAE, cuprizone and lysolecithin models.

32544469.mechanism: Inhibits T cell activation and regulates macrophage polarization
32544469.conclusion_quote: The findings broaden our understanding about the regulation of T cell and macrophage immune responses by MSC transplantation.
32544469.summary: In mice with EAE, transplanted bone marrow stem cells prevented disease, calmed T cells and inflammatory signals, and shifted macrophage behavior.

32058218.mechanism: Balances T cells and cytokines via JAK-STAT
32058218.conclusion_quote: Together, our findings suggested the adaptogenic effects of R. rosea on EAE, which may help to deepen the understanding of potential therapeutic values of traditional Chinese medicines for autoimmune diseases of CNS.
32058218.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, the natural herb Rhodiola rosea reduced disease severity and rebalanced immune cells that drive inflammation.

32265343.mechanism: Lowers chemokines, raises Treg, curbs Th1 and Th17
32265343.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that exposure to RMF may improve EAE disease by promoting CD4+ cell accumulation into peripheral lymphoid tissue, improving the imbalance between Treg and Th1/Th17 cells.
32265343.summary: In mice with EAE, a mild rotating magnetic field treatment given before onset reduced disease severity and delayed symptoms by rebalancing immune T cells.

33382357.mechanism: Modulates gut microbiota composition, reducing inflammation and myelin loss
33382357.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our data demonstrated that gut microbiota mediated the beneficial effects of oral PPE on EAE, and provided new ideas for developing the prebiotic value of pomegranate peel for the treatment of autoimmune diseases.
33382357.summary: In mice with EAE, a pomegranate peel extract taken by mouth eased disease, reduced CNS inflammation, and reshaped gut bacteria, with benefits transferred by fecal transplant.

32686813.mechanism: binds RORγt, suppressing Th17 cell differentiation and IL-17A
32686813.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our data demonstrated that EDT, as an agent for the pharmacological inhibition of RORγt, has great potential for immunomodulation, and for use in the treatment of Th17-mediated autoimmune disease.
32686813.summary: In mice with EAE, the natural citrus flavonoid eriodictyol reduced disease severity and nerve demyelination by blocking harmful Th17 immune cells.

35145730.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes disease only
35145730.conclusion_quote: Thanks to non-invasive methods, we studied the visual system in a MS model, which could be useful for developing specific therapeutic strategies to target different disease phases.
35145730.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, researchers used noninvasive tests to track how vision damage changes before and after motor symptoms begin.

33193433.mechanism: Cuts Th17 cells and IL-17, calms spinal glia
33193433.conclusion_quote: These results provide evidence that SBA-15 maximizes the immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects of CTX in an EAE model; therefore, suggesting that SBA-15 has the potential to improve CTX effectiveness in the treatment of MS.
33193433.summary: In mice with EAE, a snake venom protein carried by a nanoparticle reduced disease severity, immune cell attack, and spinal inflammation better than the venom alone.

31731043.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results indicate that the fibrotic scar is a major component of EAE pathology that leads to an inhibitory environment for remyelination, thus raising the possibility that anti-fibrotic mechanisms may serve as novel therapeutic targets for MS.
31731043.summary: In mice with EAE, fibroblasts gathered in the spinal cord near damaged myelin, and their scar material blocked progenitor cells from becoming myelin-producing oligodendrocytes.

32173452.mechanism: Suppresses Th1 and Th17 cell differentiation and infiltration
32173452.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results confirm that Compound 21 suppresses infiltrated Th1/Th17 cells to alleviate demyelination in EAE rats, suggesting its potential role as a novel candidate for MS treatment.
32173452.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of MS, the phloroglucinol derivative Compound 21 reduced harmful Th1 and Th17 immune cells, lessened myelin damage, and improved neurological symptoms.

31639420.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that periostin, either from monocyte-derived macrophages in SAS or glial cells in the parenchyma, partly facilitates the migration of inflammatory cells in the effector stage of EAE; moreover, periostin in the recovery stage of EAE appears to be involved in the plasticity of damaged central nervous system tissues.
31639420.summary: Researchers found that periostin, a protein linked to tissue repair and inflammation, rises in the spinal cord of mice with EAE, a model of MS.

32638202.mechanism: Reduces calories, increasing oligodendrocyte generation and reducing apoptosis
32638202.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, CR regimen can promote remyelination potential in a CPZ-demyelinating mouse model of MS by increasing oligodendrocyte generation while decreasing their apoptosis.
32638202.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a 33% calorie-restricted diet improved motor coordination and promoted myelin repair in the brain.

32061822.mechanism: Bacterial superantigen activating T cells, increasing inflammatory cytokines
32061822.conclusion_quote: Since SEB causes demyelination of spinal cord and increases the level of pro-inflammatory cytokine response, infiltration of T-lymphocytes and macrophages to CNS, it may exacerbate the clinical signs of EAE in mice and multiple sclerosis in human.
32061822.summary: In mice with EAE, giving staphylococcal enterotoxin B before or after immunization worsened clinical symptoms, cytokine levels and spinal cord inflammation.

32455842.mechanism: Not applicable: describes cell behavior only
32455842.conclusion_quote: Our results reveal the heterogeneity of these progenitors and their cell progeny in a scenario of autoimmune demyelination, revealing the ontogenic phenomena at play in these processes.
32455842.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers tracked NG2 glial cells from single origin cells and found varied clonal responses to brain damage.

32314194.mechanism: Boosts myelin protein expression and myelin thickness
32314194.conclusion_quote: Our data indicated the remyelination potency and cell differentiation can improve with ADSCs and pregnenolone treatments in the multiple sclerosis model which created by cuprizone in rats.
32314194.summary: In rats with cuprizone-induced demyelination, fat-derived stem cells plus the hormone pregnenolone increased myelin thickness and myelin protein levels, approaching healthy levels.

32290524.mechanism: Not applicable, model-establishing study using a demyelinating toxin
32290524.conclusion_quote: The remyelination process in mature adult mice better represents the age of MS patients and offers a better model for the examination of regenerative therapies.
32290524.summary: In aged mice, feeding the toxin cuprizone for 6.5 weeks caused almost complete loss of myelin, and repair afterward was strong but incomplete.

31722234.mechanism: Reduces S1P pathway molecules and astrocyte S1P1 expression
31722234.conclusion_quote: These findings indicate that MAT could alleviate astrogliosis in EAE through diminishing the SPH/SPHK/S1P1 pathway.
31722234.summary: In rats with EAE, matrine calmed overactive astrocytes in the central nervous system by lowering sphingosine 1-phosphate signaling molecules.

32075652.mechanism: Lowers VWF and limits barrier breakdown
32075652.conclusion_quote: Our results demonstrate that ADAMTS13 treatment ameliorates inflammatory responses, demyelination and disease course in EAE mice.
32075652.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, giving the enzyme ADAMTS13 reduced spinal cord inflammation, nerve damage, and disease severity.

32045597.mechanism: Blocks TRPA1 pain channel and reduces oxidative stress
32045597.conclusion_quote: Thus, TRPA1 plays a key role in the induction of neuropathic pain in this model of RR-EAE and can be a possible target for investigating the development of pain in RRMS patients.
32045597.summary: In mice with a relapsing form of EAE, blocking the TRPA1 pain channel or reducing oxidative stress eased pain sensitivity.

33456735.mechanism: Antioxidant and anti-apoptotic actions protect oligodendrocytes
33456735.conclusion_quote: The results of this study showed that asafoetida plays a neuro protective role in CPZ models of multiple sclerosis by reducing neuronal demyelination and oligodendrocytes death.
33456735.summary: In mice given the cuprizone diet to model multiple sclerosis, daily asafoetida treatment reduced brain demyelination and the loss of myelin making cells.

32517884.conclusion_quote: Selected molecules might share homology with self-antigens and as such are worthy of further investigation in terms of potential immunomodulatory capacity and involvement in the parasite's provoked amelioration of EAE.
32517884.summary: In blood samples from 92 people with MS, antibodies recognized parasite worm proteins, especially 45, 49 and 58 kDa proteins, linked to MS.

32151684.mechanism: Removing C3 stops complement-driven synapse loss
32151684.conclusion_quote: Thus, pathologic expression and activation of the early complement pathway, specifically at the level of C3, contributes to hippocampal grey matter pathology in the EAE.
32151684.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the C3 complement protein protected the hippocampus from synapse loss, reduced microglial activation, and preserved memory, while removing C1q did not.

33067238.mechanism: Tolerizes T cells via lung antigen-presenting cells
33067238.conclusion_quote: This study supports noninvasive pulmonary particle delivery, such as inhalable administration, to treat autoimmune disease.
33067238.summary: In mice with EAE, antigen-loaded particles delivered into the lungs reduced disease severity more than intravenous delivery by calming immune cells in the lung.

32913622.mechanism: Depletes CD52-bearing B and T lymphocytes
32913622.conclusion_quote: Collectively, our findings highlight the therapeutic potential of CNS delivery of alemtuzumab for the treatment of progressive as well as early MS.
32913622.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, intrathecal delivery of CD52 antibodies, which deplete immune cells, moderately reduced disease severity and nervous system inflammation.

32505212.mechanism: Inhibits IDO-1 or KMO enzyme in kynurenine pathway
32505212.conclusion_quote: These results provide a new mechanistic link between neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration and point to KP modulation at the KMO level to preserve immune tolerance and limit neurodegeneration in EAE.
32505212.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the kynurenine pathway enzymes IDO-1 or KMO reduced disease severity, with KMO blockade giving the stronger improvement.

32320409.mechanism: Binds GPR17 receptor, promoting myelin-producing cell development
32320409.conclusion_quote: This outcome validates the predictivity of our pipeline to identify novel MS-modifying agents.
32320409.summary: Researchers screened over one million compounds by computer and found galinex, which delayed disease onset in mice with EAE, a mouse model of MS.

32894170.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, the loss of immunological self-tolerance to MOG in EAE mice or in MS patients may not be only attributed to the restricted expression of this antigen in the immunologically privileged environment of the CNS but also of the PNS.
32894170.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, nerve signals in the legs were weaker and slower to travel, and sciatic nerve myelin was thinner, indicating peripheral nerve damage.

32643149.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, PRX5 and PRX6 may play a role in the pathogeneses of MS and NMOSD.
32643149.summary: Patients with MS or NMOSD had higher blood levels of peroxiredoxin PRX5 and PRX6, and mice with EAE showed PRX5 in infiltrating immune cells of the spinal cord.

31739156.mechanism: Modulates S1P receptors, lowering brain S1PR1 levels
31739156.conclusion_quote: Thus, fingolimod does not seem to directly promote remyelination or protect against axonal injury or loss when given after cuprizone-induced demyelination.
31739156.summary: In cuprizone-treated mice, fingolimod lowered brain S1PR1 levels but did not improve myelin repair or nerve protection compared with placebo.

32050980.mechanism: reduces chemokine release and blocks immune cell migration
32050980.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our study indicates that clozapine protects against EAE by two different mechanisms; first, by reducing the chemoattractant proteins in the CNS; and second, by direct targeting the migration potential of peripheral immune cells.
32050980.summary: In the EAE model of MS, clozapine reduced immune cell entry into the brain and spinal cord by lowering chemokine signals and blocking cell migration.

32247877.mechanism: Deletes Kv1.4 potassium channel, reducing immune responses indirectly
32247877.conclusion_quote: These data argue for an indirect effect of Kv1.4 on immune cells, possibly via glial cells.
32247877.summary: In mice lacking the Kv1.4 potassium channel, EAE was milder with fewer Th1 immune responses, while cuprizone demyelination was unchanged.

32415059.mechanism: blocks NLRP3 inflammasome, preventing astrocyte conversion to neurotoxic A1
32415059.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our present data suggest that the NLRP3 inflammasome plays an important role in cognitive deficits in EAE, possibly via the alteration of astrocyte phenotypes.
32415059.summary: In mice with EAE, blocking the NLRP3 inflammasome with MCC950 improved memory, reduced hippocampal damage and prevented harmful changes in astrocytes.

31267597.mechanism: Not a treatment study, measures visual evoked potentials
31267597.conclusion_quote: Overall, our data demonstrated that non-invasive VEPs are a powerful tool to detect visual involvement at different stages of EAE, prompting their validation as biomarkers to test novel treatments against MS optic neuritis.
31267597.summary: In dark agouti rats with MOG-induced EAE, non-invasive visual evoked potential recordings detected optic nerve damage at different disease stages, supporting their use as biomarkers.

31958635.mechanism: Not applicable: no treatment or genetic change tested
31958635.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that the comprehension of the neurosteroidogenic processes could be relevant to better understand the sexual dimorphism of MS and to possibly design sex-oriented therapeutic strategies based on neuroactive steroids.
31958635.summary: Researchers studied rats with EAE, an MS model, and found that spinal cord pregnenolone production dropped in males early and in females only later in disease.

32981181.mechanism: Blocks Kv1.3 potassium channel, boosting PD-1 and suppressing Blimp-1
32981181.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrated a novel regulatory mechanism of Kv1.3 blockade on modulating CD8 + T cell differentiation through PD-1/Blimp-1 signaling.
32981181.summary: In rats with EAE, a Kv1.3 channel blocker reduced harmful CD8 T cell infiltration into the spinal cord, working through the PD-1 and Blimp-1 pathway.

32023446.mechanism: Lowers SAM, reducing histone methylation in Th17 cells
32023446.conclusion_quote: Our data identify methionine as a key nutritional factor shaping Th cell proliferation and function in part through regulation of histone methylation.
32023446.summary: In mice with EAE, a diet low in methionine reduced harmful Th17 immune cells, delaying disease onset and reducing inflammation in the nervous system.

31664743.mechanism: Reduces astrocyte LKB1, impairing metabolic support and increasing inflammation
31664743.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that metabolic dysfunction in astrocytes, in this case due to LKB1 deficiency, can exacerbate demyelinating disease by loss of metabolic support and increase in the inflammatory environment.
31664743.summary: Mice with EAE that lacked LKB1 in astrocytes had worse disease, with more mitochondrial changes, immune activation and nerve damage than controls.

33277253.conclusion_quote: Thus, MS oligodendroglia, regardless of major immune manipulators, are intrinsically capable of myelination and making functional axo-glia/glia-glia connections, reinforcing the view that the MS oligodendrocyte differentiation block is not from major intrinsic oligodendroglial deficits.
33277253.summary: In mice lacking immune cells, brain cells made from stem cells of people with MS formed myelin and linked with nerves just as well as healthy donor cells.

31872424.mechanism: Antibodies bind neurons, recruit immune cells, cause damage
31872424.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that autoimmunity to RBPs, such as hnRNP A1, play a role in neurodegeneration in EAE with important implications for the pathogenesis of MS.
31872424.summary: In mice with EAE, injecting antibodies against hnRNP A1 worsened disease and reduced spinal neurons, while control antibodies did not.

33256847.conclusion_quote: Together, OMGP-directed autoimmunity provides a new element of heterogeneity, helping to improve the stratification of patients for diagnostic and therapeutic purposes.
33256847.summary: In mice with EAE, OMGP-specific T cells caused a new type of inflammation in the brain lining, and some MS patients had antibodies against this myelin protein.

33233421.mechanism: Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory, suppresses NLRP3 and NF-κB signaling
33233421.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results show that the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory OLE has neuroprotective effects in the CNS of EAE mice, pointing out this natural product as a candidate to consider for research on MS treatments.
33233421.summary: In mice with EAE, an MS model, the olive compound oleacein reduced paralysis, nerve damage, inflammation and oxidative stress, and protected nerve cells.

32855863.mechanism: Increases cholesterol efflux via ABCA1, resolves HIF-1 signaling
32855863.conclusion_quote: Systemic MSC treatment positively affects RGC function and survival in EAE mice.
32855863.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, systemic stem cell treatment protected retinal nerve cells and improved their function, possibly through better cholesterol handling.

33168944.mechanism: Reduces pro-inflammatory microglia and macrophage activation
33168944.conclusion_quote: Thus, guanabenz may be a promising therapeutic to minimize inflammation without exerting severe off-target effects.
33168944.summary: In mice with EAE, the blood pressure drug guanabenz reduced inflammatory microglia and macrophages, but did not improve remyelination in the cuprizone model.

33117136.mechanism: Restores downregulated axon development gene expression in retina
33117136.conclusion_quote: Our study first reported that needling treatment after ON at the GB20 acupoint regulated gene expression of the retina and reversed the expression of downregulated axon development-related genes.
33117136.summary: In mice with EAE and optic neuritis, needling at the GB20 acupoint reversed loss of axon development genes in the retina, suggesting a benefit.

31731041.mechanism: Reduces brain degeneration, limiting immune cell recruitment
31731041.conclusion_quote: This study clearly illustrates that amelioration of a primary brain-intrinsic degenerative process secondary halts peripheral immune cell recruitment and, in consequence, inflammatory lesion development.
31731041.summary: Mice given cuprizone to damage the brain, then induced with an MS-like model, received laquinimod, which reduced brain damage and immune cell entry into the brain.

31573979.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that myelin-specific CD8+ T cells may contribute to disease pathogenesis via a FasL-dependent mechanism that preferentially promotes lesion formation in the brain.
31573979.summary: In mice with EAE, myelin-specific CD8+ T cells worsened inflammation in the brain but not the spinal cord, partly through a Fas ligand signal.

31874200.mechanism: desensitizes α7 nicotinic receptors without opening channel
31874200.conclusion_quote: Taken together, our results further support the hypothesis that nAChRs may modulate inflammation via receptor desensitization rather than channel opening.
31874200.summary: In mice with EAE, a silent α7 nicotinic receptor agonist called m-bromo PEP reduced inflammatory immune cells and cytokines and lessened disease severity.

32736564.mechanism: Blocks SIRT6, reducing dendritic cell migration
32736564.conclusion_quote: Our findings indicate the ability of Sirt6 inhibition to impair DC migration, to downregulate pathogenic T cell inflammatory responses and to delay EAE onset.
32736564.summary: In mice with EAE, a small SIRT6 inhibitor given before disease onset delayed symptoms by reducing dendritic cell migration and harmful T cell activity.

32792491.mechanism: Reduces Fas and Casp8-Bid apoptosis, improving oligodendrocyte survival
32792491.conclusion_quote: Our results identify Gsta4 as an intrinsic regulator of OL differentiation, survival and remyelination, as well as a potential target for future reparative MS therapies.
32792491.summary: In mice, removing or boosting the Gsta4 gene showed that higher Gsta4 levels help oligodendrocytes survive and remyelinate after damage, in models of demyelination and EAE.

31996225.conclusion_quote: Our results indicate that the components of the NGF system are subjected to differential regulation during the EAE disease course.
31996225.summary: In mice with EAE, the nerve growth factor system, including NGF and its TrkA and p75NTR receptors, was found to be raised in spinal cord inflammatory lesions over the disease course.

32981634.mechanism: Blocks HDAC enzymes to alter gene expression
32981634.conclusion_quote: This indicates a high therapeutic potential of isoform-selective HDACi for immune-mediated diseases.
32981634.summary: A review of histone deacetylase enzymes as drug targets, noting that HDAC inhibitors reduced disease in mouse models of autoimmune conditions including EAE, a model of MS.

31843645.mechanism: reduces pro-inflammatory T cells and activated microglia
31843645.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that CTX is a potential treatment not only for pain alteration but also for clinical progression induced by the disease as well as an useful tool for the development of new therapeutic approaches for the multiple sclerosis control.
31843645.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the snake venom component crotoxin eased pain and slowed disease progression by calming immune cells.

33283780.conclusion_quote: This manuscript presents a protocol for that is useful for the isolation, identification, and characterization of infiltrated lymphocytes from the CNS and will be helpful for our understanding of how lymphocytes are involved in the development of the CNS autoimmune disease.
33283780.summary: Researchers describe a method to isolate and analyze immune cells that infiltrate the brain and spinal cord in mice with EAE, a model of MS.

32328934.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes antioxidant enzyme imbalance
32328934.conclusion_quote: The received data necessitate the search for compounds that can prevent inhibition of antioxidant system components in order to analyze the possibility of their use in the treatment of multiple sclerosis.
32328934.summary: In rats with experimental allergic encephalomyelitis, a model of MS, researchers found disrupted antioxidant enzyme activity and depleted glutathione, pointing toward future protective treatments.

32629305.mechanism: Raises klotho and PLP myelin proteins, reduces disability
32629305.conclusion_quote: Our data demonstrate that HIIT increased klotho and PLP and decreased disability.
32629305.summary: In an EAE model of MS, six weeks of high-intensity interval training before disease induction raised myelin-related proteins klotho and PLP and reduced disability.

31124292.mechanism: Rho kinase blockade cuts inflammation, boosts growth factors
31124292.conclusion_quote: These results provide evidence for the therapeutic potential of Fasudil in CPZ-induced demyelination.
31124292.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced myelin damage, the drug fasudil improved behavior, calmed brain inflammation, and supported repair of myelin-making cells.

33680032.mechanism: Reduces oxidative stress and astrocyte and microglia activation
33680032.conclusion_quote: These results suggest a potent pleiotropic therapeutic efficiency for DNC for protection of myelinating cells, possibly via suppression of astrocytes and microglia.
33680032.summary: In mice fed cuprizone to damage myelin, a curcumin nanoformulation protected oligodendrocytes, preserved myelin, and reduced activated astrocytes and microglia.

31678404.mechanism: Blocks CXCR2, promoting precursor differentiation into myelin-forming cells
31678404.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our results demonstrated that CXCR2 antagonism efficiently promoted OPC differentiation and enhanced remyelination in CPZ-intoxicated mice, supporting CXCR2 as a promising therapeutic target for the treatment of chronic demyelinating diseases such as MS.
31678404.summary: In mice with cuprizone-induced demyelination, a drug that blocks the CXCR2 receptor helped precursor cells mature and repair the myelin coating of nerves.

32951024.summary: This notice retracts a 2014 study of a treatment called MS14 in female mice with a multiple sclerosis model. It reports no new findings.

33305185.conclusion_quote: Thus, complex Ca 2+ signaling alterations contribute to synaptic dysfunctions in photoreceptors in early EAE.
33305185.summary: Mice with early stage EAE, a model of MS, showed weaker calcium signaling at retinal photoreceptor synapses, linked to altered calcium handling proteins.

31811900.conclusion_quote: Altogether, our results demonstrate that UTE-MTR values significantly correlate with myelin content as measured by histopathology, not only in white matter, but also in subcortical and cortical grey matter regions in the cuprizone mouse model for MS.
31811900.summary: In mice given cuprizone to damage myelin, a special MRI scan tracked myelin loss and repair, matching tissue analysis in both white and grey matter.

33097690.mechanism: blocks CSF1R signaling in microglia and macrophages
33097690.conclusion_quote: Together, these data suggest that CSF1R inhibition can reduce deleterious microglial proliferation and modulate microglial phenotypes during neuroinflammatory pathogenesis, particularly in progressive MS.
33097690.summary: In mice with EAE and an acute LPS inflammation model, a new small-molecule CSF1R inhibitor reduced brain inflammation, microglial overgrowth, axonal damage and neurological symptoms.

32926951.conclusion_quote: Our results show increased GluCEST-weighted signals in the LPC-induced demyelination rat brain compared with control.
32926951.summary: In rats with lysophosphatidylcholine-induced demyelination, a brain imaging method detected higher glutamate signals in the hippocampus and corpus callosum than in healthy controls.

31898518.mechanism: Ketone bodies as alternative brain energy source
31898518.conclusion_quote: This study is the first clinical study investigating the effects of a KD and a FD on disease progression of MS.
31898518.summary: This protocol describes a human trial comparing ketogenic diets, fasting diets, and a standard diet in 111 people with relapsing multiple sclerosis, tracking new brain lesions after 18 months.

32979467.conclusion_quote: Our data suggests that changes in complement components, chemoattractant cytokines and especially enrichment in microglial cells may be the primary drivers of processes that limit recovery in EAE.
32979467.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, gene activity was measured across brain regions and spinal cord, with strongest changes in complement and microglial genes.

33137648.mechanism: Activates AhR to keep Tregs stable and suppressive
33137648.conclusion_quote: We found that DIM treatment significantly alleviated the severity of EAE by maintaining the stability and suppressive function of Tregs instead of facilitating the differentiation of Tregs.
33137648.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, the dietary compound DIM kept regulatory T cells stable and active, reducing disease severity.

32019585.mechanism: removes neutrophil CXCR2 signaling, reducing ROS-driven neuron damage
32019585.conclusion_quote: CXCR2 signal in neutrophils is critical in triggering CNS neuronal damage via ROS generation, which leads to prolonged EAE disease.
32019585.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting Cxcr2 only from neutrophils reduced spinal cord nerve damage and milder disease, showing neutrophil CXCR2 drives nerve injury.

31653711.mechanism: traps immune cells in lymph nodes
31653711.conclusion_quote: 18 F-FAC PET can visualize brain-infiltrating leukocytes in a mouse MS model and can monitor the response of these cells to an immunomodulatory drug.
31653711.summary: In mice with EAE, a PET scan tracer showed immune cells entering the brain, and fingolimod treatment lowered this signal by 37 percent.

31719166.conclusion_quote: Our study shows that proliferation of hippocampal NSCs and synaptic connectivity of adult-born neurons are inversely correlated with the level of demyelination, providing critical insight into hippocampal neurogenesis as a potential therapeutic target to treat cognitive deficits associated with MS.
31719166.summary: In mice given cuprizone and rapamycin, hippocampal demyelination nearly stopped new neuron formation and reduced connections of new neurons, which recovered during remyelination.

32710244.conclusion_quote: Therefore, we conclude that better in vivo and in vitro models which mimic the pathological hallmarks of the different MS lesion types are required for the successful development of remyelination promoting drugs.
32710244.summary: Researchers examined human MS brain lesions and stem cell derived human oligodendrocytes to learn why myelin repair fails, finding the causes vary by lesion stage.

32529488.conclusion_quote: Collectively, these results suggest that the upregulation of cathepsins in the olfactory bulb of mice with EAE is associated with transient olfactory dysfunction in autoimmune encephalomyelitis.
32529488.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, cathepsin enzymes were found at higher levels in the olfactory bulb during paralysis, alongside temporary smell problems.

33027652.mechanism: Removing CST3 lowers antigen-presenting cell activation
33027652.conclusion_quote: Altogether, we have shown that CST3 has a sex-dependent role in MOG 35-55 -induced EAE.
33027652.summary: Removing the Cystatin C gene in female mice with EAE reduced their disease signs, while male mice showed no change.

32511247.mechanism: Not applicable, IFNγ used as inflammatory challenge
32511247.conclusion_quote: Our results reveal that a chronic low-grade inflammatory environment may have profound effects on the efficacy of regenerative therapies.
32511247.summary: In a lab study of human stem cells from people with MS, cells matured into myelin-making oligodendrocytes normally, but chronic low-dose inflammatory signaling blocked this process.

33335128.mechanism: Shifts gut immune cells toward a regulatory response
33335128.conclusion_quote: These results suggest a clear gut-brain axis modulation by selenized S. cerevisiae and suggest their inclusion in clinical trials.
33335128.summary: In mice with EAE, oral yeast and selenized yeast supplements reduced disease signs and Th1 inflammation, with the selenized form working more strongly.

32920871.mechanism: Modulates immune response, lowering IFN-γ cytokine levels
32920871.conclusion_quote: Dicrocoelium eggs have a great potential to stimulate immunomodulation towards treatment of EAE during the initial phase.
32920871.summary: In mice with EAE, injecting Dicrocoelium parasite eggs before or early after induction reduced disease scores and immune inflammation signals, though later treatment did not help.

32182451.mechanism: deletes IL-6 receptor on endothelial cells, reducing inflammation
32182451.conclusion_quote: These findings demonstrate that classical IL-6 signaling via endothelial cells of the CNS contributes substantially to the development of MS-like pathology, which should be taken into consideration when conceptualizing future therapeutic approaches.
32182451.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the IL-6 receptor from brain and spinal cord blood vessel cells reduced symptoms, demyelination, and immune cell infiltration.

32599126.mechanism: Stimulation reduces gliosis and vimentin, restores myelin
32599126.conclusion_quote: Our study demonstrated beneficial effects of theta-burst stimulation (TBS), an experimental paradigm of rTMS, on disease course of acute EAE.
32599126.summary: In rats with EAE, a model of multiple sclerosis, repeated magnetic brain stimulation reduced paralysis, reactive glial scarring, and myelin loss, improving the disease course.

32747712.mechanism: treats innate immune cells before symptoms appear
32747712.conclusion_quote: This technology offers a new approach to monitor organ-specific autoimmunity, and represents a platform to analyze immune dysfunction within otherwise inaccessible target tissues.
32747712.summary: Researchers built biomaterial implants in mice with EAE to sample immune cells, tracking disease and showing early treatment before symptoms reduced disease.

32041968.mechanism: Boosts aerobic glycolysis and energy metabolism
32041968.conclusion_quote: Based on these preclinical studies, clean-surfaced, faceted gold nanocrystals represent a novel remyelinating therapeutic for multiple sclerosis.
32041968.summary: In mice with cuprizone or lysolecithin induced myelin damage, oral gold nanocrystals promoted myelin repair and improved motor function.

33148886.mechanism: Describes ventricle volume changes, no treatment tested
33148886.conclusion_quote: These changes demonstrate that VV does not necessarily expand irreversibly in MS but, over short time scales, can expand and contract.
33148886.summary: In mice with EAE and in MS patients, brain ventricles grew sharply during relapses and shrank after recovery, showing they can expand and contract over short periods.

32651278.mechanism: Removes CCN3 to test its role in myelin repair
32651278.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that despite robust and dynamic expression in the CNS, CCN3 is not required for efficient myelination or remyelination in the murine CNS in vivo.
32651278.summary: In mice lacking the CCN3 gene, cuprizone and lysolecithin demyelination models showed normal numbers of oligodendrocytes and myelin repair, suggesting CCN3 is not essential.

32659316.conclusion_quote: Our data show, for the first time, the spontaneous development of trigeminal sensitization before the onset of relapsing-remitting EAE in rats.
32659316.summary: In rats with relapsing EAE induced by MOG protein, facial pain began before disease onset, alongside glial cell activation and metabolic changes in the trigeminal system.

31955841.mechanism: catalytically inactive tPA variants reduce T cell reactivity
31955841.conclusion_quote: Moreover, successful amelioration of EAE was achieved by administration of tPA variant proteins.
31955841.summary: In mice with EAE, a modified tPA protein that lacks enzyme activity reduced disease severity and T cell reactivity, while mice lacking tPA had worse disease.

32447250.mechanism: blocks macrophage NF-κB and MAPK inflammatory signaling
32447250.conclusion_quote: These data suggest that in addition to T cells, BBR3378 can also target macrophages to attenuate the inflammation associated with EAE.
32447250.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug called BBR3378 calmed macrophage immune cells, reducing their entry into the brain and easing disease symptoms.

interventions: probiotic bacterium Escherichia coli strain Nissle 1917 (EcN)
33045841.mechanism: Reduces T-cell infiltration and microglia activation
33045841.conclusion_quote: Although further studies are necessary to comprehend the exact protective mechanisms induced, our study supports a promising use of EcN as a probiotic for the prevention of MS.
33045841.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, two doses of the probiotic E. coli Nissle 1917 given before disease induction delayed onset and reduced severity and CNS inflammation.

32977663.mechanism: Inhibits JNK kinase, reducing T-cell apoptosis and proliferation
32977663.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, our study demonstrates that pharmacological pan-JNK inhibition might be a treatment strategy for autoimmune central nervous system demyelination.
32977663.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, were given the oral JNK inhibitor SP600125 after symptoms began, which reduced disease severity and immune cell infiltration in the spinal cord.

32172212.mechanism: Inhibits PDI, easing ER stress and neuronal apoptosis
32172212.conclusion_quote: We reported here that the inhibition of PDI protected EAE mice against neuronal apoptosis induced by prolonged ER stress and resulted in neuroprotection.
32172212.summary: In mice with EAE, a drug blocking protein disulfide isomerase reduced ER stress, immune cell buildup and nerve cell death, protecting the brain.

32727036.mechanism: viral infection activates B cells to make autoantibodies
32727036.conclusion_quote: Thus, the viral infection might potentially affect the outcome of autoimmune diseases, and/or the development of other chronic infections, including the protection and/or pathogenesis of TMEV-induced demyelinating disease.
32727036.summary: In a mouse model of MS, the Theiler's virus infected and activated B cells, which then produced autoantibodies and stimulated T cells.

32688029.conclusion_quote: These results indicate that a lower severity of EAE disease may allow for the study of pain behaviors while still presenting with disease pathology.
32688029.summary: In mice with EAE, lower pertussis toxin doses produced mechanical pain hypersensitivity while still showing disease pathology, creating a better model for studying MS pain.

32751289.conclusion_quote: Our results provide an SPMS-OPC cellular model and encouraging venues to study potential cell communication deficiencies in the progressive form of multiple sclerosis (MS) for future treatment strategies.
32751289.summary: Stem cells from people with progressive MS were turned into oligodendrocyte progenitor cells, which showed altered gene activity and weaker ability to stimulate cell migration.

32681355.mechanism: inhibits BMP signaling, expanding plasmacytoid dendritic cells
32681355.conclusion_quote: In addition, the clinical outcome of the disease was improved when the BMP signaling pathway was inhibited in mice that presented established EAE symptoms.
32681355.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, small molecules that block the BMP signaling pathway eased symptoms and brain damage when given after symptoms had already started.

31950453.mechanism: induces HO-1, reducing inflammation and oxidative stress
31950453.conclusion_quote: Together, our data demonstrate that daphnetin has an anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective role during the pathogenesis of EAE, which is partially at least, dependent on its regulation of HO-1.
31950453.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, daphnetin reduced brain inflammation and helped protect nerves, partly by boosting the antioxidant enzyme heme oxygenase-1.

30843756.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes pathology only
30843756.conclusion_quote: The combination of VBM with CLARITY in EAE can localize GM atrophy in brain that is associated with a specific pathology in spinal cord, revealing a PSA of GM loss.
30843756.summary: In mice with EAE, researchers found that damaged nerve fibers in the spinal cord track with shrinkage of the brain's sensorimotor cortex.

32511268.mechanism: Not applicable, no treatment or genetic change tested
32511268.conclusion_quote: In summary, cuprizone administration causes an increase in blood-brain barrier permeability and this permeability coincides with mast cell activation.
32511268.summary: In the cuprizone model of demyelination, blood brain barrier leakage increased within three days and coincided with mast cell activation, before demyelination appeared.

32442900.mechanism: Inhibits PDE5 raising cGMP to reduce neuroinflammation
32442900.conclusion_quote: The present findings demonstrated that sildenafil has therapeutic potential for cognitive deficit associated with multiple sclerosis.
32442900.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, sildenafil delayed symptoms, reduced brain inflammation, and increased proteins linked to synaptic plasticity and memory.

33054803.mechanism: Tracer binds P2X7 receptor on microglia for imaging
33054803.conclusion_quote: Our data shows that [ 11 C]SMW139 is a promising PET tracer for imaging neuroinflammation and evaluating the dynamics of pro-inflammatory microglia in the brain.
33054803.summary: In rats with EAE, a new PET tracer called [11C]SMW139 showed higher brain uptake during peak disease, tracking inflammatory microglia activity.

32458595.mechanism: Restores AMPK signaling, reducing ER stress and apoptosis
32458595.conclusion_quote: Our study revealed a new method for treating MS using currently approved antifungal drugs.
32458595.summary: Mice with EAE, a model of MS, given the antifungal itraconazole had fewer limb disabilities and less spinal demyelination, linked to restored AMPK signaling.

32745471.mechanism: Loss of neuronal MCU impairs mitochondrial calcium uptake and ATP
32745471.conclusion_quote: These findings suggest that MCU inhibition contributes to axonal damage that drives MS progression.
32745471.summary: In mice with EAE, deleting the mitochondrial calcium uniporter from neurons worsened nerve damage and blocked myelin repair.

31926910.mechanism: not applicable, no treatment or gene change tested
31926910.conclusion_quote: These results suggest that BSL-II-binding N-acetyl-glucosamine and BSL-I-binding N-acetyl-galactose are involved in transient olfactory dysfunction in EAE, which may hamper odor perception and/or signal processing in olfactory sensory neurons.
31926910.summary: In rats with experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, an animal model of MS, sugar molecules in the nose's smell tissue changed temporarily, possibly affecting the sense of smell.

32276661.mechanism: Gene deletion changes neutrophil and T-cell immune responses
32276661.conclusion_quote: These studies show that NCF1 and NOS2 interact to regulate peptide-induced EAE.
32276661.summary: In mice with EAE, removing the NCF1 gene reduced disease, while removing both NCF1 and NOS2 worsened it, showing the two genes interact.

31900864.mechanism: Restores mitochondrial complex I function, preventing cristae loss
31900864.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, targeting the dysfunctional complex I using NDI1 gene can be an approach to address axonal and neuronal loss responsible for permanent disability in MS that is unaltered by current disease modifying drugs.
31900864.summary: In mice with EAE, a gene therapy delivering the yeast NDI1 enzyme after vision problems began improved visual function and protected nerve cells and their fibers.

32866329.conclusion_quote: Serial USPIO imaging is a promising biomarker for investigating the effect of therapeutic interventions on monocytes/macrophages and microglia activation and neurodegeneration in TMEV-infected animals.
32866329.summary: Researchers used a contrast agent and 9.4 T MRI to track immune cell activity in mice infected with a virus that causes chronic demyelination, finding lesions rose over time.

33396601.conclusion_quote: Our results showed that cuprizone-induced neuronal demyelination may influence the severe abnormal metabolism in hippocampal lesions, and these responses could be caused by microglial activation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and astrocytic necrosis.
33396601.summary: In rats fed cuprizone to strip myelin, brain scans showed altered hippocampus chemistry, with more glutamate and less creatine, pointing to inflammation and energy problems.

32046916.conclusion_quote: Furthermore, oral administration of compound 18 significantly decreased clinical severity in an experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) model.
32046916.summary: In rat precursor cell cultures and an EAE model of MS, a new oral compound called compound 18 helped precursor cells mature into myelin-making cells and reduced disease severity.

31605825.conclusion_quote: Hence, the onVDMP CEST MRI signal has potential as a novel imaging biomarker and predictor of disease progression in MS.
31605825.summary: In an animal model of MS called EAE, a special MRI scan detected brain changes before paralysis, suggesting it could help predict disease progression.

33121494.mechanism: activates Axl receptor to reduce inflammation and demyelination
33121494.conclusion_quote: Our data suggests that the beneficial effect of Gas6/Axl signaling observed in mice administered with Gas6 can be partially preserved by administering an activating α-Axl antibody, but not α-MerTK.
33121494.summary: In mice with EAE, an antibody that activates the Axl receptor, given before symptoms appeared, reduced paralysis and spinal cord inflammation and demyelination.

31971074.conclusion_quote: Here, we present and evaluate the evidence for this hypothesis in the pre-clinical animal model of MS, experimental autoimmune encephalitis, in helminth-infected MS patients and in clinical trials of administered helminth immunotherapy (HIT).
31971074.summary: This review evaluates whether parasitic helminth worms can treat multiple sclerosis, covering mouse EAE studies, infected patients, and clinical trials.

31709666.conclusion_quote: Results indicate that the profiles of serum pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines might be useful as biomarkers for monitoring the pathological manifestation of EAE.
31709666.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, researchers measured blood immune signals and found higher inflammatory cytokines, with an inflammation ratio tracking disease severity.

32376270.mechanism: induces autophagy, inhibits immune response, restores gut microbiota
32376270.conclusion_quote: Inhibiting immune cell-mediated inflammation and restoring the composition of gut microbiota may help to alleviate the clinical symptoms of multiple sclerosis.
32376270.summary: In mice with EAE, a model of MS, rapamycin and MCC950 together or alone eased disease, reduced immune activity, and brought gut bacteria closer to normal levels.

32774683.mechanism: Modulates exosomal microRNAs and NRP-1 to promote remyelination
32774683.conclusion_quote: In conclusion, these results suggested that BSYSC has a neuroprotective effect and facilitates remyelination and that the mechanism underlying the effect of BSYSC on remyelination probably involves regulation of the NRP-1 and GTX proteins and miRs in serum exosomes, which drive promyelination.
32774683.summary: In mice with EAE, a herbal capsule called BSYSC improved symptoms, reduced nerve damage, and promoted myelin repair, partly through signals carried by exosomes.

32276110.mechanism: Recruits regulatory T cells that promote remyelination
32276110.conclusion_quote: The data presented here provide direct evidence for collaboration between CNS Tregs and hNSCs promoting remyelination.
32276110.summary: In mice with EAE, human neural stem cell transplants in chronic disease reduced inflammation and improved myelin repair, but only when regulatory T cells were present.

31499065.mechanism: No treatment tested, describes sex differences in synapses
